words.tr: phrase. 工作保障
words.ex: He wants job security because he has a family to support.
words.ex_cn: 他想要工作保障，因为他要养家。
words.en: Job security refers to the probability that an individual will keep their job; a job with a high level of job security is one with a low risk of unemployment.

words.tr: phrase. 失业的；没有工作的
words.ex_cn: 他失业了，因为丢了工作。
words.en: To be without a job despite being willing and able to work.

words.tr: phrase. 工作满意度
words.ex: He has high job satisfaction because he likes his work.
words.ex_cn: 他工作满意度很高，因为他喜欢自己的工作。
words.en: Job satisfaction refers to the level of contentment employees feel with their job, which can be influenced by various factors such as work environment, salary, and opportunities for advancement.

words.tr: phrase. 有...的资格；有权
words.ex: He is entitled to free healthcare.
words.ex_cn: 他有权享受免费医疗。
words.en: If you are entitled to something, you have the right to have it or do it.

words.tr: phrase. 一种满足感；成就感；圆满感
words.ex: Helping others gives me a sense of fulfillment.
words.ex_cn: 帮助他人给我一种满足感。
words.en: A feeling of happiness or satisfaction because you have achieved something or because something good has happened.

words.tr: n. 沮丧；受挫；挫败；
words.ex: He couldn't hide his frustration after losing the game.
words.ex_cn: 他输掉比赛后无法掩饰自己的沮丧。
words.en: The feeling of being upset or annoyed as a result of being unable to change or achieve something.

words.tr: phrase. 人才外流；指受过高等教育或具有专业技能的人才大量移居国外的现象
words.ex: The country is experiencing a severe brain drain as many skilled professionals emigrate.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正经历着严重的智囊流失，因为许多专业人士正在移民。
words.en: The emigration of highly trained or intelligent people from a particular country.

words.tr: phrase. 工作经验；职业经历
words.ex: He has work experience in a restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 他在餐厅有工作经验。
words.en: Work experience refers to the knowledge and skills that someone has gained through working in a particular job or field.

words.tr: phrase. 过重的工作负担；过度的工作量
words.ex: He feels tired because of excessive workload.
words.ex_cn: 他因为工作量过大而感到疲惫。
words.en: An unreasonably large amount of work assigned to a person or group, often leading to stress and reduced productivity.

words.tr: phrase. 劳动密集型的；需要大量人力的
words.ex: This type of manufacturing is labour intensive.
words.ex_cn: 这种类型的制造业是劳动密集型的。
words.en: Requiring a large amount of work relative to output, often involving human effort rather than machines.

words.tr: phrase. 一个令人感到压抑的截止日期
words.ex: He feels stressed because of an oppressive deadline at work.
words.ex_cn: 他因为工作中一个压抑的截止日期感到压力很大。
words.en: An oppressive deadline refers to a deadline that is extremely stressful and difficult to meet, often causing anxiety or pressure.

words.tr: phrase. 在巨大压力下工作
words.ex: He can work under enormous stress and still do a good job.
words.ex_cn: 他能在巨大压力下工作，并且仍然做得很好。
words.en: To perform tasks or duties while experiencing a significant amount of pressure or stress.

words.tr: phrase. 对员工友好的环境；一种支持员工福祉、促进工作满意度和积极工作氛围的组织环境
words.ex: The company provides an employee-friendly environment with flexible hours.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司提供灵活的工作时间，营造了对员工友好的环境。
words.en: A workplace that is designed to be supportive and beneficial for employees, often including policies or features that promote well-being, satisfaction, and productivity.

words.tr: n. 工作场所；工作地点；
words.ex: The new safety rules apply to the workplace.
words.ex_cn: 新的安全规则适用于工作场所。
words.en: A workplace is a place where people work, such as an office or factory.

words.w: work long hours for low pay
words.tr: phrase. 为低薪长时间工作
words.uk: wɜːk lɒŋ ˈaʊəz fɔː ləʊ peɪ
words.us: wɜːrk lɔːŋ ˈaʊərz fɔː loʊ peɪ
words.ex: He works long hours for low pay at the factory.
words.ex_cn: 他在工厂里长时间工作却赚得很少。
words.en: To work for extended periods of time while receiving minimal compensation.

words.tr: phrase. 休闲娱乐活动
words.ex: He enjoys leisure activities on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末喜欢从事休闲活动。
words.en: Leisure activities refer to activities done for enjoyment when one is not working.

words.tr: phrase. 一份要求很高的工作；需要大量精力、时间或技能的工作
words.ex: He has a demanding job that requires long hours.
words.ex_cn: 他有一份要求很高的工作，需要长时间工作。
words.en: A demanding job is one that requires a lot of time, energy, or attention because of its difficulty or the high standards expected.

words.tr:
n. 合同；契约；
v. 收缩；
words.ex: They signed a contract to buy the house.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一份购买房子的合同。
words.en: A contract is a legal agreement between two or more parties. It can also mean to become smaller or tighter, or to catch a disease.

words.tr: phrase. 职业道德；工作伦理（指对工作认真负责、勤奋努力的态度）
words.ex: He has a strong work ethic and always finishes his tasks on time.
words.ex_cn: 他有很强的职业道德，总是按时完成任务。
words.en: The principle that hard work is intrinsically virtuous or worthy of reward.

words.tr: phrase. 灵活的安排；可调整的布置
words.ex: The company offers a flexible arrangement for working hours.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司提供灵活的工作时间安排。
words.en: A flexible arrangement refers to an adaptable or variable plan or agreement that can be modified according to needs or circumstances.

words.tr: phrase. 一种工作制度，指每天从早上9点工作到晚上9点，每周工作6天
words.ex: He checks his work schedule every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一都查看自己的工作时间表。
words.en: A work schedule where employees are expected to work from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m., six days a week, common in some industries in China.

words.tr: phrase. 日常工作；常规作业
words.ex: He does routine work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天做常规工作。
words.en: Regular tasks or duties that are part of one's job or daily life, often considered mundane or repetitive.

words.tr: phrase. 人员配备充足的；拥有足够员工的
words.ex: The hospital is well-staffed with nurses and doctors.
words.ex_cn: 这家医院有充足的护士和医生。
words.en: Having an adequate number of qualified employees to meet operational needs.

words.tr: phrase. 人手不足的；员工短缺的
words.ex: The restaurant was short-staffed on the weekend, so the service was slower than usual.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅周末人手不足，所以服务比平时慢。
words.en: If a company, organization, etc. is short-staffed, it does not have enough employees to work effectively.

words.tr: phrase. 使用；接近；可以利用
words.ex: Students have access to the library after school.
words.ex_cn: 学生放学后可以使用图书馆。
words.en: To have the right or opportunity to use or see something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 在……和……之间引起摩擦；导致……与……之间的矛盾或不和
words.ex: His rude words cause friction between the two friends.
words.ex_cn: 他粗鲁的话让两个朋友之间产生了矛盾。
words.en: To create tension or disagreement between people or groups.

words.tr: 短语动词。冲突产生；矛盾出现
words.ex: Conflicts arise when people have different opinions.
words.ex_cn: 当人们有不同意见时，冲突就会产生。
words.en: Disagreements or disputes emerge, typically causing tension or problems.

words.tr: phrase. 由压力引发的疾病
words.ex: He got stress-induced diseases from working too hard.
words.ex_cn: 他因为工作太辛苦而得了压力引起的疾病。
words.en: Illnesses caused or worsened by prolonged psychological pressure.

words.tr: phrase. 工作节奏；工作速度
words.ex: The pace of work in the city can be overwhelming for newcomers.
words.ex_cn: 城市的工作节奏对新人来说可能是压倒性的。
words.en: The speed at which work is done.

words.tr: phrase. 职业危害；职业性风险
words.ex: Working with chemicals is an occupational hazard.
words.ex_cn: 接触化学物质是一种职业风险。
words.en: A risk inherent to a particular job or profession.

words.tr: phrase. 职业病
words.ex: He got an occupational disease from working in a factory.
words.ex_cn: 他在工厂工作时得了职业病。
words.en: An occupational disease is a health condition or disorder that is caused by the work environment or the activities involved in a person's job.

words.tr: phrase. 极其繁重的；累断腰的（指非常辛苦、耗费体力的工作）
words.ex: He does backbreaking tasks every day to support his family.
words.ex_cn: 他每天做繁重的工作来养家糊口。
words.en: Extremely physically demanding and exhausting work.

words.tr: phrase. 体力劳动；手工劳动
words.ex: Manual work often requires physical strength and endurance.
words.ex_cn: 手工劳动通常需要体力和耐力。
words.en: Physical work done by hand, often requiring physical strength and endurance.

words.tr: phrase. 脑力劳动；心智工作
words.ex: He does mental work every day at his office.
words.ex_cn: 他每天在办公室做脑力劳动。
words.en: Work that requires cognitive effort, concentration, and intellectual engagement.

words.tr: phrase. 负责；主管
words.ex: He is in charge of the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 他负责这个教室。
words.en: To have control over or responsibility for something.

words.tr: phrase. 有态度问题；表现得傲慢或不合作
words.ex: He have an attitude problem when he doesn't get what he wants.
words.ex_cn: 当他得不到想要的东西时，他就有态度问题。

words.tr: phrase. adj. 极其热衷于工作或活动的人；非常积极主动的人
words.ex: She always arrives early at the office, eager beaver that she is.
words.ex_cn: 她总是早早地到办公室，她就是这样一个非常勤奋的人。
words.en: To be someone who is very enthusiastic and eager to work hard, often to an excessive degree.

words.tr: 短语. 是能力的指标；表示某人能力的标志
words.ex: Her high score on the test is an indicator of her ability to learn quickly.
words.ex_cn: 她在测试中取得的高分是她学习能力强的指标。
words.en: To serve as a sign or proof of someone's skill or capability.

words.tr: phrase. 感觉不自在或不适应，好像不在自己熟悉的环境中
words.ex: He feels out of his element when talking about sports.
words.ex_cn: 当他谈论体育时，他感到不自在。
words.en: To feel uncomfortable, awkward, or out of place in a particular situation or environment.

words.tr: phrase. 对...敏感；与...协调；能感知...的变化
words.ex: She is attuned to the needs of her students.
words.ex_cn: 她对学生的需要很敏感。
words.en: To be attuned to something means to be aware of and understand it, especially the needs, feelings, or changes of something.

words.w: work all day and all night
words.tr: phrase. 整日整夜地工作；日夜不停地干活
words.ex: He works all day and all night to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他昼夜不停地工作以完成这个项目。
words.en: To work continuously, day and night, without rest.

words.tr: phrase. 持续工作；不间断地工作
words.ex: He works continuously to finish his project.
words.ex_cn: 他不停地工作以完成他的项目。
words.en: To work without stopping or taking a break.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人分心；转移某人的注意力
words.en: To divert someone's attention away from a specific task, subject, or concern.

words.tr: 转移某人的注意力
words.ex: The loud noise diverted my attention from the book.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音使我的注意力从书上转移了。

words.tr: phrase. 过着忙碌的生活
words.ex: He leads a busy life with work and family.
words.ex_cn: 他过着忙碌的生活，要工作又要照顾家庭。
words.en: To have a schedule or lifestyle that is filled with many activities or responsibilities, leaving little free time.

words.tr: phrase. 忙于工作而脱不开身；被工作占用无法分身
words.ex: I can't make it to the meeting because I'm tied up at work.
words.ex_cn: 我不能参加会议，因为工作缠身。
words.en: To be extremely busy or occupied with work, leaving no free time.

words.tr: phrase. 一份压力大且耗时的工作
words.uk: ə ˈstresful ənd ˈtaɪm kənˌsjuːmɪŋ dʒɒb
words.us: ə ˈstresful ənd ˈtaɪm kənˌsumɪŋ dʒɑːb
words.ex: He has a stressful and time-consuming job as a nurse.
words.ex_cn: 他作为一名护士，工作压力大又耗时。
words.en: A job that causes significant mental or emotional pressure and requires a large amount of time.

words.tr: phrase. 一份轻松舒适的工作；待遇好且压力小的工作
words.ex: He landed a cushy job right after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 他毕业后就找到了一份轻松的工作。
words.en: A cushy job is a job that is easy and does not require much effort, often also providing good pay or conditions.

words.tr: phrase. 就业前景；工作前景；职业前途
words.ex: The job prospects for graduates in this field are very promising.
words.ex_cn: 这个领域毕业生的就业前景非常乐观。
words.en: The possibility or likelihood of future success in employment.

words.tr: n. 动机；诱因；
words.ex: The bonus is an incentive to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 奖金是努力工作的动机。
words.en: Something that encourages a person to do something or to work harder.

words.tr: 激励追随者
words.ex: A great leader is someone who can inspire one's followers to achieve great things.
words.ex_cn: 一个伟大的领导者是能够激励追随者成就伟业的人。

words.tr: phrase. 在……之间建立密切的关系；在……之间培养良好的沟通与信任
words.ex: They build a close rapport between teacher and student.
words.ex_cn: 他们在老师和学生之间建立亲密的关系。
words.en: To establish a strong, friendly, and trusting relationship with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 玻璃天花板（指女性或少数群体在职业晋升中遇到的隐形障碍）
words.ex: She broke the glass ceiling in her company.
words.ex_cn: 她打破了公司里的无形晋升壁垒。
words.en: An unofficial barrier to advancement in a profession, especially affecting women and members of minorities.

words.tr: phrase. 歧视；不公平地对待
words.ex: They should not discriminate against people because of their skin color.
words.ex_cn: 他们不应该因为肤色而歧视他人。
words.en: If someone discriminates against a person or group, they treat them unfairly because of their race, sex, or some other characteristic.

words.tr: phrase. 可支配收入；扣除税收和必要开支后剩余可用于消费或储蓄的钱
words.ex: He spends his disposable money on video games.
words.ex_cn: 他把可支配的钱花在电子游戏上。
words.en: Income available for spending after essential expenses have been covered.

words.tr: phrase. 炫耀性消费；挥霍
words.ex: He buys expensive cars for conspicuous consumption.
words.ex_cn: 他买昂贵的汽车是为了炫耀性消费。
words.en: Conspicuous consumption refers to the act of buying and using products to publicly display economic power—of the income or of the accumulated wealth of the buyer.

words.tr: phrase. 对…征税；向…课税
words.ex: The government decided to levy a tax on luxury goods.
words.ex_cn: 政府决定对奢侈品征税。
words.en: To impose a tax on something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 节约的；经济的；节省的
words.ex: He tries to be economical with water.
words.ex_cn: 他努力节约用水。
words.en: To use resources carefully and avoid waste.

words.tr: phrase. 具有成本效益的；划算的；性价比高的
words.ex: Buying in bulk is cost-effective.
words.ex_cn: 批量购买很划算。
words.en: To provide good value for the money spent; efficient in terms of cost.

words.tr: phrase. 爱惜小钱而浪费大钱的；因小失大的
words.uk: bi ˈpeni waɪz ænd paʊnd ˈfuːlɪʃ
words.us: bi ˈpɛni waɪz ænd paʊnd ˈfuːlɪʃ
words.en: To be extremely careful with small amounts of money while being wasteful or careless with large amounts.

words.tr: phrase. 收入来源
words.ex: Her small bakery is a source of income.
words.ex_cn: 她的小面包店是一个收入来源。
words.en: A means of earning money to support oneself.

words.tr: phrase. 勤俭节约以做某事；节省开支以达成某个目的
words.ex: They scrimp and save to buy a house.
words.ex_cn: 他们勤俭节约以买一套房子。

words.tr: phrase. 属于
words.ex: This book belongs to me.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于我。
words.en: If something belongs to you, you own it or it is yours.

words.tr: phrase. 使收支相抵；勉强维持生计；量入为出
words.ex: He works two jobs to make ends meet.
words.ex_cn: 他做两份工作来维持生计。
words.en: To have enough money to pay for the things that you need.

words.tr: phrase. 没钱的；破产的；手头紧的
words.ex: He is broke after buying a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一部新手机后身无分文。
words.en: To have no money; to be financially ruined.

words.tr: phrase. 赤贫；一贫如洗
words.ex: He lives in abject poverty with no food or shelter.
words.ex_cn: 他生活在极度贫困中，没有食物和住所。
words.en: Abject poverty refers to the most severe and degraded level of poverty, where individuals lack the means to meet the most basic needs for survival.

words.tr: phrase. 生活成本；生活费用
words.ex: The cost of living is high in big cities.
words.ex_cn: 大城市的物价很高。
words.en: The cost of living refers to the amount of money needed to sustain a certain standard of living by affording basic expenses such as housing, food, taxes, and healthcare.

words.tr: phrase. 生活标准；生活水平
words.ex: His job improved the standard of living for his family.
words.ex_cn: 他的工作改善了家人的生活水平。
words.en: The level of wealth, comfort, material goods, and necessities available to a certain socioeconomic class or a certain geographic area.

words.tr: n. 收据；收条；
words.ex: He kept the receipt for his new shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他保留了新鞋的收据。
words.en: A receipt is a piece of paper that you get from someone as proof that they have received money or goods from you.

words.tr: phrase. 让某人花费一大笔钱；代价高昂
words.ex: The new car cost him a fortune.
words.ex_cn: 这辆新车花了他的巨额钱款。
words.en: To require someone to spend a large amount of money.

words.w: the bill for sth. is exorbitant
words.tr: phrase. 某物的账单昂贵得离谱的
words.uk: ðə bɪl fɔː ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɪz ɪɡˈzɒbɪtənt
words.us: ðə bɪl fɔː ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɪz ɪɡˈzɑːbɪtənt

words.tr: phrase. 价格高得令人望而却步的； prohibitively high prices 指价格高到无法承受；a prohibitive price 指高得让人不敢购买的价格
words.uk: prəˈɪbɪtɪvli haɪ praɪsɪz ə prəˈhɪbɪtɪv praɪs
words.us: prəˈhɪbɪtɪvli haɪ praɪsɪz ə prəˈhɪbɪtɪv praɪs
words.ex: The prohibitively high prices stopped me from buying the phone.
words.ex_cn: 价格高得令人望而却步，我没能买下这部手机。

words.tr: phrase. 免费的；不收费的
words.ex: The museum is free of charge on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆在星期天免费开放。
words.en: Provided without payment; costing nothing.

words.tr: phrase. 发大财；赚大钱；积累巨额财富
words.ex: He made a fortune by selling his small business.
words.ex_cn: 他通过卖掉自己的小生意发了一笔财。
words.en: To earn a large amount of money, often in a short period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 富有者与贫困者；有产者与无产者（常用于描述社会经济地位的两极分化）
words.ex: The gap between the haves and have-nots is widening in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 在许多国家，富人和穷人之间的差距正在扩大。
words.en: The phrase 'the haves and have-nots' refers to the division between those who possess wealth and resources (the haves) and those who do not (the have-nots). It highlights economic and social inequality.

words.tr: phrase. 积累财富；积聚财产
words.ex: People work hard to accumulate wealth over time.
words.ex_cn: 人们努力工作以随时间积累财富。
words.en: Gradually increase the amount of money and assets one possesses over time through saving, investment, or other means.

words.tr: phrase. 地位象征；表示社会地位的标志
words.ex: He bought a luxury car as a status symbol.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一辆豪华车作为身份的象征。
words.en: An object or possession that signifies wealth or high social standing.

words.tr: phrase. 奢侈品；高档消费品
words.ex: She bought luxury goods for her birthday.
words.ex_cn: 她为自己生日买了奢侈品。
words.en: Luxury goods are products that are not essential but are highly desired and associated with wealthy or affluent lifestyles. They are often of high quality and price.

words.tr: n. 商品；货物；日用品；
words.ex: Wheat is a basic commodity in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 小麦在许多国家是一种基本商品。
words.en: A commodity is something that is bought and sold.

words.tr: phrase. 贪得的；渴望获得的；有占有欲的
words.ex: He is acquisitive and always wants more things.
words.ex_cn: 他很贪得无厌，总是想要更多东西。
words.en: Wanting to have and keep a lot of possessions, especially in a way that seems selfish or greedy.

words.tr: n. 虚荣；自负
words.ex: He bought a new mirror because of his vanity.
words.ex_cn: 他因为虚荣心买了一面新镜子。
words.en: The quality of being vain; excessive pride in or admiration of one's own appearance or achievements.

words.tr: phrase. 节衣缩食；勒紧裤带（指削减开支、过更节俭的生活）
words.ex: When money is short, we have to tighten our belt.
words.ex_cn: 当钱不够时，我们必须勒紧裤腰带。
words.en: To reduce one's spending; to be more economical.

words.tr: phrase. 用极少的钱做某事；以极低的预算完成某事
phrase. 无法承担；负担不起
words.ex: He cannot afford a new car.
words.ex_cn: 他买不起一辆新车。
words.en: To lack the financial means to purchase or do something.

words.tr: phrase. 超出某人的经济能力；花费超出负担能力
words.ex: That car is beyond his means.
words.ex_cn: 那辆车超出了他的经济能力。
words.en: To be more expensive than one can afford.

words.tr: phrase. 非常便宜的；廉价得惊人
words.ex: This phone is dirt-cheap at the market.
words.ex_cn: 这手机在市场上便宜得要命。
words.en: extremely inexpensive

words.tr: phrase. 便宜货；交易；契约
words.ex: This shirt is a bargain at $5.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫五美元，太值了。
words.en: An agreement to buy or sell something at a fixed price.

words.tr: phrase. 被低估的；未被充分重视的
words.ex: His talent is undervalued by his boss.
words.ex_cn: 他的才华被老板低估了。
words.en: To be valued at less than something is truly worth.

words.tr: 短语动词. 去疯狂购物；进行一次购物狂欢
words.ex: She went on a shopping spree last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 她上个周末疯狂购物了一番。
words.en: To go on a shopping spree means to shop excessively and often impulsively, typically in a short period of time.

words.tr: n. 橱窗购物
words.ex: He enjoys window-shopping on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末逛橱窗。
words.en: The activity of looking at goods displayed in shop windows, especially without intending to buy anything.

words.tr: phrase. 跟上...的进展；记录
words.ex: I keep track of my expenses every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天记录我的开支。
words.en: To keep track of something means to stay informed about it or to record it, especially in order to notice any changes or developments.

words.tr: phrase. 失去对……的线索；与……失去联系；忘记；未能跟踪
words.ex: He lost track of time while playing games.
words.ex_cn: 他玩游戏时忘记了时间。
words.en: To fail to keep oneself informed about someone or something; to lose contact with someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 缺乏；不足；达不到（目标）；不符合
words.ex: They fall short of their goal every time.
words.ex_cn: 他们每次都没能达到目标。
words.en: To fail to reach a desired standard, level, or amount.

words.tr: phrase. 未能达到某人的期望
words.ex: He fell short of his parents' expectations.
words.ex_cn: 他未能达到父母的期望。

words.tr: 短语动词. 对这个价格犹豫不决；因这个价格而退缩
words.ex: He balks at this price because it is too high for him.
words.ex_cn: 他嫌这个价格太高，所以犹豫了。
words.en: To hesitate or be unwilling to accept or agree to a price.

words.tr: v. 觊觎；垂涎；贪图
words.ex: He covets his neighbor's car.
words.ex_cn: 他垂涎邻居的车。
words.en: If you covet something, you have a very strong desire to possess it, especially something that belongs to someone else.

words.tr: v. 羡慕；妒忌；
words.ex: I envy her for her happy family.
words.ex_cn: 我羡慕她幸福的家庭。
words.en: Envy is the feeling you have when you wish you could have the same thing or quality that someone else has.

words.tr: phrase. 财务支持；经济援助
words.ex: He got financial support from his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他从父母那里获得了经济支持。
words.en: Financial support refers to the provision of money or resources to help someone or something, especially in the context of education, business, or personal needs.

words.tr: phrase. 财政援助；经济资助
words.ex: He got financial aid to pay for his books.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了经济援助来支付书本费用。
words.en: Financial aid refers to funding intended to help students pay education expenses including tuition, books, and living costs for study at post-secondary educational institutions.

words.tr: phrase. （在物质或社会地位上）与邻居或他人攀比；赶时髦
words.ex: They buy a new car every year just to keep up with the Joneses.
words.ex_cn: 他们每年买一辆新车，只是为了和邻居攀比。
words.en: To strive to match or surpass one's neighbors or peers in terms of material possessions or social status.

words.tr: phrase. 乐器
words.ex: He plays musical instruments every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上演奏乐器。
words.en: Musical instruments are devices created or adapted to make musical sounds. In principle, any object that produces sound can be considered a musical instrument—it is through purpose that the object becomes a musical instrument.

words.tr: phrase. 有音乐天赋的；对音乐感兴趣的；在音乐方面有倾向的
words.ex: He is musically-inclined and plays the guitar well.
words.ex_cn: 他有音乐天赋，吉他弹得很好。
words.en: Having a natural ability or interest in music.

words.tr: phrase. 跑调；五音不全
words.ex: He cannot carry a tune when he sings.
words.ex_cn: 他唱歌时总是跑调。

words.tr: phrase. 音盲的；对音调不敏感的；无法辨别音高的
phrase. 露天音乐会；户外音乐会
words.ex: They enjoyed an open-air concert under the stars.
words.ex_cn: 他们在星空下享受了一场露天音乐会。
words.en: An open-air concert is a musical performance that takes place outdoors, often in a park or other natural setting.

words.tr: phrase. 交响乐团
words.ex: The symphony orchestra played loudly at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 交响乐团在音乐会上大声演奏。
words.en: A symphony orchestra is a large orchestra that plays classical music and is led by a conductor.

words.tr: phrase. 刺耳的音乐；响亮刺耳的乐声
words.ex: The blaring music woke up the baby.
words.ex_cn: 刺耳的音乐把婴儿吵醒了。
words.en: Loud, harsh, and unpleasantly loud music.

words.tr: phrase. 充满，洋溢（常用于情感或光线等抽象事物）
words.ex: The room was suffused with sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 房间里充满了阳光。
words.en: If something such as a book, film, or piece of music is suffused with a particular quality, that quality spreads all through it and is very noticeable in it.

words.tr: phrase. 充满…的；深受…影响的；浸透在…中的
words.ex: He is steeped in classical music.
words.ex_cn: 他深受古典音乐的熏陶。
words.en: To be deeply immersed in or saturated with a particular quality or influence.

words.tr: phrase. 原声音乐；不使用电子扩音或电子乐器的音乐，通常指用原声乐器演奏的音乐
words.ex: He plays acoustic music on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末演奏原声音乐。
words.en: Music that is produced by acoustic instruments without electronic amplification.

words.tr: phrase. 流行音乐排行榜
words.ex: The song reached number one on the pop chart.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌登上了流行音乐排行榜榜首。
words.en: A list of the most popular songs or albums at a particular time, typically based on sales or radio play.

words.tr: phrase. 最畅销的专辑
words.ex: Thriller is the best-selling album of all time.
words.ex_cn: 《Thriller》是有史以来最畅销的专辑。

words.w: just another flash in the pan
words.tr: phrase. 只是又一个昙花一现的事物；不过是短暂的辉煌
words.uk: dʒʌst əˈnʌðə ˈflæʃ ɪn ðə ˈpæn
words.us: dʒʌst əˈnʌðə ˈflæʃ ɪn ðə ˈpæn
words.ex: That new app was just another flash in the pan.
words.ex_cn: 那个新应用只是又一个昙花一现的事物。

words.tr: phrase. 大获成功的事物；极受欢迎的人或作品
words.ex: The movie was a smash hit, earning millions in its first weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影大获成功，首周末就赚了数百万美元。
words.en: A thing, especially a film, song, or show, that is very popular and successful.

words.tr: 短语动词. 具备成功所需的品质或能力；有本事，有能耐
words.ex: He works hard every day because he wants to have what it takes to be a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力学习，因为他想具备成为一名医生所需要的素质。
words.en: To have the necessary qualities or abilities to succeed in a particular endeavor.

words.tr: phrase. 处理好；处置掉；除掉
words.ex: Please dispose of the trash before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 请在离开前处理好垃圾。
words.en: To get rid of something that you no longer want or need.

words.tr: adj. 一次性的；
words.ex: He used a disposable cup for his coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一次性杯子喝咖啡。
words.en: Something that is disposable is intended to be thrown away after use.

words.tr: phrase. 恶性循环；无法摆脱的困境
words.ex: He keeps spending money and getting deeper in debt — it's a vicious circle.
words.ex_cn: 他不断花钱，债务越来越重——这就是一个恶性循环。
words.en: A situation in which one problem causes another problem, which then makes the first problem worse.

words.tr: phrase. 不良影响；副作用
words.ex: The medicine has an adverse effect on his stomach.
words.ex_cn: 这种药对他的胃有不良影响。
words.en: An adverse effect is an unwanted side effect or a negative outcome resulting from a particular action or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 不可生物降解的材料；无法被微生物分解的材料
words.ex: Plastic is a non-biodegradable material.
words.ex_cn: 塑料是一种不可生物降解的材料。
words.en: A substance that does not break down naturally in the environment.

words.tr: phrase. 可重复使用且可回收的材料
words.ex: The bottle is made of reusable recyclable material.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子是由可重复使用且可回收的材料制成的。

words.tr: phrase. 污染减少；降低污染；减排
words.ex: The city works on pollution reduction to make air cleaner.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市致力于减少污染以让空气更清洁。
words.en: Actions taken to decrease the amount of harmful substances in the environment.

words.tr: phrase. 浪费地使用某物；挥霍某物
words.ex: He uses water wastefully by leaving the tap running.
words.ex_cn: 他让水龙头一直开着，浪费了水。
words.en: To use something in a way that is not careful or efficient, leading to unnecessary consumption or loss.

words.tr: phrase. 水力发电
words.ex: The dam produces hydro-electric power for the town.
words.ex_cn: 大坝为这个城镇提供水力发电。
words.en: Hydro-electric power is electricity that is produced by the force of fast-flowing water, especially from rivers.

words.tr: n. 生物圈；生物界；
words.ex: The biosphere includes all living things on Earth.
words.ex_cn: 生物圈包括地球上所有生物。
words.en: The biosphere is the part of the Earth's surface and atmosphere in which plants and animals can live.

words.tr: phrase. 濒危物种
words.ex: Pandas are endangered species.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫是濒危物种。
words.en: An endangered species is a type of organism that is at risk of extinction due to a rapid decrease in its population or a loss of its critical habitat.

words.tr: n. 平衡；均衡；平静；
words.ex: The two kids stayed in equilibrium on the seesaw.
words.ex_cn: 两个孩子在跷跷板上保持了平衡。
words.en: A state in which opposing forces or influences are balanced.

words.tr: phrase. 臭氧层
words.ex: The ozone layer protects us from the sun's harmful rays.
words.ex_cn: 臭氧层保护我们免受太阳有害射线的伤害。
words.en: The ozone layer is a layer in the Earth's stratosphere that contains a high concentration of ozone (O3) molecules, which absorb most of the Sun's harmful ultraviolet radiation.

words.tr: phrase. 大气；气氛；空气；环境氛围
words.ex: The atmosphere at the concert was electric.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会的气氛非常热烈。
words.en: The air or climate in a place; the mood or feeling of an event or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 永久性受损的；无法修复的
words.ex: The painting was permanently damaged by the flood.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画因洪水而永久损坏。
words.en: To be in a state of irreversible harm or destruction.

words.tr: phrase. 全球变暖
words.ex: Global warming is making the Earth hotter.
words.ex_cn: 全球变暖正在让地球变得更热。
words.en: Global warming refers to the long-term increase in Earth's average surface temperature due to human activities, primarily fossil fuel burning, which increases heat-trapping greenhouse gas levels in Earth's atmosphere.

words.tr: phrase. 温室效应
words.ex: The greenhouse effect makes the Earth warmer.
words.ex_cn: 温室效应使地球变暖。
words.en: The greenhouse effect is the process by which radiation from a planet's atmosphere warms the planet's surface to a temperature above what it would be without its atmosphere.

words.tr: phrase. 汽车排放物；汽车尾气
words.ex: The car emissions are very high.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的尾气排放很高。
words.en: The gases and particles that are released into the air by cars as a result of the combustion of fuel.

words.tr: phrase. 废气；尾气（指发动机排出的有害气体）
words.ex: The car emitted harmful exhaust fumes.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车排放出有害的废气。
words.en: Exhaust fumes are the gases and smoke that come out of a vehicle's engine when it is running.

words.tr: phrase. 呼吸系统疾病
words.ex: He has respiratory diseases because he smokes.
words.ex_cn: 他因为吸烟而患有呼吸系统疾病。
words.en: Illnesses affecting the lungs and breathing system.

words.tr: phrase. 土壤侵蚀
words.ex: Heavy rain causes soil erosion on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 大雨导致山坡上的土壤侵蚀。
words.en: The process by which the surface of the earth is worn away by the action of water, glaciers, winds, waves, etc.

words.tr: n. 沙漠化；荒漠化；
words.ex: Overgrazing causes desertification in dry areas.
words.ex_cn: 过度放牧会导致干旱地区的沙漠化。
words.en: Desertification is the process by which fertile land becomes desert, typically as a result of drought, deforestation, or inappropriate agriculture.

words.tr: n. 地下水
words.ex: The well draws water from groundwater.
words.ex_cn: 这口井从地下水取水。
words.en: Water that is located beneath the earth's surface in soil pore spaces and in the fractures of rock formations.

words.tr: phrase. 海水淡化；将海水中的盐分去除以生产淡水的过程
words.ex: The town uses seawater desalination to get clean drinking water.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇使用海水淡化来获得干净的饮用水。
words.en: The process of removing salt from seawater to make it suitable for drinking or irrigation.

words.tr: phrase. 化学肥料；通过化学方法制成的用于促进植物生长的肥料
words.ex: The farmer uses chemical fertiliser to grow crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用化学肥料来种植庄稼。
words.en: A chemical fertiliser is a substance added to soil to improve its fertility and promote plant growth.

words.tr: n. 杀虫剂；除害药物；
words.ex: Farmers use pesticide to kill insects on crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用杀虫剂来杀死作物上的昆虫。
words.en: A pesticide is a chemical substance used to kill pests, especially insects, that damage crops or are harmful to human health.

words.tr: phrase. 酸雨
words.ex: Acid rain kills trees and fish.
words.ex_cn: 酸雨杀死树木和鱼类。
words.en: Rainfall made sufficiently acidic by atmospheric pollution that it causes environmental harm, typically to forests and lakes. The main cause is the industrial burning of coal and other fossil fuels, the waste gases from which contain sulfur and nitrogen oxides which combine with atmospheric water to form acids.

words.tr: verb phrase. 充满…的；饱含…的；被…浸透的
words.ex: The paper is saturated with too many details.
words.ex_cn: 这篇论文充满了太多细节。
words.en: To be filled with something so that no more can be added; to be thoroughly soaked or imbued with a substance or quality.

words.tr: phrase. 破坏生态系统；扰乱生态平衡
words.ex: Pollution can upset the ecosystem.
words.ex_cn: 污染会破坏生态系统。
words.en: To disrupt or disturb the natural equilibrium of an environment.

words.tr: phrase. 恢复生态平衡；重新调整生态平衡
words.ex: Efforts to redress the ecological balance have been ongoing for years.
words.ex_cn: 多年来一直在努力恢复生态平衡。
words.en: To correct or restore a damaged ecological system to a healthy state.

words.tr: phrase. 工业废料；工业废弃物
words.ex: Factories dump industrial wastes into the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂把工业废料倒入河里。
words.en: By-products from manufacturing processes that pollute the environment.

words.tr:
v. 放电；放出；
n. 排放；
words.ex: The battery will discharge if left unused for a long time.
words.ex_cn: 如果长时间不使用，电池会放电。
words.en: If someone is discharged from a hospital, prison, or the armed forces, they are officially allowed to leave, or told that they must leave. If something is discharged from inside a place, it comes out.

words.tr: phrase. 碳达峰；指二氧化碳排放量达到历史最高值后开始下降的转折点
words.ex: China aims to reach carbon peaking by 2030.
words.ex_cn: 中国目标在2030年前实现碳达峰。

words.tr: 在费用
words.ex: He bought a new car at the expense of his savings.
words.ex_cn: 他用储蓄的钱买了辆新车。

words.tr: phrase. 自然灾害（如地震、洪水、飓风等）
words.ex: The earthquake was a natural disaster.
words.ex_cn: 这场地震是一场自然灾害。
words.en: A natural disaster is a major adverse event resulting from natural processes of the Earth; examples include floods, hurricanes, tornadoes, volcanic eruptions, earthquakes, tsunamis, and other geologic processes.

words.tr: phrase. 生态退化
words.ex: The rapid development has led to severe ecological degradation.
words.ex_cn: 快速的开发导致了严重的生态退化。
words.en: The deterioration of ecosystems and the natural environment, often due to human activity.

words.tr: phrase. 石油短缺；油荒
words.ex: The country faces an oil shortage this winter.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家今年冬天面临石油短缺。
words.en: A situation in which there is not enough oil available to meet the demand.

words.tr: 短语动词. 供应不足；缺乏
words.ex: Water is in short supply during the drought.
words.ex_cn: 干旱期间，水严重短缺。
words.en: If something is in short supply, there is not enough of it available.

words.tr: phrase. 矿物燃料
words.ex: Cars use fossil fuel to move.
words.ex_cn: 汽车使用化石燃料行驶。
words.en: Fossil fuels are fuels formed by natural processes such as anaerobic decomposition of buried dead organisms, containing energy originating in ancient photosynthesis.

words.tr: phrase. 太阳能
words.ex: The house uses solar energy to power the lights.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子利用太阳能来供电。
words.en: Solar energy is energy that comes from the sun and is captured using various technologies, primarily solar panels, to generate electricity or heat.

words.tr: phrase. 风能
words.ex: The farm uses wind energy to make electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场利用风能发电。
words.en: Wind energy is power obtained by harnessing the energy of the wind.

words.tr: phrase. 噪音污染
words.ex: The city has too much noise pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市有太多的噪音污染。
words.en: Noise pollution refers to harmful or annoying levels of noise, as from airplanes, industry, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 光污染（指人造光源对夜空环境造成的过度或不当照明，影响天文观测、生态系统和人类健康）
words.ex: The stars are hard to see because of light pollution.
words.ex_cn: 由于光污染，星星很难看到。
words.en: Excessive or misdirected artificial light that obscures the night sky.

words.tr: phrase. 让某人感到烦躁；使某人恼火
words.ex: The loud music next door gets on my nerves.
words.ex_cn: 隔壁的吵闹音乐让我很烦。
words.en: To irritate or annoy someone.

words.tr: phrase. 成为麻烦；惹人讨厌
phrase. 动物权利；指动物应享有免受虐待和剥削的基本权利
words.ex: People fight for animal rights to stop cruelty.
words.ex_cn: 人们为动物权利而斗争，以阻止虐待。
words.en: The idea that animals should have moral and legal rights similar to those of humans.

words.tr: phrase. 动物剥削；对动物的利用或虐待，通常为了人类利益
words.ex: People are fighting against animal exploitation.
words.ex_cn: 人们正在反对对动物的剥削。
words.en: The use of animals for human benefit, often in ways that cause suffering.

words.tr: phrase. 食物链
words.ex: The lion is at the top of the food chain.
words.ex_cn: 狮子处于食物链的顶端。
words.en: A food chain is a series of organisms each dependent on the next as a source of food.

words.tr: phrase. 猛禽；食肉鸟
words.ex: The birds of prey flew high above the forest.
words.ex_cn: 猛禽在森林上方高高飞翔。
words.en: Birds of prey are birds that hunt and feed on other animals. They are characterized by their keen eyesight, powerful talons, and beaks designed for tearing flesh.

words.tr: phrase. 制药公司；药品生产企业
words.ex: He works for a pharmaceutical company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家制药公司工作。
words.en: A business that researches, develops, and sells medicines and health products.

words.tr: phrase. 动物实验；动物测试（指在科学研究或产品测试中使用动物进行实验的过程）
words.ex: Some companies still use animal testing for new medicines.
words.ex_cn: 一些公司仍然用动物实验来测试新药物。
words.en: The use of animals in experiments and research to determine the safety and efficacy of products and medical treatments.

words.tr: n. 栖息地；居留地；产地；
words.ex: The panda's habitat is in the mountains of China.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫的栖息地在中国的山区。
words.en: The natural environment in which a species or group of species lives.

words.tr: n. 野生生物；
words.ex: The park protects many kinds of wildlife.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园保护许多种类的野生生物。
words.en: Wildlife refers to animals and plants that live and grow in natural conditions.

words.tr: v. 创办优秀公司；使公司变得出色
words.ex: He wants to make good companies that help people.
words.ex_cn: 他想创办帮助人们的优秀公司。

words.tr:
n. 欲望；渴望；
v. 渴望；期望；
words.ex: He felt a strong desire to travel the world.
words.ex_cn: 他有一种强烈的环游世界的欲望。
words.en: A strong feeling of wanting to have something or wishing for something to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 流浪动物；走失的动物
words.ex: Stray animals are often found in urban areas.
words.ex_cn: 流浪动物经常出现在城市地区。
words.en: Stray animals are domestic animals that are wandering at large and are not under the control of their owner.

words.tr: 状态良好：指物品或人的状态良好，没有损坏或疾病。
words.ex: The car is in good condition.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车状况良好。
words.en: If something is in good condition, it is in a good state or quality, especially because it has been well looked after.

words.tr: phrase. 崭新的；完好无损的；处于完美状态的
words.ex: The car is in mint condition, as if it just came out of the factory.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车崭新如初，就像刚从工厂出来一样。
words.en: In mint condition means that something is in perfect condition, as if it were new.

words.w: be subjected to wear and tear
words.tr: phrase. 遭受磨损；经历损耗（指物体因长期使用而逐渐损坏）
words.uk: biː səbˈdʒɛktɪd tʊ wɪə ənd tɛə
words.us: bi səbˈdʒɛktɪd tu wɪr ənd tɛr
words.ex: The machinery is subjected to wear and tear over time.
words.ex_cn: 随着时间的推移，机器会遭受磨损和撕裂。
words.en: To be damaged or worn out through regular use over time.

words.tr:
v. 提升；提高；改进；
n. 增加；改进；
words.ex: He upgraded his phone to get better performance.
words.ex_cn: 他升级了手机以获得更好的性能。
words.en: To upgrade means to improve the quality or usefulness of something, or to raise it to a higher standard. It can also refer to the process of improving or raising something.

words.tr: phrase. 无多余装饰的；朴实无华的；只提供基本服务的
words.ex: The airline offers no frills flights to save money.
words.ex_cn: 这家航空公司提供无附加服务的航班以节省费用。
words.en: No frills refers to something that is basic and without any unnecessary extras or decorations, often used to describe services or products that are simple and functional.

words.tr: phrase. 附加的花哨功能；额外的装饰性特性（通常指并非必需但能增加吸引力的功能）
words.ex: The phone works fine, but it has too many bells and whistles.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机功能正常，但太多花里胡哨的东西了。
words.en: Additional features or enhancements that are not essential but add to the attractiveness or functionality of something.

words.tr: 短语。电池没电了；电池耗尽了
words.ex: The battery has run down, so the phone won't turn on.
words.ex_cn: 电池没电了，所以手机开不了机。
words.en: The battery has lost all its power and can no longer function.

words.tr:
n. 制造；
v. （用机器大量）制造；虚构；捏造；
words.ex: The manufacture of cars needs many workers.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的制造需要很多工人。
words.en: To manufacture something means to make it in a factory, usually in large quantities.

words.tr: n. 退款；
words.ex: I asked for a refund after the product broke.
words.ex_cn: 产品坏了之后，我要求退款。
words.en: A refund is a sum of money that is returned to you, for example because you have paid too much or because you have returned goods to a shop.

words.tr: adj. 粗笨的；笨重的
words.ex: The old computer is clunky and slow.
words.ex_cn: 这台旧电脑笨重又缓慢。
words.en: If you describe something as clunky, you mean that it is heavy, awkward, and not efficient or elegant.

words.tr: adj. 复杂而低效的；
words.ex: The old system is cumbersome and slow.
words.ex_cn: 这个旧系统复杂而低效。
words.en: Something that is cumbersome is large and heavy and therefore difficult to carry, wear, or handle.

words.tr: adj. 方便的；
words.ex: A pocket calculator is handy for math problems.
words.ex_cn: 便携式计算器对于数学问题很方便。
words.en: If something is handy, it is useful and easy to use or to reach.

words.tr: phrase. 促进……的发展；使……的发展更容易
words.ex: The new program helps to facilitate the development of children's skills.
words.ex_cn: 这个新项目有助于促进儿童技能的发展。
words.en: To make a process or development easier or smoother.

words.tr: v. 抑制；
words.ex: The medicine helps inhibit pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物有助于抑制疼痛。
words.en: If something inhibits an event or process, it prevents it or slows it down.

words.tr: v. 伴随；
words.ex: The music accompanies the dance.
words.ex_cn: 音乐伴随舞蹈。
words.en: To go somewhere with someone as a companion or escort; to play a musical accompaniment for.

words.tr: phrase. 落后；滞后；跟不上
words.ex: Tom often lags behind in class because he doesn't study.
words.ex_cn: 汤姆因为不学习，经常在课堂上落后。
words.en: To fail to keep up with others or to fall behind in progress, development, or achievement.

words.tr: phrase. 作出改进；取得进步
words.ex: Regular training sessions help employees make improvements in their performance.
words.ex_cn: 定期的培训课程有助于员工在表现上做出改进。
words.en: To make something better than it was before.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 勇往直前；努力前进；大力推进
words.ex: They forge ahead despite the difficulties.
words.ex_cn: 尽管困难，他们仍然继续前进。
words.en: To make progress or move forward steadily, especially in the face of difficulties.

words.tr: phrase. 已经改进到完全认不出来的地步
words.ex: The city has have improved beyond all recognition since the new roads were built.
words.ex_cn: 自从新路建成后，这座城市已经改进到完全认不出来的地步。

words.w: be an instrument of social change
words.tr: 短语. 成为社会变革的工具或推动者
words.uk: biː æn ˈɪnstrəmənt ɒv ˈsəʊʃl tʃeɪndʒ
words.us: biː æn ˈɪnstrəmənt əv ˈsoʊʃl tʃeɪndʒ
words.ex: Education can be an instrument of social change, empowering individuals to challenge inequalities.
words.ex_cn: 教育可以成为社会变革的工具，赋予个人挑战不平等的能力。
words.en: To act as a means or tool for bringing about changes in society.

words.tr: 使某事陷入停滞；使完全停止
words.ex: The traffic accident brought the whole city to a standstill.
words.ex_cn: 交通事故使整个城市陷入了停顿。
words.en: To cause something to stop moving or progressing completely.

words.tr: adj. 不变的；未改变的；
words.ex: The rules remained unchanged.
words.ex_cn: 这些规则没有改变。
words.en: If something is unchanged, it has stayed the same for a particular period of time.

words.w: there has been a shift in
words.tr: 短语。表示‘在……方面已经发生了转变或变化’
words.us: ðer hæz bɪn ə ʃɪft ɪn
words.ex: There has been a shift in how students learn math.
words.ex_cn: 学生学习数学的方式已经发生了变化。
words.en: A change in focus, direction, or attitude has occurred.

words.tr: phrase. 转移重点；改变强调点
words.ex: They shift emphasis from grades to learning.
words.ex_cn: 他们把重点从成绩转移到学习上。
words.en: To change the focus or priority from one area to another.

words.w: the economic swings of boom and slump
words.tr: phrase. 经济的繁荣与萧条周期性波动
words.uk: ðiː ˌiːkəˈnɒmɪk swɪŋz əv buːm ənd slʌmp
words.us: ði ˌiːkəˈnɑːmɪk swɪŋz əv buːm ənd slʌmp
words.ex: The economic swings of boom and slump are characteristic of a market economy.
words.ex_cn: 经济繁荣与萧条的波动是市场经济的特征。
words.en: The periods of economic growth and decline that alternate in a cycle.

words.tr: phrase. 经济衰退；指一个国家的经济活动显著下降，通常表现为GDP连续两个季度负增长
words.ex: The country faced an economic recession last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这个国家经历了经济衰退。
words.en: A period of temporary economic decline during which trade and industrial activity are reduced, generally identified by a fall in GDP in two successive quarters.

words.tr: 短语动词. 产生深远影响的；具有广泛而长期后果的
words.ex: The new policy will have far-reaching effects on the economy.
words.ex_cn: 新政策将对经济产生深远的影响。
words.en: To have significant and widespread consequences.

words.tr: phrase. 连锁反应；涟漪效应（指一个事件引发一系列后续影响）
words.ex: The decision to close the factory had a ripple effect on the local economy.
words.ex_cn: 关闭工厂的决定对当地经济产生了连锁反应。
words.en: A situation in which one event causes a series of other events to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 知识经济；以知识和信息为主要生产要素的经济形态
words.ex: The country is building a knowledge economy through education and technology.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家通过教育和技术建设知识经济。
words.en: An economy based on the production, distribution, and use of knowledge and information.

words.tr: phrase. 休闲产业（包括旅游、娱乐、体育、餐饮等为人们提供休闲服务的行业）
words.ex: The leisure industry has seen significant growth in recent years.
words.ex_cn: 近年来，娱乐产业经历了显著的增长。
words.en: The leisure industry refers to the sector of the economy that is involved in the provision of recreational and entertainment services, including tourism, hospitality, sports, and leisure activities.

words.tr: phrase. 持续不断的城市化
words.ex: Relentless urbanisation is forcing many farmers to move to cities.
words.ex_cn: 持续不断的城市化正迫使许多农民搬到城市。
words.en: The continuous and often uncontrolled growth and expansion of cities.

words.tr: phrase. ……的涌入；……的流入（常指人、物或资金等大量进入某地）
words.ex: The influx of tourists increased traffic in the city.
words.ex_cn: 游客的涌入增加了城市的交通压力。
words.en: A large number of people or things arriving at a place.

words.tr: phrase. 中央商务区；城市中商业和办公活动集中的区域
words.ex: The shops are in the central business district.
words.ex_cn: 商店位于中央商务区。
words.en: The primary commercial and financial heart of a city or town.

words.tr: phrase. 行人区
words.ex: Cars are not allowed in the pedestrian zone.
words.ex_cn: 汽车不允许进入步行区。
words.en: A pedestrian zone is a part of a city or town reserved for pedestrian-only use and in which most or all automobile traffic is prohibited.

words.tr: phrase. 嘈杂且烟雾弥漫的；又吵又雾霾的
words.ex: The city is noisy and smoggy in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市早上又吵又多烟雾。
words.en: Noisy and smoggy: Characterised by excessive sound pollution and thick, polluted air, often describing an unpleasant urban environment.

words.tr: v. 被制作；被制成
words.en: To be produced, constructed, or formed from materials or components.

words.tr: phrase. 被……取代；被……挤走；因……而流离失所
words.ex: The old machine was displaced by a newer one.
words.ex_cn: 旧机器被一台新的机器取代了。
words.en: To take the place of something or someone else.

words.tr: n. 出生率
words.ex: The birthrate in this country is falling.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的出生率正在下降。
words.en: The number of live births per thousand of population per year.

words.tr: phrase. 人口老龄化
words.ex: The country is facing population ageing because more people are getting old.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正面临人口老龄化，因为越来越多的人变老了。
words.en: Population ageing refers to the increase in the median age of a population due to declining fertility rates and rising life expectancy.

words.tr: adj. 挤满的；过度拥挤的；
words.ex: The bus was overcrowded at rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段公交车挤满了人。
words.en: If a place is overcrowded, there are too many people or things in it.

words.tr: phrase. 人口密度
words.ex: The population density is high in big cities.
words.ex_cn: 大城市的人口密度很高。
words.en: Population density is a measurement of population per unit area or unit volume; it is a quantity of type number density.

words.tr: adj. 老式的；老派的；守旧的
words.ex: He wears an old-fashioned hat.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着一顶过时的帽子。
words.en: If you describe something as old-fashioned, you mean that it is no longer modern, current, or fashionable.

words.tr:
adj. 先锋的；前卫的
n. 先锋派；前卫
words.ex: The artist uses avant-garde styles in her paintings.
words.ex_cn: 这位艺术家在她的画作中使用前卫的风格。
words.en: Avant-garde is used to describe people or works that are experimental or innovative, particularly in the arts.

words.tr: phrase. , 眼下；现阶段
words.ex: At this stage, he is learning to read.
words.ex_cn: 在这个阶段，他正在学习阅读。
words.en: At a particular point or step in a process or series of events.

words.tr: phrase. 现在；目前
words.ex: At present, he is working as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 目前，他是一名老师。
words.en: At the present time; now.

words.tr: phrase. 在这一点上；目前；此时
words.ex: At this point, I want to stop.
words.ex_cn: 此时此刻，我想停下来。
words.en: At the particular time or moment being referred to.

words.tr: phrase. 一个关键的转折点或关键时刻
words.ex: The company is at a critical juncture in its development.
words.ex_cn: 公司正处于发展的关键时刻。
words.en: A critical point in time or a decisive stage in a process where important decisions or changes occur.

words.tr: phrase. 引入； ushered in 是 usher 的现在完成时，意为“ usher in”表示带来、开启（新时代、新阶段等）
words.ex: The internet have ushered in a new era of communication.
words.ex_cn: 互联网 ushered in 了一个通信的新时代。

words.tr: phrase. 成为一个里程碑；标志重要进展或事件
words.ex: Winning the race was a milestone for him.
words.ex_cn: 赢得比赛对他来说是一个里程碑。
words.en: To represent a significant event or achievement that marks progress or a new phase.

words.tr: phrase. 不再是必需品
phrase. 仍然是必需品；依然是必要之物
words.ex: Clean water remains a necessity for all people.
words.ex_cn: 干净的水对所有人来说仍然是必需的。
words.en: To continue to be something that is needed or essential.

words.tr: adj. 产生相反效果的；适得其反的；事与愿违的；
words.ex: Yelling at him is counterproductive.
words.ex_cn: 对他大喊大叫会产生相反的效果。
words.en: Something that is counterproductive achieves the opposite result from the one that you want to achieve.

words.tr: v. 未被蚀刻；未被刻印
phrase. 不是固定不变的；可以修改的；灵活的
phrase. 一个由来已久的问题；长期存在的难题
words.ex: Poverty is an age-old problem that continues to affect millions.
words.ex_cn: 贫困是一个持续影响数百万人的古老问题。
words.en: A problem that has existed for a very long time and continues to be relevant.

words.tr: phrase. 一个持久存在的问题；长期难以解决的难题
words.ex: Climate change is an enduring problem that affects every country.
words.ex_cn: 气候变化是一个影响每个国家的持久问题。
words.en: An enduring problem refers to a persistent issue that continues over a long period of time without being resolved.

words.tr: phrase. 给……带来问题；对……构成难题
words.ex: The new rule poses a problem for small businesses.
words.ex_cn: 新规定给小企业带来了问题。
words.en: To create a difficulty or issue for someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 对...构成威胁
words.ex: Pollution can pose a threat to our health.
words.ex_cn: 污染可能对我们的健康构成威胁。
words.en: To present a danger or risk to someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 繁荣的经济；蓬勃发展的经济
words.ex: The country has a thriving economy with low unemployment.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家有一个繁荣的经济，失业率很低。
words.en: An economy that is growing strongly, with high levels of business activity and prosperity.

words.tr: phrase. 经济不景气的；经济疲软的；经济迟滞的
words.ex: The sluggish economy made it hard for small businesses to survive.
words.ex_cn: 经济不景气使小企业难以生存。
words.en: An economic condition characterized by slow growth, low consumer spending, and reduced business activity.

words.tr: phrase. （某种特征、疾病或才能）在家族中遗传或普遍存在
words.ex: Musical talent seems to run in the family.
words.ex_cn: phrase. 音乐天赋似乎在家族中遗传。
words.en: phrase. If a characteristic runs in the family, many members of the family have it.

words.tr: phrase. 遗传的；由遗传决定的
phrase. 对某物的依恋；对某人的感情牵绊
words.ex: He has a strong attachment to his childhood home.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的童年故居有着深厚的感情。

words.tr: phrase. 与……疏远的；与……关系破裂的
words.ex: He is estranged from his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他和他哥哥疏远了。
words.en: To become distant or disconnected from someone, often due to disagreement or conflict.

words.tr: phrase. 空巢综合症（指子女离家后父母感到孤独或失落的心理状态）
words.ex: After her last child went to college, she experienced empty-nest syndrome.
words.ex_cn: 在她最后一个孩子上大学后，她经历了空巢综合症。
words.en: The sadness or loneliness felt by parents after their children have grown up and left home.

words.tr: phrase. 家庭关系；亲情
words.ex: Family bonds help people feel safe and loved.
words.ex_cn: 家庭纽带让人感到安全和被爱。
words.en: The emotional connections and relationships within a family that unite its members.

words.tr: phrase. 家庭破裂；家庭解体
words.ex: The family break-up made the children very sad.
words.ex_cn: 家庭破裂让孩子们非常难过。
words.en: The dissolution of a family unit, typically through separation, divorce, or death.

words.tr: phrase. 义务感；责任感
words.ex: He has the sense of obligation to help his family.
words.ex_cn: 他有帮助家人的责任感。
words.en: The feeling that one is morally or legally bound to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 履行某人的义务；完成应尽的责任
words.ex: He must fulfill his obligation to pay the debt.
words.ex_cn: 他必须履行偿还债务的义务。
words.en: To fulfill one's obligation means to do what one is required to do according to a law, agreement, or moral duty.

words.tr: n. 养家糊口的人
words.ex: He is the breadwinner in his family.
words.ex_cn: 他是家里的经济支柱。
words.en: A breadwinner is a person who earns money to support their family.

words.tr: phrase. 经济负担；财务压力
words.ex: The loan created a financial burden for her family.
words.ex_cn: 这笔贷款给她的家庭带来了经济负担。
words.en: A heavy load of financial responsibility or debt.

words.tr: phrase. 性别偏见；基于性别的歧视或成见
words.ex: He faced gender prejudice at work because he is a man in a female-dominated job.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作中因身为男性而在女性主导的职位上遭受性别偏见。
words.en: Bias or discrimination based on a person's sex, often disadvantaging one gender over another.

words.tr: phrase. 想当然认为···
words.ex: He takes his health for granted.
words.ex_cn: 他把健康视为理所当然。
words.en: If you take something for granted, you believe it to be true or accept it as normal or without questioning it.

words.tr: phrase. 对……心存感激的；感谢……的
words.ex_cn: 我感谢我的老师帮助了我。
words.en: To feel or show appreciation for kindness or benefits received.

words.tr: 谚语. 慈善始于家庭；照顾好自己人才能帮助他人
words.ex: She gives money to her neighbors before helping strangers, because charity begins at home.
words.ex_cn: 她在帮助陌生人之前先帮助邻居，因为慈善始于家庭。
words.en: A proverb meaning that one should prioritize caring for one's own family before helping others.

words.tr: phrase. 感到想家的；思乡的
words.ex: He feels homesick when he is away from his family.
words.ex_cn: 当他远离家人时，他会感到想家。
words.en: To feel homesick means to feel unhappy because you are away from home and missing your family, friends, and familiar surroundings.

words.tr: phrase. 拥有美好的回忆
words.ex: I have fond memories of playing with my grandparents in the park.
words.ex_cn: 我对我和祖父母在公园里玩耍有着美好的回忆。

words.w: leave a bad taste in one's mouth
words.tr: phrase. 留下不愉快的印象；让人感到厌恶或失望
words.uk: liːv ə bæd teɪst ɪn wʌnz maʊθ
words.us: liːv ə bæd teɪst ɪn wʌnz maʊθ
words.ex: The unfair rule left a bad taste in his mouth.
words.ex_cn: 这个不公平的规则让他感到很不舒服。
words.en: To leave a bad taste in one's mouth: To cause a lingering feeling of disgust, disappointment, or unpleasantness after an experience.

words.tr: phrase. 家务活；家庭杂务
words.ex: He does household chores every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上做家务。
words.en: Tasks such as cleaning, washing, and cooking that are done regularly to keep a house running smoothly.

words.tr: n. 家务事；家务劳动；
words.ex: He does the housework every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都做家务。
words.en: Housework refers to the work done in the house, such as cleaning, cooking, and washing, especially as a regular duty.

words.tr: n. 差事; errand的复数; 差使( errand的名词复数 )
words.ex: She had to run errands for her mother.
words.ex_cn: 她得为母亲跑腿。
words.en: Short, routine tasks or journeys, such as shopping or visiting a post office, that are necessary but not major.

words.tr: phrase. 爱与奉献；深情与忠诚
words.ex: She showed love and devotion to her family every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天都对家人表现出爱与奉献。
words.en: A strong feeling of deep affection and commitment towards someone or something.

words.tr:
v. 热爱；爱；
n. 爱；爱情；爱好的事物；
words.ex: I love playing football with my friends.
words.ex_cn: 我热爱和朋友们一起踢足球。
words.en: Love is a very strong feeling of affection towards someone that you are romantically or sexually attracted to.

words.tr: v. 尊重并珍爱
words.ex: She honours and cherishes her grandmother's memories.
words.ex_cn: 她敬重并珍视祖母的回忆。

words.w: absence makes the heart grow fonder
words.tr: 谚语. 小别胜新婚；分离使感情更深
words.uk: ˈæbsəns meɪks ðə hɑːt grəʊ fɒnə(r)
words.us: ˈæbsəns meɪks ðə hɑrt groʊ ˈfɑːnər
words.ex: He missed her so much while she was away; absence makes the heart grow fonder.
words.ex_cn: 她离开时他非常想念她；距离让爱更深。
words.en: A saying that suggests absence from a loved one can increase affection and longing.

words.tr: phrase. 掌上明珠；心爱的人或物
words.ex: Her little brother is the apple of her eye.
words.ex_cn: 她弟弟是她的心肝宝贝。
words.en: The phrase 'the apple of one's eye' refers to someone or something that is very precious or dear to a person.

words.tr: phrase. 提出；教育；养育；呕出
words.ex: He brought up an important point in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个重要的观点。
words.en: To mention a subject or start to talk about it; to care for a child until they are an adult, often giving them particular beliefs; to educate someone; to vomit.

words.tr: n. 抚养子女；育儿
words.ex: Parents learn child-rearing from their own parents.
words.ex_cn: 父母从自己的父母那里学习育儿。
words.en: The process of bringing up and educating children.

words.tr: phrase. 母性本能；母亲天生照顾和保护子女的本能
words.ex: Her maternal instinct made her protect the child.
words.ex_cn: 她的母性本能让她保护那个孩子。
words.en: A natural, instinctive tendency in women to care for and protect children, often associated with motherhood.

words.tr: phrase. 养育本能；关怀天性
words.ex: Mother birds show a nurturing instinct to feed their young.
words.ex_cn: 母鸟有喂养幼鸟的天性。
words.en: An innate tendency to care for and protect others.

words.tr: adj. 离婚的； v. “divorce”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is a divorced father with two children.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有兩個孩子的離婚父親。
words.en: If someone is divorced, they are no longer married because their marriage has been legally ended.

words.tr: adj. 已婚的； v. 结婚；“marry”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: They are married and have two children.
words.ex_cn: 他们已婚，有两个孩子。
words.en: Having a husband or wife; united in matrimony.

words.tr: phrase. 为...铺平道路；为...做好准备
words.ex: New technology can pave the way for better education.
words.ex_cn: 新技术可以为更好的教育铺平道路。
words.en: To make it easier for something to happen or for someone to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 为…奠定基础；为…做准备
words.ex: He laid the groundwork for the new project last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月为这个新项目打下了基础。
words.en: To prepare the necessary conditions or foundation for something to develop or succeed.

words.tr: phrase. 绊脚石；障碍物；阻碍进展的事物
words.ex: Lack of practice is a stumbling block for many students.
words.ex_cn: 缺乏练习是许多学生的障碍。
words.en: A stumbling block is a problem or difficulty that prevents you from achieving something.

words.tr: phrase. 预防措施
words.ex: Washing hands is a preventative measure against colds.
words.ex_cn: 洗手是预防感冒的措施。
words.en: Actions taken to prevent something undesirable, such as disease or accidents, from happening.

words.tr: v. 采取预防措施以防范
words.ex: Wear a mask to take precautions against the virus.
words.ex_cn: 戴口罩以预防病毒。

words.tr: v. 确保；保证；担保；
words.ex: Please ensure the door is locked.
words.ex_cn: 请确保门锁好了。
words.en: To make certain that something will occur or be the case.

words.tr: 谚语. 只要目的正当，可以不择手段
words.ex: He lied to win the game, saying the end justifies the means.
words.ex_cn: 他为了赢比赛而撒谎，说目的正当化手段。
words.en: The idea that a desired outcome can justify the use of questionable or unethical methods.

words.tr: phrase. 必要的恶；虽不受欢迎但为达成目标所必需的事物
words.ex: Taxes are a necessary evil in society.
words.ex_cn: 税收是社会中一种必要的恶。
words.en: Something that is unpleasant or harmful but must be accepted because it brings some benefit or because there is no alternative.

words.tr: phrase. 两害相权取其轻；在两个坏选项中选择危害较小的一个
words.ex: Choosing to work overtime was the lesser of two evils compared to missing the project deadline.
words.ex_cn: 选择加班是相比于错过项目截止日期两害相权取其轻。
words.en: The less harmful or unpleasant of two bad choices or possibilities.

words.tr: v. 采取观望态度
words.ex: The government decided to adopt a wait-and-see attitude about the new policy.
words.ex_cn: 政府决定对这项新政策采取观望态度。

words.tr: phrase. 立即采取行动；马上行动
words.ex: The company must take immediate action to fix the error.
words.ex_cn: 公司必须立即采取行动来修复这个错误。
words.en: To act without delay.

words.tr: phrase. 火上浇油；使情况更加恶化
words.ex: His angry words add fuel to the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他愤怒的话火上浇油。
words.en: To make a bad situation worse by saying or doing something that causes more anger or problems.

words.tr: v. 加剧；使恶化；激怒
words.ex: Loud noise aggravates his headache.
words.ex_cn: 噪音加重了他的头痛。
words.en: If someone or something aggravates a situation, they make it worse.

words.w: be barking up the wrong tree
words.tr: phrase. 完全搞错了方向；找错了目标；误会了情况
words.uk: biː ˈbɑːkɪŋ ʌp ðə wrɒŋ triː
words.us: biː ˈbɑːrkɪŋ ʌp ðə wroʊŋ triː
words.ex: If you think I took your book, you're barking up the wrong tree.
words.ex_cn: 如果你认为我拿了你的书，那你就找错人了。
words.en: To be pursuing a mistaken or misguided line of thought or course of action.

words.tr: phrase. 一个被误导的计划；一个方向错误的计划
words.ex: The project failed because it was based on a misguided plan.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目失败了，因为它是基于一个误导的计划。
words.en: A plan that is based on wrong judgments or ideas.

words.tr: phrase. 可行的替代方案；一种切实可行的代替选择
words.ex: Solar power is a feasible alternative to fossil fuels.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能是化石燃料的一个可行替代方案。
words.en: A feasible alternative to something is a possible and practical option that can be used instead of it.

words.tr: phrase. 可行的替代方案；一种切实可行的代替选择
words.ex: Solar energy is a viable alternative to fossil fuels.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能是化石燃料的一个可行的替代方案。
words.en: A viable alternative to something is a practical and possible option that can be used instead of it, often suggesting that it is better or more sustainable.

words.tr: phrase. 最后手段；万不得已的选择
words.ex: He took the last resort and called the police.
words.ex_cn: 他采取了最后的手段，报警了。
words.en: The final option or course of action when all others have failed.

words.w: have no option but to do
words.tr: v. 别无选择，只能做……
words.uk: hæv nəʊ ˈɒpʃən bʌt tə duː
words.us: hæv noʊ ˈɑːpʃən bʌt tə duː
words.ex: I have no option but to walk home because the bus broke down.
words.ex_cn: 因为公交车坏了，我别无选择，只能走回家。

words.tr: phrase. 是时候了；早该如此；总算等到（表示某事早就应该发生）
words.ex: It's about time you cleaned your room.
words.ex_cn: phrase. 你早该打扫你的房间了。
words.en: used to say that something should have happened sooner

words.tr: phrase. 处理一个问题；着手解决难题
words.ex: We must tackle a problem when it comes.
words.ex_cn: 当问题来临时，我们必须解决它。
words.en: To deal with a problem or challenge in a determined and effective way.

words.tr: phrase. 克服障碍；战胜困难
words.ex: He worked hard to overcome an obstacle in his path.
words.ex_cn: 他努力克服了前进道路上的一个障碍。
words.en: To successfully deal with or gain control of something that is difficult or stands in the way of progress.

words.w: a desirable ideal rather than an achievable reality
words.tr: 短语. 一种令人向往的理想，而非可实现的现实
words.uk: /ə dɪˈzɜːrəbəl aɪˈdiːəl ˈrɑːðə(r) ðən ən əˈtʃiːvəbəl ˈriːələti/
words.us: /ə dɪˈzɜːrəbəl aɪˈdiːəl ˈræðər ðən ən əˈtʃiːvəbəl ˈriːələti/
words.ex: Peace in the world is a desirable ideal rather than an achievable reality.
words.ex_cn: 世界和平是一个美好的理想，但难以实现。
words.en: An ideal worth striving for but unlikely to be fully achieved.

words.tr: phrase. 实际上；事实上
words.ex: He looks happy, but in reality, he is sad.
words.ex_cn: 他看起来很开心，但事实上，他很难过。
words.en: used to emphasize what is actually the case, as opposed to what people might think

words.tr: phrase. 获得知识；学习知识
words.ex: He wants to acquire knowledge by reading books.
words.ex_cn: 他想通过读书来获取知识。
words.en: To gain information, understanding, or skill through study, experience, or being taught.

words.tr: phrase. 天赋；与生俱来的才能
words.ex: He has innate talent for playing the piano.
words.ex_cn: 他天生就有弹钢琴的才华。
words.en: Inborn or inherent ability, not learned or developed.

words.tr: 短语动词. 咨询专家；向专家请教
words.ex: He will consult an expert about his problem.
words.ex_cn: 他将向专家咨询他的问题。
words.en: Seek advice or information from someone with specialized knowledge.

words.tr: phrase. 解决问题的能力；解题能力
words.ex: He shows strong problem-solving ability in math class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学课上表现出很强的解决问题的能力。
words.en: The capacity to find solutions to difficult or complex issues.

words.tr: v. 有做某事的天赋；善于做某事
words.ex: He has the knack of solving math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他有快速解决数学问题的天赋。

words.tr: adj. 平庸的；
words.ex: The movie was mediocre and not worth watching.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影很平庸，不值得看。
words.en: If you describe something as mediocre, you mean that it is of average quality but you think it should be better.

words.tr: phrase. 对某事了如指掌；对某事物非常熟悉
words.ex: He knows the city inside out.
words.ex_cn: 他对这座城市了如指掌。
words.en: To know something inside out means to be completely familiar with it, understanding every detail.

words.tr: v. 对某事了如指掌；非常熟悉某事
phrase. 熟悉某物的用法；掌握做某事的窍门
words.ex: He is trying to get the hang of riding a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他正在努力学会骑自行车。
words.en: If you get the hang of something, you learn how to do it or use it successfully.

words.tr: phrase. 生疏的；荒废的（指长时间未使用某项技能或知识而变得不熟练）
words.ex: My bike has been sitting in the garage for years and now it's rusty.
words.ex_cn: 我的自行车在车库里放了好几年，现在生锈了。
words.en: To be rusty means to be covered with rust or to be out of practice in a particular skill.

words.tr:
v. 磨刀；磨练
n. 磨刀石
words.ex: He honed the knife on a stone.
words.ex_cn: 他用石头磨刀。
words.en: To hone something means to improve and perfect it over time, especially a skill or technique.

words.tr: phrase. 擅长于……的；在……方面熟练的
words.ex: He is adept at solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他擅长解决数学问题。
words.en: To be very skilled or proficient at something.

words.tr: phrase. 精通于……的；在……方面熟练的
words.ex_cn: 他擅长数学。
words.en: To have or show a high level of skill or ability in a particular activity or subject.

words.tr: v. 超出某人的能力/理解范围；某人无法做到/理解
phrase. 比喻某人处于超出其能力或理解范围的情境中，无法应对
words.ex: He was out of his depth in the advanced math class.
words.ex_cn: 他在高级数学课上感到力不从心。
words.en: If you are out of your depth, you are in a situation that is too difficult for you to understand or deal with.

words.w: use sb. as a guinea pig
words.tr: phrase. 把某人当作实验对象（尤指医学或科学实验）
words.ex: The new teaching method was used on the students as guinea pigs.
words.ex_cn: v. 新的教学方法被用在学生身上作为实验品。
words.en: To use someone as a test subject, often without their full consent or knowledge, in an experiment or trial.

words.tr: phrase. 试验场；测试场地；用于实验或评估某事物的地方
words.ex: This park is a testing ground for new bikes.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园是新自行车的试验场。
words.en: A place or situation used for testing new ideas or methods.

words.tr: phrase. 守法公民；遵纪守法的市民
words.ex: He is a law-abiding citizen who always follows the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他是个守法的公民，总是遵守规则。
words.en: A law-abiding citizen is someone who obeys the laws of their country and behaves in a way that is accepted by society.

words.tr: phrase. 司法制度；司法体系
words.ex: The judicial system makes sure people follow the law.
words.ex_cn: 司法系统确保人们遵守法律。
words.en: The judicial system refers to the system of courts that interprets and applies the law in the name of the state.

words.tr: phrase. 受…约束的；受…限制的
words.ex_cn: 他受游戏规则的约束。
words.en: To be compelled or required to act in a certain way by a rule, law, or agreement.

words.tr: phrase. 通过新立法；使新的法律法规获得通过
words.ex: The government will pass new legislation next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府下个月将通过新法律。
words.en: To enact a new law or statute through a formal legislative process.

words.tr: phrase. 维护一个有序的社会
words.ex: The police work to uphold an ordered society.
words.ex_cn: 警察努力维护一个有秩序的社会。
words.en: To maintain or defend a society based on rules, order, and stability.

words.tr: phrase. 抑制无法无天的行为
words.ex: The police want to curb lawless behaviour in the city.
words.ex_cn: 警察希望遏制城市中的无法无天行为。
words.en: To restrict or control violent, chaotic, or illegal actions.

words.tr: phrase. 有做某事的冲动；倾向于做某事；受到诱惑去做某事
words.ex: He was tempted to eat the cake.
words.ex_cn: 他很想吃那块蛋糕。
words.en: To be tempted to do something means to have a desire to do it, even though you know it might not be the best thing to do.

words.tr: phrase. 青少年犯罪
words.ex: The city is trying to reduce juvenile delinquency with after-school programs.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市正通过课后项目来减少青少年犯罪。
words.en: Juvenile delinquency refers to the participation in illegal behavior by minors (juveniles) who fall under a statutory age limit.

words.tr: phrase. 法定年龄；成年年龄
words.ex: He is of legal age to vote.
words.ex_cn: 他到了可以投票的法定年龄。
words.en: The age at which a person is legally considered an adult and responsible for their actions.

words.tr: phrase. 纪律处分；惩戒措施
words.ex: The school took disciplinary action after the student broke the rules.
words.ex_cn: 学生违反规则后，学校采取了纪律处分。
words.en: A formal measure taken by an organization to address an employee's misconduct or violation of rules, often resulting in penalties such as suspension or dismissal.

words.tr: phrase. 职业罪犯；惯犯
words.ex: He is a career criminal who stole many times.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名惯犯，多次行窃。
words.en: A person who makes a living by committing crimes, often repeatedly and over a long period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 随机犯罪；无特定目标的罪行
words.ex: The police are investigating a random crime in the neighborhood.
words.ex_cn: 警方正在调查社区里一起随机犯罪。
words.en: A crime that is unplanned and occurs by chance, not as part of a pattern.

words.tr: phrase. 怀疑的；有疑心的；可疑的
words.ex: He is suspicious of the strange man near the door.
words.ex_cn: 他怀疑门口那个奇怪的男人。
words.en: To have doubts or suspicions about something or someone.

words.tr: v. 阻止某人做某事；使某人打消做某事的念头
words.en: To discourage or prevent someone from doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 帮助并教唆（某人做某事），通常用于法律语境中，指协助和怂恿他人犯罪
words.ex: He helped the thief by aiding and abetting him.
words.ex_cn: 他通过帮助和纵容小偷来协助他。
words.en: To help or encourage someone to commit a crime or wrongdoing.

words.tr:
v. 定罪；宣判有罪
n. 罪犯；囚犯
words.ex: The court convicted him of theft.
words.ex_cn: 法院判定他犯有盗窃罪。
words.en: If someone is convicted of a crime, they are found guilty of that crime in a court of law.

words.tr: phrase. 被判定犯有（某项罪行）
words.ex: He was convicted of stealing a car.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷车被定罪。
words.en: If someone is convicted of a crime, they are found guilty of that crime in a court of law.

words.tr: phrase. 将某人绳之以法；使某人受到法律制裁
words.ex: The police will bring the thief to justice.
words.ex_cn: 警察会将小偷绳之以法。
words.en: To capture and punish someone for a crime they have committed, ensuring they face legal consequences.

words.tr: n. 法律程序；诉讼程序
words.ex: The legal proceeding took months to finish.
words.ex_cn: 这个法律程序花了数月才完成。

words.tr: phrase. 已经大量繁殖；已经迅速扩散；已经激增
words.ex: Smartphones have proliferated in recent years.
words.ex_cn: 近年来，智能手机大量增加。
words.en: To increase rapidly in number or spread widely.

words.tr: phrase. 犯罪预防；防止犯罪的措施或行动
words.ex: The police help with crime prevention in the neighborhood.
words.ex_cn: 警察帮助社区预防犯罪。
words.en: Activities or measures taken to stop crimes from happening.

words.tr: n. 残忍；暴行；
words.ex: The movie shows the brutality of war.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了战争的残忍。
words.en: Brutality is cruel and violent behavior, or a cruel and violent act.

words.tr: phrase. 成为……的受害者；受到……的伤害
words.ex: Many people fall victim to the lure of easy money.
words.ex_cn: 许多人成为轻松赚钱的诱惑的牺牲品。
words.en: If someone falls victim to something, they are harmed or killed by it, or they are affected by it in a bad way.

words.tr: phrase. 完全无法自拔地沉迷于；对……上瘾到无药可救的程度
words.ex: He is hopelessly addicted to video games.
words.ex_cn: 他对电子游戏上瘾得无法自拔。
words.en: To be unable to stop doing or using something, especially something harmful.

words.tr: phrase. 充满忧虑的；全神贯注于…的；一心想着…的
words.ex_cn: 他整天都心不在焉地想着手机。
words.en: If you are preoccupied with something, you are thinking about it a lot or worrying about it so much that you do not think about other things.

words.tr: phrase. 网络诈骗；线上欺诈
words.ex: He lost money to online fraud last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月在网上诈骗中损失了钱。
words.en: Deception or cheating that is carried out via the internet.

words.tr: phrase. 白领犯罪
words.ex: The CEO was arrested for committing white-collar crime.
words.ex_cn: 那位CEO因为犯下白领犯罪而被逮捕。
words.en: White-collar crime refers to financially motivated, nonviolent crime committed by business and government professionals.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人对社会变得冷酷或麻木
words.ex: Hard work can harden him against society's pressures.
words.ex_cn: 努力工作可以让他对社会的压力变得坚强。
words.en: To make someone less trusting or more hostile towards society, often due to negative experiences or hardships.

words.tr: phrase. 家庭暴力
words.ex: He called the police because of domestic violence.
words.ex_cn: 他因为家庭暴力报了警。
words.en: Domestic violence refers to violent or aggressive behavior within the home, typically involving the violent abuse of a spouse or partner.

words.tr: n. 恣意毁坏他人财产罪
words.ex: The boys did vandalism by breaking the windows.
words.ex_cn: 那些男孩通过砸坏窗户实施了破坏行为。
words.en: The crime of deliberately damaging or destroying public or private property.

words.tr: phrase. 接受审判；出庭受审
words.ex: He will stand trial for stealing a car.
words.ex_cn: 他将因偷车受审。
words.en: To undergo a judicial examination and determination of issues between parties by a court of law.

words.tr: phrase. 被控告
words.ex: He was charged with stealing a car.
words.ex_cn: 他被指控偷了一辆车。
words.en: If someone is charged with a crime, they are officially accused of it and will be judged in a court of law.

words.tr: phrase. 惯犯；累犯
words.ex: He is a repeat offender who stole again last month.
words.ex_cn: 他是个惯犯，上个月又偷了。
words.en: A repeat offender is a person who has been convicted of a crime on more than one occasion.

words.tr: v. 使囚犯重新适应社会；改造罪犯
words.ex: The government wants to rehabilitate prisoners by teaching them job skills.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望通过教授囚犯职业技能来帮助他们改过自新。

words.tr: n. 扒手；小偷
words.ex: The pickpocket stole his wallet on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 小偷在公交车上偷了他的钱包。
words.en: A pickpocket is a person who steals things from people's pockets or bags in public places.

words.tr: phrase. 财产犯罪；侵犯财产罪（指盗窃、抢劫、纵火等以非法获取或毁坏他人财产为目的的犯罪行为）
words.ex: He was arrested for a property crime last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月因财产犯罪被逮捕了。
words.en: Property crime refers to crimes that involve the theft or destruction of someone else's property. This can include burglary, theft, arson, and vandalism.

words.tr: phrase. 一场骗局；欺诈行为
words.ex: He lost money because of a scam.
words.ex_cn: 他因为一个骗局损失了钱。
words.en: A dishonest scheme or fraud designed to cheat someone.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 对…进行严厉打击；采取严厉措施制止
words.ex: The government will crack down on people who break the rules.
words.ex_cn: 政府将严厉打击违反规则的人。
words.en: To take severe measures against someone or something, especially in order to stop them from doing something illegal or harmful.

words.tr: phrase. 彻底消除；扑灭；踩灭
words.ex: The police tried to stamp out the illegal market.
words.ex_cn: 警察试图取缔这个非法市场。
words.en: To stamp out something means to put an end to it, especially by using force or strong measures.

words.tr: phrase. 一段艰难但值得的过程；一项虽然辛苦却富有回报的经历
words.ex: Learning a new language is an arduous but rewarding process.
words.ex_cn: 学习一门新语言是一个艰难但值得的过程。
words.en: A difficult but worthwhile undertaking.

words.tr: n. 渴望；
words.ex: His aspiration is to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他的渴望是成为一名医生。
words.en: A strong desire to achieve something high or great.

words.tr: phrase. 集中于； 专心于
words.ex: He must concentrate on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他必须专心做作业。
words.en: To direct all your attention and effort towards a particular activity, subject, or problem.

words.tr: phrase. 构成...的基础
words.ex: These findings form the basis of our research.
words.ex_cn: 这些发现构成了我们研究的基础。
words.en: To serve as the foundation or starting point for something.

words.tr: phrase. 运用横向思维；采用非传统或创造性的方式思考问题
words.ex: He used lateral thinking to solve the puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 他用横向思维解决了这个谜题。
words.en: To use lateral thinking means to approach problems or situations from a new or unusual angle, rather than by traditional step-by-step logic.

words.tr: phrase. 依赖线性思维；依靠直线式思考方式
words.ex: Many people rely on linear thinking to solve problems.
words.ex_cn: 许多人依赖线性思维来解决问题。
words.en: To depend on a straightforward, step-by-step approach to problem-solving or decision-making.

words.tr: phrase. 打破常规；打破模式
words.ex: She decided to break the mould and start her own business.
words.ex_cn: 她决定打破常规，开始自己的事业。
words.en: To do something differently after it has been done in the same way for a long time.

words.tr: phrase. 学术表现；学业成绩
words.ex: His academic performance improved after he studied harder.
words.ex_cn: 他更努力学习后，学业表现提高了。
words.en: The achievement or success in academic studies or work, often measured by grades or other assessments.

words.tr: phrase. 学术资格；学历
words.ex: He needs an academic qualification to get the job.
words.ex_cn: 他需要一份学术资格才能获得这份工作。
words.en: An academic qualification is an official document showing that someone has successfully completed a course of study or passed an examination.

words.tr: 标准化考试：一种按照统一标准进行评估和比较的考试，通常用于衡量学生的学术水平和能力。
words.ex: He took a standardised test last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周参加了一次标准化考试。
words.en: An examination administered and scored in a consistent, uniform manner.

words.tr: phrase. 有天赋的
words.ex_cn: v. 她在音乐方面有天赋。
words.en: To have a natural ability or talent.

words.tr: phrase. 机械记忆；死记硬背
words.ex: He passed the test by rote memorisation.
words.ex_cn: 他通过死记硬背通过了考试。
words.en: The process of learning something by repeating it many times without thinking about it or understanding it.

words.tr: phrase. v. 完全记住某事；背熟
words.ex: He learned the poem by heart.
words.ex_cn: 他把这首诗背了下来。
words.en: To memorize something completely so that it can be recalled without hesitation.

words.tr: phrase. 广泛阅读；大量阅读；博览群书
words.ex: He reads extensively to improve his English.
words.ex_cn: 他广泛阅读以提高英语水平。
words.en: To read a wide range of materials or topics in order to gain knowledge or understanding.

words.tr: phrase. 促使（某人）临时抱佛脚；导致突击式死记硬背
words.ex: The upcoming exams can induce cramming among students.
words.ex_cn: 即将到来的考试可能会导致学生们临时抱佛脚。
words.en: To encourage or cause someone to study intensively in a short time before an exam.

words.tr: n. 无知；愚昧；
words.ex: His ignorance of the rules caused the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他对规则的无知导致了这个错误。
words.en: Lack of knowledge or information.

words.tr: phrase. 正直行为的标准
words.ex: He lives by the standard of upright conduct.
words.ex_cn: 他以正直的行为准则为生活准则。
words.en: The level of moral integrity and ethical behavior expected.

words.tr: phrase. 学生的自主性；学生自我管理或自我决策的能力
words.ex: Encouraging students' autonomy can lead to more effective learning.
words.ex_cn: 鼓励学生的自主性可以带来更有效的学习。
words.en: The freedom and independence for students to make their own choices.

words.tr: n. 自律；自我约束
words.ex: He shows self-discipline by waking up early every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天早起展现自律。
words.en: The ability to control yourself and to make yourself work hard or behave in a particular way without needing anyone else to tell you what to do.

words.tr: phrase. 模范；榜样
words.ex: My teacher is my role model.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师是我的榜样。
words.en: A role model is a person whose behavior, example, or success is or can be emulated by others, especially by younger people.

words.tr: phrase. 树立一个好榜样；以身作则
words.ex: He sets a good example by arriving on time every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天准时到达，树立了良好的榜样。
words.en: To behave in a way that others should copy.

words.tr: phrase. 达到某人的期望；符合某人的预期
words.ex: He worked hard to meet someone's expectations.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以达到别人的期望。
words.en: To fulfill or satisfy what someone anticipates or hopes for.

words.tr: phrase. 未达到某人的期望；未能满足某人的要求
words.ex: He fell short of his parents' expectations because he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他没考好，辜负了父母的期望。
words.en: To fail to meet someone's expectations or standards.

words.tr: phrase. 无法保证成功的
words.ex_cn: 即使他努力工作，也不能保证他会成功。
words.en: Success is not certain or assured.

words.tr: 短语动词. 涉及很多内容；走很远的路；在短时间内完成大量工作
words.ex: We cover a lot of ground in our science class.
words.ex_cn: 我们的科学课涵盖了很多内容。
words.en: To cover a lot of ground means to deal with a wide range of topics or areas in a discussion, presentation, or piece of work.

words.tr: phrase. 全面发展，多才多艺
words.ex_cn: 他很全面，因为他既运动又读书。
words.en: To be well-rounded means to have a broad range of abilities and knowledge in various areas, making one versatile and adaptable.

words.tr: phrase. 对……的全面覆盖；对……的综合报道或详尽涵盖
words.ex: The book provides comprehensive coverage of basic math topics.
words.ex_cn: 这本书全面涵盖了基础数学内容。
words.en: Providing complete and thorough information or protection about a particular subject or area.

words.tr: phrase. 自定进度学习；学习者根据自身节奏安排学习进程的教育方式
words.ex: He uses self-paced learning to study math at home.
words.ex_cn: 他使用自主节奏学习在家学习数学。
words.en: Self-paced learning refers to an instructional strategy that allows learners to progress through a course at their own speed, without the constraints of a fixed schedule.

words.tr: phrase. 核心课程；必修课程体系
words.ex: Math and science are part of the core curriculum.
words.ex_cn: 数学和科学是核心课程的一部分。
