words.en: A set of basic courses that all students must take to graduate.

words.tr: phrase. 教育的目标；教育的目的
words.ex: The aims of education are to help students learn and grow.
words.ex_cn: 教育的目标是帮助学生学习和成长。
words.en: The objectives or goals that education seeks to achieve, encompassing the development of knowledge, skills, and values in individuals.

words.tr: 专门研究，专攻；专门从事【动词短语】
words.ex: He specialises in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他专攻计算机科学。
words.en: To concentrate on and become expert in a particular subject or skill.

words.tr: phrase. 课外活动；课程以外的活动（如体育、社团、志愿服务等）
words.ex: He joins extra-curricular activities after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后参加课外活动。
words.en: Activities pursued outside the formal academic curriculum, such as sports or clubs.

words.tr: phrase. 促进平等；推动平等
words.ex: The school works to promote equality for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校努力促进所有学生的平等。
words.en: To promote equality means to support or encourage the principle that all people should have equal rights and opportunities.

words.tr: phrase. 压制个性；压抑个体性
words.ex: The school's strict rules tend to repress individuality among students.
words.ex_cn: 学校的严格规定往往压制学生的个性。
words.en: To suppress or conceal the unique qualities and expressions of a person.

words.tr: n. 共同教育；男女合校教育
words.ex: The school offers co-education for boys and girls.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校为男孩和女孩提供男女合校教育。
words.en: An educational system where male and female students attend the same school or classes.

words.tr: phrase. 单性学校；只招收一种性别的学校
words.ex: He went to a single sex school when he was young.
words.ex_cn: 他小时候上的是单性别学校。

words.tr: phrase. 混合能力班；由不同能力水平学生组成的班级
words.ex: The teacher plans a mixed-ability class for all students.
words.ex_cn: 老师为所有学生安排了一个能力混合的班级。
words.en: A classroom containing students with a wide range of abilities.

words.tr: v. 区分；辨别某物与另一物
phrase. 反社会行为；破坏公共秩序的行为，如滋扰、破坏公物或暴力行为
words.ex: He shows anti-social behaviour by ignoring others.
words.ex_cn: 他通过忽视他人表现出反社会行为。
words.en: Anti-social behaviour refers to actions that harm or lack consideration for the well-being of others, often violating social norms and laws.

words.tr: adj. 行为端正的; （电脑程序）多种机体通用的; 饬; 乖乖
words.ex: The well-behaved child sat quietly during class.
words.ex_cn: 这个表现良好的孩子在课堂上安静地坐着。
words.en: A well-behaved person or animal behaves in a way that is acceptable to other people.

words.tr: n. 青春期
words.ex: He was shy during his adolescence.
words.ex_cn: 他在青春期时很害羞。
words.en: Adolescence is the period in a person's life when they develop from a child into an adult.

words.tr: phrase. 对生活的健康看法
words.ex: Maintaining a healthy outlook on life can significantly improve your mental well-being.
words.ex_cn: 保持对生活的健康看法可以显著改善你的心理健康。
words.en: A positive and balanced perspective towards life that contributes to one's physical and mental well-being.

words.tr: n. 调整良好的成年人
words.ex: He is a well-adjusted adult who handles stress calmly.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个能冷静应对压力的适应良好的成年人。

words.tr: phrase. 达到法定年龄；到了成年
words.ex: He came of age last year and now he can vote.
words.ex_cn: 他去年成年了，现在可以投票了。
words.en: To reach the age at which one is legally recognized as an adult.

words.tr: phrase. 能说两种语言的；双语的
words.ex_cn: 他会说英语和西班牙语，所以是双语者。
words.en: To be bilingual means to be able to speak two languages fluently.

words.tr: adj. 仅懂一种语言的；
words.ex: He is monolingual and only speaks English.
words.ex_cn: 他只会说英语，不懂其他语言。
words.en: Using or knowing only one language.

words.tr: phrase. 偷懒；懈怠；不认真工作
words.ex: He slack off when the teacher isn't looking.
words.ex_cn: 当老师没注意时，他偷懒。
words.en: To be lazy or to do something with less effort or energy than is required.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 破坏性的学生；指在课堂或学校环境中行为扰乱秩序、影响教学的学生
words.ex: The teacher sent disruptive students to the office.
words.ex_cn: 老师把捣乱的学生送到了办公室。
words.en: Students who behave in a way that interrupts lessons and disturbs others.

words.tr: phrase. 不守规矩的学生；难以管教的学生
words.ex: The teacher struggled to control the unruly students in her class.
words.ex_cn: 老师努力控制她班上那些难以管教的学生。
words.en: Students who are difficult to control and behave badly.

words.tr: phrasal verb. （机器、身体部位等）出毛病，行为失常；（孩子）调皮捣蛋
words.ex: My old laptop keeps acting up when I open too many programs.
words.ex_cn: 我的旧笔记本电脑在打开太多程序时就会出毛病。
words.en: to behave badly or function improperly

words.tr: n. 缺乏纪律，无纪律
words.ex: The teacher punished the boy for indiscipline.
words.ex_cn: 老师因为不守纪律惩罚了那个男孩。
words.en: Indiscipline refers to a lack of discipline or control, often leading to chaos or disorder.

words.tr: phrase. 满足……的需求；符合……的要求
words.ex: The factory works hard to meet the demand of customers.
words.ex_cn: 工厂努力满足客户的需求。
words.en: To fulfill or satisfy the needs or requirements of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 被设计成适合…的；针对…而调整的
words.ex: This course is geared to beginners.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程面向初学者。
words.en: To be designed or adjusted to meet a particular requirement or to suit a particular group.

words.tr: phrase. 通知某人关于……；告知某人有关……
words.ex: Please inform me about the meeting time.
words.ex_cn: 请告诉我会议的时间。
words.en: To tell someone about something, especially in an official or formal way.

words.tr: phrase. 把理论付诸实践；将理论应用于实际
words.ex: He put theory into practice by building a robot.
words.ex_cn: 他通过制作一个机器人将理论付诸实践。
words.en: To apply theoretical knowledge in a practical or real-world situation.

words.tr: phrase. 第一手经验；直接经验
words.ex: She gained first-hand experience of life in a remote village.
words.ex_cn: 她获得了在偏远村庄生活的直接经验。
words.en: First-hand experience refers to knowledge or experience that is obtained directly, rather than from other people or from books.

words.tr: phrase. 退学；辍学
words.ex: He dropped out of school last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年退学了。
words.en: To leave a school or university before you have finished your studies.

words.tr: phrase. 逃学；旷课
words.ex: He skipped school yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天逃学了。
words.en: To deliberately miss school without permission.

words.w: the responsibility for sth. falls on
words.tr: 动词短语 某事的责任落在……身上
words.uk: ðə ˌrɛspɒnsəˈbɪlətɪ fə r ˈsʌmθɪŋ fɔːlz ɒn
words.us: ðə ˌrɛspɑːnsəˈbɪlət̬i fɔːr ˈsʌmθɪŋ fɔːlz ɑːn

words.w: the responsibility for sth. rests with
words.tr: n. 某事的责任在于；某事由某人负责
words.uk: ðə ˌres.pɒn.səˈbɪl.ɪ.ti fɔːr ˈsʌm.θɪŋ ˈrɛsts wɪð
words.us: ðə ˌrɛs.pɑːn.səˈbɪl.ə.t̬i fɔːr ˈsʌm.θɪŋ ˈrɛsts wɪð

words.tr: v. 推卸对……的责任
words.ex: He tried to shirk his responsibility for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他试图推卸自己对这个错误的责任。

words.tr: phrase. 履行某人的责任
words.ex: Every person should fulfill one's responsibility at work.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都应该履行自己在工作中的责任。
words.en: To fulfill one's responsibility means to do what one is required to do as part of a job, role, or legal obligation.

words.w: deny sb. the freedom to do
words.tr: v. 剥夺某人做某事的自由
words.uk: dɪˈnaɪ ɛs biː ðə ˈfriːdəm tə duː
words.us: dɪˈnaɪ ɛs biː ðə ˈfriːdəm tə du

words.tr: phrase. 必修科目；必须学习的课程
words.ex: Math is a compulsory subject in all schools.
words.ex_cn: 数学是所有学校的必修科目。
words.en: A compulsory subject is a course or area of study that students are required to take as part of their curriculum.

words.tr: v. 激发某人对……的兴趣
words.ex: The book kindled her interest in science.
words.ex_cn: 这本书激发了她对科学的兴趣。

words.tr: phrase. 选修科目；可选课程
words.ex: Math is an optional subject in her school.
words.ex_cn: 数学是她学校的一门选修课。
words.en: A subject that a student can choose to study rather than being required to do so.

words.tr: phrase. 没有什么可以替代……；……是无可替代的
words.ex: There is no substitute for hard work.
words.ex_cn: 努力工作是无可替代的。
words.en: There is nothing that can replace or take the place of something; it is unique or essential.

words.tr: phrase. 远程教育
words.ex: He is doing distance learning at home.
words.ex_cn: 他正在家里进行远程学习。
words.en: Distance learning is a way of studying where tuition is carried out over the internet or by post, so that you do not need to attend a college or university.

words.tr:
n. 妥协；
v. 危及；
words.ex: They reached a compromise after hours of talk.
words.ex_cn: 经过数小时的讨论，他们达成了妥协。
words.en: A compromise is an agreement between two people or groups in which each side gives up some of the things they want so that both sides are happy at the end.

words.tr: phrase. 折中的办法；适中的状态；令人满意的中间立场
words.ex: She found a happy medium between work and leisure.
words.ex_cn: 她在工作和休闲之间找到了一个折中的办法。
words.en: A happy medium is a compromise between two extremes that is satisfactory to all parties involved.

words.tr: v. 担任某人的导师；指导某人
n. 同辈；与自己地位相当的人
words.ex: He treats everyone as his peer, no matter their job.
words.ex_cn: 他对待每个人都是平等的，不管他们的工作是什么。

words.tr: v. 提携某人；庇护某人；像保护雏鸟一样照顾和指导某人
words.ex: My teacher took me under her wing when I was new at school.
words.ex_cn: 当我刚到学校时，老师收留了我并照顾我。

words.tr: phrase. v. 熬夜工作；开夜车
words.ex: He burns the midnight oil to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他熬夜完成作业。
words.en: If you burn the midnight oil, you stay up very late in order to study or do some other work.

words.tr: phrase. 集中精力地学习；刻苦攻读
words.ex: He studied intensively for the exam last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周集中精力地为考试学习。
words.en: To study something with great concentration and effort.

words.tr: phrase. 出发；动身；使爆炸；引起
words.ex: He set off early to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他早早出发以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To begin a journey or to cause something to start or happen.

words.tr: phrase. 烟火表演；焰火展示
words.ex: The town had a fireworks display on New Year's Eve.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇在除夕夜举行了烟花表演。
words.en: A fireworks display is a public show of fireworks, often held to celebrate a special event or occasion.

words.tr: phrase. 公共活动；公开活动；公众事件
words.ex: The concert was a public event that attracted thousands of people.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会是一个吸引了数千人的公共事件。
words.en: A public event is an occasion that is open to and intended for the general public.

words.tr: v. 迎接新年（通常指在新年钟声敲响时庆祝）
words.ex: We gathered at midnight to ring the new year.
words.ex_cn: 我们在午夜聚集，迎接新年。

words.tr: phrase. 新年决心；新年计划；在新年伊始为自己定下的目标或要改正的习惯
words.ex: My new year's resolution is to exercise more.
words.ex_cn: 我的新年决心是多锻炼。
words.en: A New Year's resolution is a promise that you make to yourself to start doing something good or stop doing something bad on the first day of the year.

words.tr: phrase. v. 过分；做得太过分；全力以赴
words.ex: He went overboard with the decorations for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他为派对装饰得太过分了。
words.en: To do something to an excessive or extreme degree, often beyond what is considered reasonable or necessary.

words.tr: phrase. 不足以胜任做某事的；缺乏必要工具或能力去做某事的
words.ex: He is ill-equipped to solve complex math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他没有能力解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: Lacking the necessary resources, skills, or preparation to perform a task effectively.

words.tr: phrase. 玩得很开心
words.ex: We have a blast at the park every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周末在公园都玩得很开心。
words.en: To have a very enjoyable time.

words.tr: phrase. 非常享受自己；玩得非常愉快
words.ex: The children enjoyed themselves immensely at the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园里玩得非常开心。
words.en: To have a very enjoyable time.

words.tr: phrase. 放松；无拘无束；尽情享乐
words.ex: After the exam, she let her hair down and danced with friends.
words.ex_cn: 考试后，她放松下来，和朋友们一起跳舞。
words.en: To relax and enjoy oneself without worrying about what others think.

words.tr: phrase. 感到拘束的；觉得不自在的；受到抑制的
words.ex: He feels inhibited when he speaks in front of people.
words.ex_cn: 当他当着大家的面说话时，感到拘谨。
words.en: To feel restrained or self-conscious in a situation, preventing natural expression or action.

words.tr: phrase. 感觉不自在；觉得格格不入；感到自己不属于某个环境
words.ex: He feels out of place at the party because he doesn't know anyone.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上感到格格不入，因为他不认识任何人。
words.en: To feel uncomfortable or not belong in a particular situation or environment.

words.tr: phrase. 找到自己的定位；找到适合自己的位置或角色
words.ex: He tried to find a niche for himself in the tech industry.
words.ex_cn: 他试图在科技行业为自己找到一个专长领域。
words.en: To establish a specific role or position where one feels comfortable and valued.

words.tr: phrase. 扫兴的人或事物
words.ex: Don't be such a wet blanket at the party.
words.ex_cn: 别在派对上这么扫兴。
words.en: A person or thing that spoils other people's fun or dampens their enthusiasm.

words.tr: phrase. 指非常喜欢参加派对、热衷于狂欢娱乐的人
words.ex: He is a party animal and loves dancing every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他是个派对狂，喜欢每个周末都跳舞。
words.en: A person who enjoys attending parties and social events frequently and enthusiastically.

words.tr: phrase. 发挥监管作用；起调控作用
words.ex: The government plays a regulatory role in the market.
words.ex_cn: 政府在市场中发挥监管作用。
words.en: To function as a means of controlling or directing activities according to rules.

words.tr: phrase. 监管并监督；规范并管理
words.ex: The government must regulate and oversee food safety.
words.ex_cn: 政府必须监管和监督食品安全。
words.en: To control and supervise activities to ensure compliance with standards.

words.tr: phrase. 规章制度；条例章程；规定与准则
words.ex: All employees must follow the rules and regulations.
words.ex_cn: 所有员工都必须遵守规章制度。
words.en: Rules and regulations refer to a set of explicit or understood regulations or principles governing conduct within a particular activity or sphere.

words.tr: phrase. 对……实施禁令；禁止……
words.ex: The government will impose a ban on plastic bags.
words.ex_cn: 政府将禁止使用塑料袋。
words.en: To officially forbid or prohibit something.

words.tr: phrase. 把负担强加于；使承担（责任、费用等）
words.ex: High taxes can impose a burden on poor families.
words.ex_cn: 高税收会给贫困家庭带来负担。
words.en: To place a heavy load or responsibility on someone or something.

words.tr: v. 应当废除
words.ex: The government should abolish the old law.
words.ex_cn: 政府应该废除这项旧法律。

words.tr: v. 应当实施；应该执行
words.ex: The school should implement a new rule for homework.
words.ex_cn: 学校应该实施一项新的家庭作业规定。

words.tr: phrase. 实施；使生效；执行某事
words.ex: The new rule will put into effect next Monday.
words.ex_cn: 新规则将于下周一生效。
words.en: To implement or bring something into operation.

words.tr: 短语. 位于政府议程的优先位置；政府重点关心的事项
words.ex: Clean water is high on the government's agenda.
words.ex_cn: 清洁用水在政府的议程中占据重要位置。
words.en: Of great importance or priority in the government's plans or schedule.

words.tr: phrase. 高度重视；把……置于优先位置；给予……极高优先级
words.ex: The school places a high priority on student safety.
words.ex_cn: 学校高度重视学生的安全。
words.en: To regard something as extremely important and give it significant attention.

words.tr: n. 改革；改造；
words.ex: The government announced a major reform in education.
words.ex_cn: 政府宣布了教育方面的重大改革。
words.en: If someone reforms a system, they change or improve it.

words.tr: phrase. 将某事转化为行动；付诸实践
words.ex: It's time to translate our plans into action.
words.ex_cn: 是时候将我们的计划转化为行动了。
words.en: To put a plan or idea into practical effect.

words.tr: v. 采取严厉措施做某事
words.ex: The government took draconian measures to stop the spread of the virus.
words.ex_cn: 政府采取了严厉措施来阻止病毒的传播。

words.tr: n. 政府在……方面的松懈
words.ex: The government's laxity in enforcing traffic laws caused many accidents.
words.ex_cn: 政府在执行交通法规方面的松懈导致了许多事故。

words.tr: v. 对抗；抵制；
words.ex: Wear a helmet to counteract the risk of head injury.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔以对抗头部受伤的风险。
words.en: If you counteract something, you reduce its effect by doing something that produces an opposite effect.

words.tr: n. 对策；对抗手段
words.ex: The company developed a countermeasure to combat the new security threat.
words.ex_cn: 公司制定了一项对策来应对新的安全威胁。
words.en: A countermeasure is an action or strategy that is intended to counteract or offset another action or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 一个反复出现的问题；一再发生的难题
words.ex: He faces a recurring problem with his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他总是遇到电脑的问题。
words.en: A problem that happens repeatedly over time.

words.tr: phrase. 一种持久的、长期有效的解决方案
words.ex: We need to find an enduring solution to this problem.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要找到一个持久的解决方案来解决这个问题。
words.en: A permanent or long-lasting resolution to a problem or issue.

words.tr: adj. 短视的；目光短浅的；缺乏远见的
words.uk: ɪt ɪz ˈʃɔːt saɪtɪd tuː duː
words.us: ɪt ɪz ˈʃɔːrt saɪtɪd tuː duː
words.ex: It is short-sighted to ignore climate change.
words.ex_cn: 忽视气候变化是短视的。

words.w: sb. would be well-advised to do
words.tr: 某人最好做某事；某人明智之举是做某事
words.uk: ɛs biː wʊd biː wɛl ədˈvaɪzd tuː duː
words.us: ɛs biː wʊd biː wɛl ədˈvaɪzd tuː duː

words.tr: phrase. 有权做某事；有权力或权限去做某事
words.ex: The manager has the authority to approve the request.
words.ex_cn: 经理有权批准这个请求。
words.en: To have the power or right to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 制定政策
words.ex: The committee is working to formulate policies that will benefit the entire community.
words.ex_cn: 委员会正在努力制定将使整个社区受益的政策。
words.en: To create or prepare a plan, policy, or strategy carefully and in detail.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对某物拥有垄断权；独家控制某事物
words.uk: hæv hæz ə məˈnɒpəli əv sth
words.us: hæv hæz ə məˈnɑːpəli əv sth
words.ex: The company has a monopoly over the water supply in the city.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司垄断了该市的供水。
words.en: To have exclusive control over a particular market, activity, or resource.

words.tr: 国防：指一个国家为保卫自身的领土、主权、安全和利益而采取的一切措施和行动。
words.ex: The government spends money on national defence.
words.ex_cn: 政府在国防上花钱。
words.en: The protection of a nation's territory, sovereignty, and interests from external threats.

words.tr: phrase. 保护我们的安全；维护我们的安全
words.ex: We must take effective measures to safeguard our security.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须采取有效措施来保护我们的安全。
words.en: To protect or defend our safety and security from harm or danger.

words.tr: phrase. 军备竞赛；指两个或多个国家之间为了在军事力量上超过对方而进行的激烈竞争
words.ex: The two countries are in an arms race.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家正在进行军备竞赛。
words.en: A competitive struggle between nations to develop and stockpile military weapons.

words.tr: phrase. 预算赤字
words.ex: The government has a big budget deficit this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年政府有巨大的预算赤字。
words.en: A budget deficit occurs when expenses exceed revenue and indicate the financial health of a country. The government generally uses the term budget deficit when referring to spending rather than businesses or individuals. Budget deficits affect the national debt, the sum of annual budget deficits, and the cumulative total a country owes to creditors.

words.tr: phrase. 政府支出；政府花费
words.ex: The government spending increased last year.
words.ex_cn: 政府支出去年增加了。
words.en: Government spending refers to the money spent by the government on various public services and investments. It includes expenditures on healthcare, education, defense, and infrastructure, among others.

words.tr: 短语. 由纳税人负担费用；花纳税人的钱
words.ex: The new public park was built at the taxpayer's expense.
words.ex_cn: 这个新公园是由纳税人承担费用建造的。
words.en: Funded by money collected from the public through taxes.

words.tr: phrase. 减轻税收负担；缓解税务压力
words.ex: The government announced new policies to relieve tax burden on small businesses.
words.ex_cn: 政府宣布了新政策，以减轻小企业的税收负担。
words.en: To reduce the amount of tax that people or businesses have to pay.

words.tr: v. 以津贴补助
words.ex: The government helps to subsidise farmers.
words.ex_cn: 政府帮助补贴农民。
words.en: To subsidise means to support financially, typically by a government or public body, to help keep the price of a product or service low or to support a business or industry.

words.tr: phrase. 将资金分配给；向……拨款
words.ex: The government has decided to allocate money to the healthcare sector.
words.ex_cn: 政府决定拨款给医疗保健部门。
words.en: To allocate money to something means to give money to it for a particular purpose, often as part of an official process.

words.tr: phrase. 贸易壁垒；贸易障碍（指限制国际贸易的政策或措施）
words.ex: The two countries removed trade barriers to help businesses.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家消除了贸易壁垒以帮助企业。
words.en: Trade barriers are measures that governments or public authorities introduce to make imported goods or services less competitive than locally produced goods and services.

words.tr: phrase. 自由贸易
words.ex: Two countries agree on free trade to sell goods easily.
words.ex_cn: 两个国家同意实行自由贸易以便轻松销售商品。
words.en: Free trade refers to the international exchange of goods and services without restrictions or tariffs.

words.tr: phrase. 饥饿与贫困
words.ex: Many children suffer from hunger and poverty in remote areas.
words.ex_cn: 许多孩子在偏远地区遭受饥饿和贫困。
words.en: The state of lacking sufficient food and living in poverty.

words.tr: phrase. 财富与繁荣；富裕与昌盛
words.ex: The country enjoys wealth and prosperity after years of peace.
words.ex_cn: 经过多年的和平，这个国家享有财富与繁荣。
words.en: A state of abundant financial resources and general well-being.

words.tr: adj. 弱势的；下层社会的；贫困的
words.ex: The school helps underprivileged children learn to read.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校帮助弱势儿童学习阅读。
words.en: People who are underprivileged lack the advantages that other people have, such as enough money or a good standard of living.

words.tr: phrase. 慈善组织；慈善机构
words.ex: Charitable organisations help poor children.
words.ex_cn: 慈善组织帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: Charitable organisations are institutions that aim to help those in need by providing support, funding, or services without the primary intention of making a profit.

words.tr: phrase. 健康保险；医疗保险
words.ex: He bought health insurance for his family.
words.ex_cn: 他为家人购买了医疗保险。
words.en: Health insurance is a type of insurance coverage that pays for medical and surgical expenses incurred by the insured. Health insurance can reimburse the insured for expenses incurred from illness or injury, or pay the care provider directly.

words.tr: phrase. 国际援助；对外援助
words.ex: The country received international aid after the earthquake.
words.ex_cn: 地震后，这个国家收到了国际援助。
words.en: Assistance provided by one country or an international organization to another, typically in the form of money, goods, or services, to support development, emergency relief, or welfare.

words.tr: phrase. 低息贷款
words.ex: He got a low-interest loan to buy a car.
words.ex_cn: 他申请了一笔低息贷款来买车。
words.en: Loans offered at lower-than-market interest rates, often to support specific sectors or individuals.

words.tr: phrase. 维护社会稳定；保障社会安定
words.ex: The government works to safeguard social stability.
words.ex_cn: 政府努力维护社会稳定。
words.en: To protect and maintain social order and peace.

words.tr: phrase. 增进国家之间的关系
words.ex: The two countries work together to enhance relations between countries.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家共同努力加强国家之间的关系。
words.en: To improve diplomatic or friendly connections between nations.

words.tr: phrase. 一个长期存在的问题；慢性问题
words.ex: Poverty is a chronic problem in many developing countries.
words.ex_cn: 贫困是许多发展中国家长期存在的问题。
words.en: A chronic problem refers to a long-standing issue that persists over time and is difficult to resolve.

words.tr: 短语. 长期缺乏……的；慢性短缺……的
words.ex: There is a chronic shortage of clean water in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄长期缺乏干净的水。
words.en: A persistent lack or scarcity of something over a long period.

words.tr: phrase. 变得广泛可用；变得普及并容易获得
words.ex: Solar panels become widely available in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能电池板在许多国家变得广泛可用。
words.en: To become accessible to the general public on a large scale.

words.tr: phrase. 开创先河；取得突破性进展；开辟新领域
words.ex: The scientist's research breaks new ground in medicine.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家的研究在医学上开辟了新领域。
words.en: To do something innovative that has not been done before.

words.tr: phrase. 科学上的重大突破；科学领域取得的革命性进展
words.ex: The scientist made a scientific breakthrough last year.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家去年取得了科学突破。
words.en: A scientific breakthrough is a significant and often unexpected discovery or development in the field of science that leads to new knowledge or technology.

words.tr: phrase. ……的到来；……的出现
words.ex: The advent of smartphones changed how people communicate.
words.ex_cn: 智能手机的出现改变了人们的交流方式。
words.en: The arrival or coming into being of a notable person, thing, or event.

words.tr: v. 取代；代替；替代
words.ex: The new law will supersede the old one.
words.ex_cn: 新法律将取代旧法律。
words.en: If something is superseded by something newer, it is replaced because it has become old-fashioned or unacceptable.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 热烈欢迎某事；张开双臂迎接某事
words.ex: They welcomed the new student with open arms.
words.ex_cn: 他们热情地欢迎了这位新生。
words.en: Receive someone or something with great enthusiasm and pleasure.

words.tr: v. 宣传；推广；使普及；使通俗化
words.ex: He wants to popularise science among children.
words.ex_cn: 他想让孩子们喜欢上科学。
words.en: To make something popular or well-known to the general public.

words.tr: phrase. 遗传工程；基因工程
words.ex: Scientists use genetic engineering to change plant genes.
words.ex_cn: 科学家使用基因工程来改变植物的基因。
words.en: The deliberate modification of the characteristics of an organism by manipulating its genetic material.

words.tr: n. 基因编辑；指对生物体基因组特定目标进行修改的技术
words.ex: Scientists are using gene editing to fix diseases.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们正在使用基因编辑来治疗疾病。
words.en: A technology that allows scientists to modify an organism's DNA, often to correct genetic defects or study gene function.

words.tr: phrase. 转基因食品；经过基因改造的食品
words.ex: Many people are concerned about the safety of genetically-modified food.
words.ex_cn: 许多人对转基因食品的安全性表示担忧。
words.en: Food derived from organisms whose genetic material has been altered using biotechnology.

words.tr: v. 最小化……的风险
words.ex: Wear a helmet to minimise the risk of head injury.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔以降低头部受伤的风险。

words.tr: phrase. 云计算
words.ex: He uses cloud computing to store his files.
words.ex_cn: 他使用云计算来存储文件。
words.en: Cloud computing is the delivery of different services through the Internet, including data storage, servers, databases, networking, and software.

words.tr: n. 气象卫星
words.ex: The meteorological satellite sends weather data to Earth.
words.ex_cn: 气象卫星向地球发送天气数据。
words.en: A satellite used for observing and forecasting weather patterns.

words.tr: phrase. 通信设备；通讯器材
words.ex: The school bought new communications equipment for the office.
words.ex_cn: 学校为办公室购买了新的通信设备。
words.en: Devices and systems used for transmitting and receiving information, such as radios or telephones.

words.tr: n. 电话会议；视频会议；
words.ex: We use teleconferencing to talk with our team in another city.
words.ex_cn: 我们使用电话会议与另一个城市的团队交谈。
words.en: Teleconferencing is the use of telecommunication technology to conduct meetings between participants who are in different locations.

words.tr: phrase. 一次载人任务；指有宇航员或人员参与的航天、探险等任务
words.ex: The country successfully launched a manned mission to Mars.
words.ex_cn: 该国成功发射了一次前往火星的载人任务。
words.en: A mission that involves sending humans into space, as opposed to unmanned missions which are carried out by robots or machines.

words.tr: phrase. 零重力
words.ex: Astronauts float in zero gravity.
words.ex_cn: 宇航员在失重状态下漂浮。
words.en: A condition in which there is no net force of gravity acting on a body, either because the force is negated or because the body is in a state of free fall.

words.tr: n. 宇航员；太空人
words.ex: The astronaut walked on the moon.
words.ex_cn: 这名宇航员在月球上行走。
words.en: An astronaut is a person who is trained to travel in a spacecraft.

words.tr: phrase. v. 试验；尝试；对……进行实验
words.ex: Scientists often experiment with new materials to find the best one for their needs.
words.ex_cn: 科学家经常试验新材料，以找到最适合他们需求的那种。
words.en: To try out new ideas or methods in order to see what results they produce.

words.tr: phrase. 满足人类的好奇心
words.ex: The telescope helps to satisfy human curiosity about space.
words.ex_cn: 望远镜帮助满足人类对太空的好奇心。
words.en: To fulfill or answer the desire to learn or know about something.

words.tr: phrase. 来之不易的发现；经过艰苦努力才获得的成果
words.ex: He made a hard-won discovery after ten years of research.
words.ex_cn: 经过十年的研究，他做出了一个来之不易的发现。
words.en: A discovery that was achieved with great effort, perseverance, or sacrifice.

words.tr: phrase. 太空竞赛（指20世纪美苏之间为争夺航天技术优势而展开的竞争）
words.ex: The space race began in the 1950s.
words.ex_cn: 太空竞赛始于20世纪50年代。
words.en: The competitive rivalry, especially between nations, to achieve dominance in space exploration and technology.

words.tr: phrase. 社交媒体
words.ex: He uses social media to talk with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他使用社交媒体和朋友聊天。
words.en: Websites and applications that enable users to create and share content or to participate in social networking.

words.tr: phrase. 与…互动；与…相互作用；与…交流

words.ex_cn: 孩子们在学校里互相交流。
words.en: To communicate or engage with someone, often in a social or professional context.

words.tr: phrase. 电子邮件欺诈；通过电子邮件进行的诈骗行为

words.ex_cn: 他因为电子邮件诈骗而损失了钱。
words.en: The use of electronic mail to deceive or defraud individuals, often for financial gain.

words.tr: phrase. 电子邮件垃圾邮件发送；指大量发送未经请求的电子邮件的行为
words.ex: E-mail spamming is a common problem for internet users.
words.ex_cn: 垃圾邮件发送是互联网用户常见的问题。
words.en: The unsolicited sending of large numbers of emails, typically for advertising or malicious purposes.

words.tr: phrase. 人工智能
words.ex: He is learning artificial intelligence at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习人工智能。
words.en: Artificial intelligence refers to the simulation of human intelligence in machines that are programmed to think like humans and mimic their actions.

words.tr: n. 高科技小装置；高科技小玩意
words.ex: He bought a high-tech gizmo to track his sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个高科技小装置来追踪他的睡眠。

words.tr: n. 超导体；超导电体
words.ex: The superconductor carries electricity without losing energy.
words.ex_cn: 超导体在传输电力时不会损失能量。
words.en: A superconductor is a material that can conduct electricity without resistance when it is cooled below a certain temperature.

words.tr: adj. 超音速的
words.ex: The jet flies at supersonic speed.
words.ex_cn: 这架喷气式飞机以超音速飞行。
words.en: relating to speeds that are faster than the speed of sound

words.tr: phrase. 被机械化的；使用机械来完成工作的
words.ex: The factory will be mechanised to increase production.
words.ex_cn: v. 工厂将被机械化以提高产量。
words.en: To be mechanised means to have machinery or mechanical devices introduced to perform tasks that were previously done by hand or by more primitive methods.

words.tr: phrase. 大量生产；批量生产
words.ex: The factory uses mass production to make cars quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂使用大规模生产来快速制造汽车。
words.en: Mass production is the manufacture of large quantities of standardized products, often using assembly lines or automated technology.

words.tr: phrase. 硅谷（美国加利福尼亚州的一个地区，以高科技产业和创新公司聚集闻名）
words.ex: He works in Silicon Valley as a software engineer.
words.ex_cn: 他在硅谷做软件工程师。
words.en: A region in California, USA, known for its high technology industry and innovation.

words.tr: phrase. 加快……的节奏或速度
words.ex: He tried to speed up the pace of his walking.
words.ex_cn: 他试图加快走路的速度。
words.en: To increase the rate or speed at which something happens or is done.

words.tr: phrase. 设定优先事项；确定优先顺序
words.ex: You need to set priorities to manage your time effectively.
words.ex_cn: 你需要设定优先级来有效管理你的时间。
words.en: To decide which tasks or problems are more important and deal with them first.

words.tr: phrase. 虚拟现实
words.ex: He is wearing a headset to experience virtual reality.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着头盔体验虚拟现实。
words.en: Virtual reality is an artificial environment that is created with software and presented to the user in such a way that the user suspends belief and accepts it as a real environment.

words.tr: adj. 高清的
words.ex: He watches movies in high-definition on his TV.
words.ex_cn: 他用电视以高清观看电影。
words.en: High-definition refers to a very detailed and clear image or sound, especially in television and video.

words.tr: 短语动词. 带来从……中解脱；使摆脱……的束缚
words.ex: The new law will bring liberation from unfair taxes.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律将带来从不公平税收中的解放。
words.en: to free someone or something from oppression or limitation

words.tr: n. 自动化
words.ex: The factory uses automation to make cars.
words.ex_cn: 工厂使用自动化来制造汽车。
words.en: The use of largely automatic equipment in a system of manufacturing or other production process.

words.tr: phrase. 提高农作物产量
words.ex: Farmers are adopting new technologies to boost crop yield.
words.ex_cn: 农民们正在采用新技术以提高作物产量。
words.en: To increase the agricultural output of a specific crop through improved methods or technology.

words.tr: phrase. 可以想象的是；可以想到的是
words.ex: It is conceivable that he will pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 可以想象他会通过考试。
words.en: It is possible or believable that.

words.tr: v. 发掘……的未开发潜力
words.ex: The company realised the untapped potential of renewable energy.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司意识到了可再生能源的未开发潜力。
words.en: To recognize and make use of the full, unused capabilities of something.

words.us: sʌm ˈsaɪəntɪfɪk ˈɛvɪdəns hæz ɪˈmɜːrdʒ tə ðə ˈkɑːntrəri

words.en: Evidence has been found that contradicts a previous claim or belief.

words.ex_cn: 有大量证据表明吸烟会导致肺癌。
words.en: There is a substantial amount of evidence that indicates.

words.tr: v. 维护网络安全
words.ex: The government must uphold security of cyberspace to protect citizens.
words.ex_cn: 政府必须维护网络安全以保护公民。

words.tr: n. 移动应用程序
words.ex: He downloaded a mobile application to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 他下载了一个移动应用程序来学习英语。
words.en: A software program designed to run on mobile devices like smartphones or tablets.

words.tr: n. 数字新媒体；指以数字技术为基础的新型传播媒介，如社交媒体、网络视频、移动应用等
words.ex: She works in digital new media, creating videos for social media.
words.ex_cn: 她从事数字新媒体工作，为社交媒体制作视频。

words.tr: phrase. 尖端技术
words.ex: This company uses cutting-edge technology to make phones.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司使用尖端技术来制造手机。
words.en: Cutting-edge technology refers to the latest and most advanced technology available in a particular field.

words.tr: phrase. 最先进的技术；尖端科技
words.ex: The company invested heavily in state-of-the-art technology to stay competitive.
words.ex_cn: 为了保持竞争力，该公司在尖端技术上投入了大量资金。
words.en: The most recent stage in the development of a product, incorporating the newest ideas and features.

words.tr: phrase. 在线学习
words.ex: He uses e-learning to study math at home.
words.ex_cn: 他使用在线学习在家学习数学。
words.en: E-learning refers to the use of electronic technologies to access educational curriculum outside of a traditional classroom.

words.tr: n. 电讯家庭办公；在家办公；
words.ex: He likes telecommuting because he can work from home.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢电讯家庭办公，因为他可以在家工作。
words.en: Telecommuting refers to the practice of working from home or another remote location, using the internet, email, and the telephone to communicate with the office.

words.tr: n. 智能移动设备
words.ex: He uses an intelligent mobile device to check the weather.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个智能移动设备查看天气。

words.tr: n. 可穿戴设备
words.ex: He uses a wearable device to count his steps every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天使用可穿戴设备来计步。

words.tr: phrase. 智能家居系统：一种通过互联网连接并自动化控制家庭设备（如照明、温控、安防等）的集成系统
words.ex: The smart home system allows you to control your lights, thermostat, and security cameras from your smartphone.
words.ex_cn: 智能家居系统允许你通过智能手机控制灯光、恒温器和安全摄像头。
words.en: A smart home system is a convenient home setup where appliances and devices can be automatically controlled remotely from anywhere with an internet connection using a mobile or other networked device.

words.tr: v. 改革；创新；
words.ex: The company wants to innovate its production process.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司想改革它的生产流程。
words.en: To innovate means to introduce changes and new ideas in the way something is done or made.

words.tr:
v. 利用；
n. 马具；

words.ex_cn: 我们必须利用太阳的能量。
words.en: A harness is a set of straps which fit under a person's arms and fasten round their body in order to keep a piece of equipment in place or to prevent the person moving from a place.

words.us: ˈɪntɪɡreɪt ˌtrædɪˈʃənəl ˈsɛktərz wɪð laɪv ˈstriːmɪŋ ˈmiːdiə

words.tr: phrase. 提高效率
words.ex: Implementing new software can boost efficiency in the workplace.
words.ex_cn: 实施新软件可以提高工作场所的效率。
words.en: To increase the efficiency or effectiveness of something.

words.tr: phrase. 促进沟通；使交流更顺畅
words.ex: A good teacher can facilitate communication in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 一位好老师可以在课堂上促进交流。
words.en: To make it easier for people to exchange information or ideas.

words.tr: v. 提高人们的生活质量
words.ex: Clean water and good schools can enhance people's quality of life.
words.ex_cn: 干净的水和良好的学校可以提高人们的生活质量。

words.tr: v. 打破地理障碍

words.ex_cn: 互联网帮助人们打破地理障碍。

words.tr: v. 简化日常任务；使日常事务更高效

words.ex_cn: 这个应用可能对隐私构成威胁。

words.tr: v. 导致对技术的过度依赖

words.tr: v. 导致久坐不动的生活方式
words.ex: Too much screen time can give rise to a sedentary lifestyle.
words.ex_cn: 过多的屏幕时间可能导致久坐不动的生活方式。

words.tr: v. 削弱面对面的沟通能力

words.ex: Too much screen time can erode face-to-face communication skills.
words.ex_cn: 过多的屏幕时间会削弱面对面的沟通能力。

words.tr: v. 产生信息过载；使信息量超出处理能力
words.ex: Too many emails can generate information overload.
words.ex_cn: 太多邮件会导致信息过载。

words.tr: phrase. 获得动力
words.ex: The car starts to gain momentum going down the hill.
words.ex_cn: 汽车下山时开始加速。
words.en: To gain momentum means to start to happen or develop more quickly, or to become more popular or successful.

words.tr: v. 飞速前进；急剧发展
words.ex: Technology is advancing by leaps and bounds.
words.ex_cn: 技术正在飞速前进。

words.tr: phrase. 在上升，在增加
words.ex: Prices are on the rise.
words.ex_cn: 价格正在上涨。
words.en: To be increasing in amount, number, or level.

words.tr: phrase. 信息茧房；指人们在信息获取过程中，由于个人兴趣、习惯等因素，只选择与自己观点相符的信息，从而形成的一种封闭的信息环境。
words.ex: In the era of personalized recommendation, people are more likely to be trapped in an information cocoon.
words.ex_cn: 在个性化推荐的时代，人们更容易陷入信息茧房。

words.tr: n. 网络暴力；网络欺凌
words.ex: Many teenagers face cyber violence on social media.
words.ex_cn: 许多青少年在社交媒体上遭受网络暴力。

words.tr: n.假日游客
words.ex: Many holidaymakers visit the beach in summer.
words.ex_cn: 许多度假者在夏天去海滩。
words.en: People who are on holiday, especially those who are away from home.

words.tr: phrase. 预订航班
words.ex: She decided to book a flight to Paris for her vacation.
words.ex_cn: 她决定为她的假期预订一张去巴黎的机票。
words.en: To arrange and secure a seat on an airplane for a specific journey, typically through an airline or travel agent.

words.tr: phrase. 蜂拥至…；涌进（向）…
words.ex: Tourists flock to the beach in summer.
words.ex_cn: 游客在夏天涌向海滩。
words.en: If people flock to a place or event, they go there in large numbers because it is interesting or attractive.

words.tr: phrase. 带薪休假；带薪假期
words.ex: He got a paid holiday last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天得到了有薪假期。
words.en: Paid time off from work granted to an employee, often for vacation, personal reasons, or public holidays.

words.tr: n. 背包客
words.ex: The backpacker walked through the mountains with a big bag.
words.ex_cn: 那个背包客背着一个大包穿越了山脉。
words.en: A backpacker is someone who travels or hikes carrying their belongings in a backpack.

words.tr: n. 纪念品；纪念物；
words.ex: I bought a souvenir from the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我从海边买了一个纪念品。
words.en: A souvenir is something which you buy or keep to remind you of a holiday, place, or event.

words.tr: v. 展览；陈列；展示；
words.ex: The museum will exhibit ancient coins next month.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆下个月将展览古钱币。
words.en: To exhibit something means to show it in a public place so that people can go to see it. It can also mean to show a particular quality, ability, or type of behavior.

words.tr: phrase. 旅行社
words.ex: He booked his flight through a travel agency.
words.ex_cn: 他通过一家旅行社预订了航班。
words.en: A travel agency is a business that helps people plan and book trips and vacations.

words.tr: phrase. 跟团旅行
words.ex: We booked a package tour to Japan last month.
words.ex_cn: 我们上个月预订了一次去日本的跟团旅行。
words.en: A package tour is a holiday organized by a travel agent, with arrangements for transport, accommodation, and sometimes meals and entertainment, all included in the price.

words.tr: phrase. 旺季
words.ex: Tourists visit the beach in peak season.
words.ex_cn: 游客在旺季去海滩。
words.en: The period of the year when demand for a particular product or service is at its highest.

words.tr: phrase. 淡季
words.ex: The shop is quiet during the slack season.
words.ex_cn: 在淡季，商店很安静。
words.en: A period of time when business or activity is less busy than usual.

words.tr: n. 喷气式航空公司
words.ex: She booked a flight with a jet airline for her trip to Paris.
words.ex_cn: 她为去巴黎的旅行预订了一家喷气式航空公司的航班。

words.tr: phrase. 飞行时差反应；时差感
words.ex: He feels tired because of jet lag.
words.ex_cn: 他因为时差而感到疲倦。
words.en: A temporary disorder that causes fatigue, insomnia, and other symptoms as a result of rapid travel across several time zones.

words.tr: v. 商业化，使商业化：组织或改变以追求盈利。
words.ex: The festival became commercialised after big brands joined.
words.ex_cn: 大品牌加入后，这个节日变得商业化了。
words.en: Made something available for commercial purposes; turned into a business opportunity.

words.w: make sb. more tolerant and open-minded

words.tr: 短语动词. 令人开眼界的；使人突然意识到真相或现实的

words.ex_cn: 这部纪录片关于贫困的内容令人震惊。
words.en: To provide a surprising or enlightening experience that changes one's perspective.

words.tr: phrase. 消除先入之见；去除偏见或预先形成的观念
words.ex: Try to eliminate preconceptions when you meet new people.
words.ex_cn: 当你遇见新人时，试着消除先入之见。
words.en: To remove or get rid of preconceived ideas or opinions.

words.tr: phrase. 确认某人的偏见；使某人原有的偏见得到证实
words.ex: The false report confirmed his prejudice against the group.
words.ex_cn: 这份虚假报道证实了他对该群体的偏见。
words.en: Strengthen someone's existing biased or prejudiced views.

words.tr: phrase. 缓解紧张；减轻压力
words.ex: She sings to ease tension after work.
words.ex_cn: 她唱歌来缓解工作后的紧张。
words.en: Reduce feelings of hostility or nervousness between people or in a situation.

words.tr: phrase. 深化相互理解
words.ex: Cultural exchanges can deepen mutual understanding between countries.
words.ex_cn: 文化交流可以深化国家之间的相互理解。
words.en: To enhance the level of understanding between parties involved.

words.tr: 被认作是冒犯性的；被认为具有冒犯意味的
words.ex: That joke is considered to be offensive by many people.
words.ex_cn: 很多人认为这个笑话是冒犯性的。
words.en: Be regarded as insulting, disrespectful, or hurtful to others.

words.tr: 短语动词. 产生税收收入
words.ex: The new store will generate tax revenue for the city.
words.ex_cn: 这家新商店将为城市产生税收收入。
words.en: Produce income for the government through taxes.

words.tr: phrase. 招致额外费用；产生额外成本
words.ex: He incurred additional costs by buying extra parts.
words.ex_cn: 他因为购买了额外的零件而产生了额外费用。
words.en: Bring about extra expenses or financial burdens.

words.tr: phrase. 游览胜地
words.ex: The Great Wall is a famous tourist attraction.
words.ex_cn: 长城是一个著名的游览胜地。
words.en: A place of interest where tourists visit, typically for its inherent or exhibited natural or cultural value, historical significance, natural or built beauty, offering leisure, adventure, and amusement.

words.tr: n. 游客目的地
words.ex: Paris is a popular tourists destination.
words.ex_cn: 巴黎是一个受欢迎的旅游目的地。

words.tr: 短语动词. 出发；上路；开始旅行
words.ex: He hit the road early to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他早早上路以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To begin a journey or to leave a place to go somewhere else.

words.tr: phrase. 留在原地；逗留不走
words.ex: He decided to stick around until the meeting was over.
words.ex_cn: 他决定留下来直到会议结束。
words.en: To remain in a place or situation, especially while waiting for something to happen or someone to arrive.

words.tr: phrase. 离开常规路线；探索人迹罕至之地；尝试非传统或冒险的事物
words.ex: They decided to venture off the beaten path to find a quiet beach.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定离开常规路线，去找一个安静的海滩。
words.en: To take a risk by doing something different or unusual, especially in travel or exploration.

words.en: In a very remote or isolated place, far from towns or civilization.

words.tr: n. 路线；
words.ex: We planned our itinerary before the trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们在旅行前规划了路线。
words.en: An itinerary is a plan of a journey, including the route and the places that you will visit.

words.tr: n. 行李
words.ex: He packed his luggage before the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他在旅行前收拾好了行李。
words.en: Luggage consists of the suitcases and bags that you take with you when you travel.

words.tr: phrase. 轻装上阵；轻装旅行
words.ex: He travels light with just a backpack.
words.ex_cn: 他只带一个背包轻装旅行。
words.en: To travel with minimal luggage or belongings, making movement and exploration easier.

words.tr: phrase. 剧烈的运动；需要大量体力的体育活动
words.ex: He avoids strenuous sports because he has a weak heart.
words.ex_cn: 他避免剧烈运动，因为他心脏不好。
words.en: Requiring great physical effort and exertion; demanding sports.

words.tr: n. 枯竭；耗尽；筋疲力尽；
words.ex: The long hike led to his exhaustion.
words.ex_cn: 长时间的徒步旅行导致他筋疲力尽。
words.en: A state of extreme physical or mental tiredness.

words.tr: n. 耐力；
words.ex: He built his endurance by running every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天早晨跑步来增强耐力。
words.en: The ability to endure an unpleasant or difficult process or situation without giving up.

words.tr: 短语动词. 增强耐力；提高体力
words.ex: Regular exercise helps to build up stamina.
words.ex_cn: 定期锻炼有助于增强耐力。
words.en: To increase physical or mental endurance through practice or training.

words.tr: phrase. 有氧运动；指通过持续、有节奏的身体活动来增强心肺功能的锻炼方式，如跑步、游泳、骑自行车等
words.ex: He does aerobic exercise every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上做有氧运动。
words.en: Physical activity that increases the heart rate and improves the body's use of oxygen, typically performed over a prolonged period.

words.tr: phrase. 燃烧卡路里，消耗热量
words.ex: He runs every morning to burn calories.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑步来燃烧卡路里。
words.en: To burn calories means to use energy by doing physical activity, which can help in weight loss or maintaining a healthy weight.

words.tr: phrase. 体育赛事；运动项目比赛
words.ex: The city is hosting a major sports event next month.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市下个月将举办一场大型体育赛事。
words.en: A sports event is an organized competition or activity involving physical exertion and skill, typically involving teams or individuals competing against each other.

words.tr: phrase. 激烈的竞争；强劲的角逐
words.ex: There is fierce competition for the job.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作竞争非常激烈。
words.en: Intense rivalry for limited opportunities or positions.

words.tr: phrase. 运动天赋；体育才能
words.ex: He has great athletic talent.
words.ex_cn: 他有很强的运动天赋。
words.en: Natural aptitude or ability for physical sports or exercise.

words.tr: adj. 破纪录的
words.ex: The athlete's record-breaking performance won him a gold medal.
words.ex_cn: adj. 这位运动员破纪录的表现为他赢得了一枚金牌。
words.en: Achieving a better performance or result than ever before.

words.tr: phrase. 发泄某人精力的途径；一种让人释放能量的方式
words.ex: Running is an outlet for one's energy.
words.ex_cn: 跑步是发泄精力的一种方式。
words.en: A means of releasing or expressing one's energy or emotions.

words.tr: phrase. 发泄情绪；宣泄精力；释放压力
words.ex: He runs every day to let off steam.
words.ex_cn: 他每天跑步来发泄情绪。
words.en: If you let off steam, you get rid of your energy, anger, or strong emotions by doing something active or noisy.

words.tr: adj. 势均力敌的
words.ex: The two teams were evenly-matched, making the game very exciting.
words.ex_cn: adj. 两支队伍势均力敌，使得比赛非常精彩。
words.en: adj. If two people or teams are evenly-matched, they are equally strong or skilled.

words.tr: v. 支配；
words.ex: He dominates the conversation.
words.ex_cn: 他主宰了谈话。
words.en: To dominate means to control or govern someone or something, or to be the most important or noticeable feature of something.

words.tr: phrase. （尤指戏剧、电影或小说的）悬念结局，扣人心弦的结尾；令人焦急等待后续发展的情节
words.ex: The movie ended with a cliffhanger.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影以一个悬念结尾。
words.en: A suspenseful ending to a story or episode that leaves the audience eager to know what happens next.

words.tr: phrase. 可预测的；可预料的
words.ex: His behavior is predictable.
words.ex_cn: 他的行为是可以预测的。
words.en: To behave or occur in a way that can be foreseen or expected.

words.tr: n. 团队合作；
words.ex: Good teamwork helps the group finish the project faster.
words.ex_cn: 良好的团队合作帮助小组更快地完成项目。
words.en: The combined action of a group of people, especially when effective and efficient.

words.tr: phrase. 团队精神
words.ex: The team showed great team spirit during the match.
words.ex_cn: 比赛期间，团队展现了极强的团队精神。
words.en: Team spirit refers to the feelings of camaraderie and enthusiasm for the group that one is part of, especially in a sports team or workplace.

words.tr: n. 板球；蟋蟀
words.ex: He plays cricket every weekend with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都和朋友们打板球。
words.en: Cricket is a sport played between two teams of eleven players each, using a bat and ball, on a field with a wicket at each end.

words.tr: phrase. 赛马；跑马比赛
words.ex: Horse racing is a popular sport in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 赛马是许多国家的一项流行运动。
words.en: A sport in which horses race against each other, often with jockeys riding them.

words.tr: phrase. 良好的体育精神；指在比赛中表现出尊重、公平、谦虚和礼貌的态度
words.ex: He showed good sportsmanship after losing the game.
words.ex_cn: 他在输掉比赛后展现了良好的体育精神。
words.en: Good sportsmanship refers to the ethical, appropriate, and polite behavior exhibited by participants in sports or other competitive activities.

words.tr: n. 足球流氓
words.ex: The police arrested some football hooligans after the match.
words.ex_cn: 比赛后，警察逮捕了一些足球流氓。

words.tr: n. 卫生；卫生学；
words.ex: Good hygiene helps prevent sickness.
words.ex_cn: 良好的卫生有助于预防疾病。
words.en: Hygiene refers to conditions and practices that help to maintain health and prevent the spread of diseases.

words.tr: phrase. 烹饪用具；厨具
words.ex: She carefully selected the best cooking utensils for her new kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 她为她的新厨房精心挑选了最好的炊具。
words.en: Tools or containers used in the preparation of food.

words.tr: adj. 有营养的；滋养的；
words.ex: Eating fruits and vegetables is nutritious.
words.ex_cn: 吃水果和蔬菜是有营养的。
words.en: Nutritious food contains substances which help your body to be healthy.

words.tr: phrase. 良好的营养；合理的膳食
words.ex: He eats good nutrition to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他吃有营养的食物来保持健康。
words.en: A diet that provides all the necessary nutrients for health.

words.tr: v. 养肥（fatten 的现在分词）; adj. 使人发胖的；正被养肥的；用于养肥禽畜的
words.ex: Sugary snacks are fattening.
words.ex_cn: 甜点心容易让人发胖。
words.en: Making or becoming fat or fatter.

words.tr: 短语动词. 正当令的；正当时节的（指水果、蔬菜等在自然成熟的季节中，供应充足且价格较低）
words.ex: Strawberries are in season now, so they are cheaper.
words.ex_cn: v. 草莓现在正当时令，所以更便宜。
words.en: If a food is in season, it is the time of year when it is naturally available and ready to eat.

words.tr: 短语动词. 不在当季；过时的；不合时宜的
words.ex: The strawberries are out of season now.
words.ex_cn: 现在草莓不是应季的。
words.en: To be out of season means to be outside the usual time of year for a particular activity, product, or event.

words.tr: phrase. 食物供应；食品储备
words.ex: The storm damaged the food supplies.
words.ex_cn: 风暴破坏了食物补给。
words.en: Food supplies are the stocks of food available for consumption, especially in a household, community, or for emergencies.

words.tr: phrase. 速冻食品
words.ex: He bought some frozen food from the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 他从超市买了些速冻食品。
words.en: Frozen food refers to food that has been subjected to rapid freezing and is kept frozen until use, preserving it from the time of preparation to the time of consumption.

words.tr: phrase. 罐头食品
words.ex: He eats canned food for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃罐头食品。
words.en: Food that has been processed and sealed in a can or jar to preserve it.

words.tr: phrase. 电视餐；即食冷冻餐，通常在看电视时食用
words.ex: He ate a tv dinner while watching his favorite show.
words.ex_cn: 他一边看最喜欢的节目，一边吃电视餐。
words.en: A pre-packaged meal consisting of frozen food components that are heated before eating.

words.tr: n. 茶点和饮料；
words.ex: We had a snack and some drinks as refreshment after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议结束后，我们吃了点心和喝了一些饮料作为茶点。
words.en: Refreshment refers to the act of refreshing or the state of being refreshed, especially by food or drink. It can also mean a light meal or drinks served in a social setting.

words.tr: phrase. 健康的饮食；有益健康的膳食
words.ex: Eating a wholesome diet helps you stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 吃健康的饮食有助于你保持健康。
words.en: A wholesome diet refers to a way of eating that contributes to overall health and well-being, typically including a variety of nutrients from different food groups.

words.tr: phrase. 不健康的饮食
words.ex: He has an unhealthy diet because he eats too much junk food.
words.ex_cn: 他饮食不健康，因为他吃太多垃圾食品。
words.en: A pattern of eating that lacks essential nutrients and harms health.

words.tr: adj. 油污的；多油的；
words.ex: The greasy pan needed a good wash.
words.ex_cn: 这个油污的平底锅需要好好洗一洗。
words.en: Something that is greasy has a lot of grease or oil on it or in it.

words.tr: phrase. 减少；节省
words.ex: He wants to cut down on sugar to be healthier.
words.ex_cn: 他想减少糖的摄入来更健康。
words.en: To reduce the amount or number of something.

words.tr: n. 摄入量；
words.ex: The doctor checked his daily intake of sugar.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他每天的糖摄入量。
words.en: The process of taking something in, especially food, air, or information.

words.tr: phrase. 沉迷于快餐的人；快餐成瘾者
words.ex: He is a fast food junkie who eats burgers every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是个快餐迷，每天都吃汉堡。
words.en: A person who is very fond of or addicted to fast food.

words.tr: phrase. 碳酸饮料；含气饮料
words.ex: He drinks carbonated drinks every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都喝碳酸饮料。
words.en: Carbonated drinks are beverages that contain dissolved carbon dioxide gas, creating bubbles and a fizzy sensation.

words.tr: phrase. 饮食习惯；指个人或群体在日常饮食中的偏好和规律
words.ex: His dietary habits changed after he got sick.
words.ex_cn: 他生病后，饮食习惯发生了变化。
words.en: Dietary habits are the regular patterns of eating and drinking that a person or group follows.

words.tr: phrase. 饮食失调
words.ex: He has an eating disorder and needs help.
words.ex_cn: 他有饮食失调，需要帮助。
words.en: An eating disorder is a mental disorder defined by abnormal eating habits that negatively affect a person's physical or mental health.

words.tr: phrase. 微量元素；痕量元素（指生物体或物质中含量极微但具有重要生理或化学作用的元素）
words.ex: Plants need trace elements to grow well.
words.ex_cn: 植物需要微量元素才能良好生长。
words.en: Trace elements are minerals required by the body in very small amounts for normal physiological functions.

words.tr: adj. 蛋白质丰富的
words.ex: Eggs are protein-rich foods.
words.ex_cn: 鸡蛋是富含蛋白质的食物。
words.en: Protein-rich describes food that contains a high amount of protein, a nutrient essential for building and repairing tissues.

words.tr: phrase. 爱吃甜品
words.ex: She has a sweet tooth and eats candy every day.
words.ex_cn: 她爱吃甜食，每天都要吃糖果。
words.en: If you have a sweet tooth, you like eating sweet foods, especially sweets and chocolate.

words.tr: phrase. 成为美食家；对美食有高雅品味的人
words.ex: He is a gourmet who loves fine cheese.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个热爱优质奶酪的美食家。
words.en: To have a refined and sophisticated taste in food and drink, often implying expertise and appreciation.

words.tr: phrase. 令人垂涎的
words.ex: The aroma of the freshly baked bread was mouth-watering.
words.ex_cn: 新鲜出炉的面包的香气令人垂涎。
words.en: If you describe food as mouth-watering, you mean that it looks or smells extremely delicious.

words.tr: phrase. 令人作呕的；令人厌恶的；极不愉快的
words.ex: The smell from the trash is disgusting.
words.ex_cn: 垃圾的气味很恶心。
words.en: To cause a strong feeling of disgust or revulsion, making someone feel physically or emotionally repelled.

words.tr: phrase. 弹出式广告窗口；网页中自动弹出的小广告框
words.ex: The website showed many pop-up advertising windows.
words.ex_cn: 这个网站显示了许多弹出式广告窗口。
words.en: Pop-up advertising windows are small, unsolicited browser windows that appear suddenly to display advertisements.

words.tr: phrase. 广告时段；广告位
words.ex: The company bought the advertising slot during the prime time to promote its new product.
words.ex_cn: 该公司购买了黄金时段的广告时段来推广其新产品。
words.en: A specific time or space allocated for advertising purposes, especially in broadcasting or online media.

words.tr: 被广泛地、高强度地宣传或广告推广
words.ex: The new product will be intensively advertised to ensure its success in the market.
words.ex_cn: 新产品将被密集地广告宣传，以确保其在市场上的成功。
words.en: Heavily promoted through concentrated marketing efforts.

words.tr: phrase. 广告宣传活动
words.ex: The company launched a new advertising campaign last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司上个月推出了一项新的广告活动。
words.en: A planned series of advertisements intended to achieve a particular aim.

words.tr:
n. 高峰；顶峰；
v. 达到高峰；达到最高值；
words.ex: The mountain peak is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 这座山的高峰被雪覆盖。
words.en: The highest point or level of something; the pointed top of a mountain.

words.tr: phrase. 紧紧地盯住，全神贯注于（某事物）
words.ex: The boy is glued to the TV screen.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩紧盯着电视屏幕。
words.en: To be fixed or attached firmly to something, or to be very interested in something and not want to stop doing or watching it.

words.tr: adj. 信息灵通的；了解情况的
phrase. 破坏某人的乐趣；扫某人的兴
words.ex: The loud noise spoiled his enjoyment of the movie.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音破坏了他看电影的乐趣。
words.en: To diminish or ruin the pleasure one derives from an activity or experience.

words.tr: phrase. 激起某人做某事的愿望；引起某人的欲望
words.ex: The movie aroused his desire to travel the world.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影激发了他环游世界的愿望。
words.en: To stimulate someone's wish or longing for something.

words.tr: phrase. 老生常谈的主题；被过度使用而显得陈旧的题材
words.ex: The movie uses well-worn themes like love and betrayal.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影使用了诸如爱情和背叛这样的老套主题。
words.en: Overused ideas or topics that have lost their original impact.

words.tr: phrase. 陈腐的题材；老生常谈的主题
words.ex: The novel avoids hackneyed subjects and instead explores new themes.
words.ex_cn: 这部小说避免了陈腐的主题，而是探索了新的主题。
words.en: Clichéd or unoriginal subjects that lack freshness.

words.tr: phrase. 时事；当前发生的重大事件
words.ex: He reads the newspaper to learn about current affairs.
words.ex_cn: 他读报纸来了解时事。
words.en: Current affairs are events of political or social importance and interest happening in the world at the present time.

words.tr: phrase. 媒体炒作；媒体大肆宣传
words.ex: The media hype made the movie seem more exciting than it was.
words.ex_cn: 媒体的炒作让这部电影看起来比实际更精彩。
words.en: Excessive publicity and the ensuing commotion, especially in the media, about something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 有新闻价值的事件；值得报道的事件
words.ex: The fire was a newsworthy event.
words.ex_cn: 这场火灾是一起值得报道的事件。
words.en: An event considered important enough to be reported by news media.

words.tr: phrase. 主导新闻头条；成为新闻报道的主要内容
words.ex: The scandal dominates the headlines today.
words.ex_cn: 这个丑闻今天占据了头条新闻。
words.en: To be the main focus of news coverage, often repeatedly.

words.tr: phrase. 歪曲事实；篡改真相
words.ex: He tried to distort the truth to avoid punishment.
words.ex_cn: 他试图歪曲事实以避免惩罚。
words.en: To distort the truth means to misrepresent or alter the facts in a way that is misleading or false.

words.tr: phrase. 公正的；无偏见的；不偏不倚的
words.ex: The judge must be unbiased when deciding the case.
words.ex_cn: 法官在裁决案件时必须公正无私。
words.en: To treat all sides or opinions equally, without prejudice.

words.tr:
n. 审查员；检查员
v. 检查；审查
words.ex: The censor removed the bad words from the movie.
words.ex_cn: 审查员从电影中删除了粗俗用语。
words.en: A censor is a person who supervises conduct and morals: in particular, one who examines books, films, or other material for objectionable matter.

words.tr: n. 审查；审查制度；
words.ex: The government imposed censorship on the news.
words.ex_cn: 政府对新闻实施了审查。
words.en: Censorship is the censoring of books, plays, films, or reports, especially by government officials, because they are considered immoral or secret in some way.

words.tr: phrase. 公众人物；知名人士
words.ex: Public figures often face media attention.
words.ex_cn: 公众人物经常面临媒体的关注。
words.en: Public figures are individuals who have a certain degree of fame and influence in society, often due to their profession, achievements, or public roles.

words.tr: phrase. 法庭媒体曝光；指法院案件通过媒体向公众传播和报道的现象
words.ex: The celebrity sought to avoid court media publicity after the trial.
words.ex_cn: 这位名人试图在审判后避免法庭媒体曝光。
words.en: The coverage and reporting of court proceedings by the media, aimed at informing the public but sometimes influencing perceptions and outcomes.

words.tr: phrase. 保持低调；不引人注目
words.ex: In order to avoid unwanted attention, he decided to keep a low profile.
words.ex_cn: 为了避免不必要的关注，他决定保持低调。
words.en: To avoid attracting attention or publicity; to stay out of the public eye.

words.tr: phrase. 富有魅力的；迷人的 n. 名人；名流
words.ex: She became a glamorous celebrity overnight after her performance.
words.ex_cn: 她的表演后一夜之间成为了一位富有魅力的名人。
words.en: A glamorous celebrity refers to a famous person who is very attractive and charming, often associated with the entertainment industry.

words.tr: v. 夸张；夸大；
words.ex: He exaggerates his achievements to impress others.
words.ex_cn: 他夸张自己的成就来给别人留下印象。
words.en: If you exaggerate, you indicate that something is, for example, worse or more important than it really is.

words.tr: v. 夸大某事；把某事说得过分严重
words.en: To exaggerate the importance or severity of something beyond its actual significance.

words.tr: v. 歪曲；不实报道；曲解
words.ex: He misrepresents the facts to win the debate.
words.ex_cn: 他歪曲事实以赢得辩论。
words.en: To give a false or misleading account of the nature of something.

words.tr: phrase. 逃避现实；摆脱现实生活的压力或困扰
words.ex: He watches movies to escape reality.
words.ex_cn: 他看电影来逃避现实。
words.en: To escape reality means to avoid facing the real world, often by engaging in activities that provide a distraction from real-life problems or responsibilities.

words.tr: phrase. 真人秀；纪实节目；真实秀
words.ex: The reality show became a hit overnight.
words.ex_cn: 这档真人秀节目一夜之间就火了。
words.en: A reality show is a type of television program that documents unscripted real-life situations, often featuring ordinary people instead of professional actors.

words.tr: phrase. 智力竞赛节目；问答节目
words.ex: The quiz show was a hit, attracting millions of viewers.
words.ex_cn: 这个问答节目很受欢迎，吸引了数百万观众。
words.en: A quiz show is a television or radio program in which people compete to answer questions correctly.

words.tr:
n. 全体演员；
v. 投掷；扔；投射；
words.ex: The cast of the play performed very well.
words.ex_cn: 这部剧的全体演员表演得非常好。
words.en: To cast something means to throw it forcefully in a particular direction.

words.tr: n. 电影术；电影摄影学
words.ex: The film's cinematography is beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的摄影非常美丽。
words.en: The art or technique of movie photography, including both the shooting and development of the film.

words.tr: phrase. 提前；预先

words.en: Before a particular time, or before doing a particular thing.

words.ex_cn: 我们需要为学校旅行制定一个计划。
words.en: To prepare or write out a plan or proposal, typically in a detailed or formal manner.

words.tr: phrase. 打算做某事；有意做某事；计划做某事

words.ex_cn: 我打算明天去公园。
words.en: If you intend to do something, you have decided or planned to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 一心想要；决心要得到

words.en: To have a very strong desire or determination to achieve something.

words.tr: phrase. 下决心；拿定主意

words.ex_cn: 他下定决心戒烟。
words.en: To decide something after considering it carefully.

words.tr: phrase. 对…感到矛盾的；对…有复杂情感的

words.ex_cn: 我对新校规感到矛盾。
words.en: To feel both positive and negative emotions about something.

words.tr: v. 将决定；将确定

words.ex_cn: 天气将决定我们是否去徒步。

words.ex: The trip plans are still up in the air.
words.ex_cn: 旅行计划仍然未定。

words.tr: 某人仍在两者之间犹豫不决

words.us: ɛs biː ɪz stɪl ˈweɪvərɪŋ bɪˈtwiːn

words.us: ɛs biː ˈhæz noʊ seɪ ɪn

words.tr: phrase. 还清；得到回报；取得成功
words.ex: He worked hard and finally paid off his debt.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作，终于还清了债务。
words.en: If something you have done pays off, it is successful or brings a good result.

words.tr: phrase. 结出果实；产生结果；奏效
words.ex: If you work hard, your efforts will bear fruit.
words.ex_cn: 如果你努力工作，你的努力会结出果实。
words.en: To produce a desired result or to become successful.

words.tr: adj. 富有成效的；
words.ex: The meeting was fruitful and solved many problems.
words.ex_cn: 这次会议富有成效，解决了许多问题。
words.en: Producing good or helpful results; productive.

words.tr: 谚语. 种瓜得瓜，种豆得豆；自作自受
words.ex: If you work hard, you will succeed. You reap what you sow.
words.ex_cn: 如果你努力工作，你就会成功。种瓜得瓜，种豆得豆。
words.en: This phrase means that your actions, whether good or bad, will have consequences that you will eventually experience.

words.tr: phrase. 一个千载难逢的机会；极好的机会
words.ex: This is a golden opportunity to expand our business overseas.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个拓展海外业务的黄金机会。
words.en: An exceptionally favorable or advantageous chance that is rare and valuable.

words.tr: phrase. 抓住机会
words.ex: He decided to seize the opportunity to study abroad.
words.ex_cn: 他决定抓住机会去国外学习。
words.en: To take advantage of a chance to do something.

words.tr: phrase. (事情)付诸东流，白白浪费，化为乌有
words.ex: All his hard work went down the drain when he lost his job.
words.ex_cn: 他丢了工作，所有的努力都白费了。
words.en: If something goes down the drain, it is wasted or fails to achieve anything.

words.tr: phrase. 徒劳的；白费的；没有结果的
words.ex: He tried to fix the car, but it was in vain.
words.ex_cn: 他试图修理汽车，但徒劳无功。
words.en: Without success or result; futile.

words.tr: phrase. 尽力；努力；使自己付出努力
words.ex: He exerts himself to finish the job on time.
words.ex_cn: 他努力按时完成工作。
words.en: To exert oneself means to make a physical or mental effort.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 专心致志；努力投入（工作或任务）
words.ex: He applies himself to his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上专心做作业。
words.en: To devote oneself diligently and persistently to a task or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 实现；成功；结出果实（指计划、想法等最终得以实现）
words.ex: Her dream to open a small bakery came to fruition last year.
words.ex_cn: 她开一家小面包店的梦想去年实现了。
words.en: If a plan or project comes to fruition, it is successfully completed after a period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 被抛弃；中途放弃；逐渐被遗忘或失败
words.ex: He promised to exercise daily, but his plan fell by the wayside after a week.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺每天锻炼，但一周后这个计划就放弃了。
words.en: Fail to continue with a task or plan, often due to difficulty or lack of commitment.

words.tr: phrase. 薄弱环节；最弱的一环
words.ex: The weak link in the chain broke easily.
words.ex_cn: 链条中最弱的一环很容易就断了。
words.en: A person or thing in a system that is weak and likely to cause failure.

words.w: the only fly in the ointment is
words.tr: 短语 只有的美中不足是
words.uk: ðə ˈəʊnli flaɪ ɪn ðə ˈɒntmənt ɪz
words.us: ðə ˈoʊnli flaɪ ɪn ðə ˈɑːntmənt ɪz
words.ex: The food was perfect; the only fly in the ointment is the slow service.
words.ex_cn: 食物很完美，唯一的美中不足是服务太慢。

words.tr: 短语动词. 对双方都有利或都有害；两面都有影响
words.ex: This rule can cut both ways: it helps some people but hurts others.
words.ex_cn: 这个规则可能两面都有影响：它帮助了一些人，但也伤害了其他人。
words.en: If something cuts both ways, it has both positive and negative effects or can be interpreted in two different ways.

words.tr: phrase. 一场灾难的征兆；注定失败的安排；可能导致严重后果的情况
words.ex: Mixing alcohol and driving is a recipe for disaster.
words.ex_cn: n. 酒后驾驶是灾难的预兆。
words.en: A situation or course of action that is likely to lead to failure or disaster.

words.tr: adj. 一贯正确的；
words.ex: The pope is considered infallible in matters of faith by some Catholics.
words.ex_cn: 一些天主教徒认为教皇在信仰问题上是一贯正确的。
words.en: If a person or thing is infallible, they are never wrong or never fail.

words.tr: n. 传下来的衣物；二手衣物
words.ex: He wears hand-me-downs from his older brother.
words.ex_cn: 他穿他哥哥传下来的衣服。
words.en: Clothes or other items that have been passed down from one person to another, typically within a family.

words.tr: phrase. 破烂的衣服；褴褛的衣衫
words.ex: The boy wore tattered clothing to school.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩穿着破烂的衣服去上学。
words.en: Clothing that is torn, worn, or in poor condition.

words.tr: 短语动词. 穿着得体以获得成功，指通过穿着正式或专业的服装来提升个人形象和职业成就
words.ex: You should dress for success when going to a job interview.
words.ex_cn: 去参加工作面试时，你应该穿得得体以取得成功。
words.en: To dress in a way that is intended to create a positive impression and help achieve success, especially in a professional context.

words.tr: 短语动词. 穿着舒适的衣服；为了舒适而穿衣
words.ex: She dresses for comfort on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 她在周末穿得舒服。
words.en: Choose clothing that prioritizes ease and practicality over style.

words.tr: v. 穿着品味极佳；对服装有无瑕的审美
words.ex: She always wears elegant clothes; she has impeccable taste in clothing.
words.ex_cn: 她总是穿着优雅的衣服，穿衣品味极佳。

words.tr: phrase. 一种涉及多种感官的体验；多感官体验
words.ex: The museum offers a multisensory experience for children.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆为孩子们提供了一种多感官体验。
words.en: An experience that involves multiple senses simultaneously, designed to engage participants more fully than a single-sense experience.

words.tr: adj. （事物或处所）没有生气的; 呆板的; 乏味的; （人）不懂感情的
words.ex: The movie felt soulless and boring.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影感觉没有灵魂，很无聊。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as soulless, you mean that they lack human qualities and the ability to feel or produce deep feelings.

words.tr: n. 有读写能力；识字；
words.ex: Children need literacy to read books and write letters.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们需要有读写能力才能读书和写信。
words.en: Literacy is the ability to read and write.

words.tr:
adj. 文盲的；无知的；
n. 文盲；无知识的人；
words.ex: He is illiterate and cannot read simple signs.
words.ex_cn: 他是文盲，无法阅读简单的标识。
words.en: Someone who is illiterate cannot read or write.

words.tr: phrase. 潦草的笔迹；凌乱的字迹
words.ex: His messy handwriting makes it hard to read the note.
words.ex_cn: 他凌乱的字迹让这张便条很难读懂。
words.en: Handwriting that is untidy and difficult to read.

words.tr: n. 书法；笔迹
words.ex: He practices calligraphy every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上练习书法。
words.en: Calligraphy is the art of producing decorative handwriting or lettering with a pen or brush.

words.tr: phrase. 避免打字错误；防止拼写错误
words.ex: She tries to avoid typos in her emails.
words.ex_cn: 她努力在邮件中避免拼写错误。
words.en: To prevent mistakes in writing or typing.

words.tr: phrase. 有声读物；音频书
words.ex: He listens to an audio book on his way to work.
words.ex_cn: 他上班路上听有声书。
words.en: An audio book is a recording of a book or other work being read out loud. A reading of the complete text is described as 'unabridged', while readings of a shorter version are 'abridged'.

words.tr:
adj. 多媒体的；
n. 多媒体；
words.ex: The school uses multimedia tools to teach students.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校使用多媒体工具来教学。
words.en: Multimedia is the use of computers to present text, graphics, video, animation, and sound in an integrated way.

words.tr: phrase. 社交动物；喜欢与人交往的人
words.ex: Humans are social creatures.
words.ex_cn: 人类是社会性生物。
words.en: An animal or person that lives and interacts in groups, relying on social contact.

words.tr: phrase. 喜欢社交的、外向的
phrase. 与某人交往
words.ex: It's important to socialise with colleagues to build a good work environment.
words.ex_cn: 与同事交往对营造良好的工作环境很重要。
words.en: To spend time with other people in a friendly way.

words.tr: phrase. 通信手段；交流方式；沟通工具
words.ex: Phones and emails are means of communication.
words.ex_cn: 电话和电子邮件是沟通的方式。
words.en: Means of communication refers to the methods or systems used for exchanging information or messages between people or groups.

words.tr: phrase. 沟通能力
words.ex: He improved his communication skills at work.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作中提高了沟通技能。
words.en: Communication skills refer to the ability to convey information to another effectively and efficiently.

words.tr: phrase. 充分参与；完全投入到
words.ex: He wants to participate fully in the class discussion.
words.ex_cn: 他想完全参与课堂讨论。
words.en: To take part in something completely or to the fullest extent.

words.tr: phrase. 参加；参与
words.ex: He will take part in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将参加学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: To be involved in an activity or event.

words.tr: phrase. 支持
words.ex: She is always supportive of her friends' decisions.
words.ex_cn: 她总是支持她朋友的决定。
words.en: To be supportive of someone or something means to give help or encouragement to them.

words.tr: v. 成为志同道合的人；心灵相通
phrase. 相处；进展
words.ex: I get along with my neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 我和我的邻居相处得很好。
words.en: If you get along with someone, you have a friendly relationship with them.

words.tr: v. 与……完全相反
短语. 第一印象最持久
words.ex: First impressions are most lasting.
words.ex_cn: 第一印象最持久。
words.en: The initial perception or opinion formed about someone or something tends to have a lasting impact on subsequent judgments and relationships.

words.tr: 谚语. 诚实是最好的策略；做人应以诚实为上策

words.ex: He always tells the truth because honesty is the best policy.
words.ex_cn: 他总是说真话，因为诚实是最好的策略。
words.en: A proverb advising that telling the truth is always the most advantageous course of action in the long run.

words.tr: 短语动词. 指彼此想法一致，理解相同，心意相通
words.ex: They are on the same wavelength and understand each other easily.
words.ex_cn: 他们想法一致，很容易理解对方。
words.en: To think in a similar way and to understand each other well.

words.w: do not see eye to eye with
