words.uk: dəʊ nɒt siː aɪ ə tʌɪ wɪð
words.us: doʊ nɑt si aɪ ə tɑ wɪð
words.ex: I do not see eye to eye with my brother about money.
words.ex_cn: 我和我哥哥在金钱问题上看法不同。

words.tr: phrase. 只在顺境时才做朋友的人；不能共患难的朋友
words.ex: He is a fair-weather friend who leaves when things get hard.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个只在顺境时才陪伴的朋友，一有困难就离开。
words.en: A person who is only supportive or friendly in times of success or good fortune.

words.tr: phrase. 背叛某人；在背后捅刀子（比喻暗中伤害或出卖信任自己的人）
words.ex: He stabbed his friend in the back by telling the boss the lie.
words.ex_cn: 他通过告诉老板一个谎言，背叛了朋友。
words.en: To betray someone, especially in a way that is unexpected and causes them harm.

words.w: console sb. at times of sorrow
words.tr: phrase. 在悲伤时刻安慰某人
words.ex: Her friends console her at times of sorrow.
words.ex_cn: 朋友们在她悲伤时安慰她。
words.en: To offer sympathy and comfort to someone during a period of grief or sadness.

words.tr: phrase. 欢乐与悲伤；人生的喜怒哀乐
words.ex: He feels the joys and sorrows of life every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天感受着生活的喜与悲。
words.en: The phrase 'joys and sorrows' refers to the happy and sad experiences that are part of life.

words.w: compete on a level playing field
words.tr: 短语. 在公平的条件下竞争；在平等的竞争环境中较量
words.uk: kəmˈpiːt ɒn ə ˈlev(ə)l ˈpleɪɪŋ fiːld
words.us: kəmˈpiːt ɑːn ə ˈlev(ə)l ˈpleɪɪŋ fiːld
words.ex: All companies should compete on a level playing field.
words.ex_cn: 所有公司都应在公平的环境中竞争。
words.en: To compete in a situation where everyone has an equal chance of winning or succeeding.

words.tr: phrase. 光明正大地；堂堂正正地
words.ex: He won the game fair and square.
words.ex_cn: 他公平合理地赢得了比赛。
words.en: If you say that someone won a competition fair and square, you mean that they won honestly and without cheating.

words.tr: phrase. v. 变得过于兴奋或激动而失去控制；忘乎所以；得意忘形
words.ex: He got carried away with the game and forgot to eat dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他玩游戏玩得忘了吃晚饭。
words.en: If you get carried away, you are so excited or involved in something that you do something hasty or foolish.

words.tr: phrase. 保持冷静；保持镇定
words.ex: It's important to keep calm in stressful situations.
words.ex_cn: 在压力大的情况下保持冷静是很重要的。
words.en: To remain calm and not become agitated or upset.

words.tr: v. 爱慕；敬慕；崇拜
words.ex: She adores her little brother.
words.ex_cn: 她非常喜爱她的弟弟。
words.en: If you adore someone, you feel great love and admiration for them.

words.tr: phrase. 对……充满热情的；热爱……的
words.ex_cn: 他热衷于打篮球。
words.en: To have a very strong interest in or enthusiasm for something.

words.tr: adj. 热衷的；
words.ex: He is an avid reader of mystery novels.
words.ex_cn: 他热衷于阅读侦探小说。
words.en: If you say that someone is avid for something, you mean that they are very eager to get it.

words.tr: phrase. 渴望拥有，对……有强烈的向往
words.ex: He has a yearning for adventure.
words.ex_cn: 他渴望冒险。
words.en: to have a strong desire or longing for something

words.tr: phrase. 渴望；非常想得到（某物），尤指食物或某种体验
words.ex: He has a craving for chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 他很想吃巧克力。
words.en: to have an intense desire for something, especially food

words.tr: phrase. 优越于；胜过；不屈服于
words.ex: This phone is superior to that one.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机比那部更好。
words.en: To be better or higher in quality, rank, or status than someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 喜爱；喜欢
words.ex: He is fond of playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢踢足球。
words.en: To have a liking or affection for someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 相当喜欢；颇有好感
words.ex: He quite likes ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 他很喜欢冰淇淋。
words.en: To like or enjoy something to a moderate degree.

words.tr: phrase. 对…漠不关心的；对…无动于衷的
words.ex_cn: 他对噪音毫不在意。
words.en: To have no particular interest or sympathy; unconcerned.

words.tr: n. 偏好；
words.ex: He has a preference for tea over coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: A preference is a greater liking for one alternative over another or others.

words.tr: phrase. 关心；挂念
words.ex: She is concerned about her son's health.
words.ex_cn: 她担心她儿子的健康。
words.en: To be worried or anxious about something or someone.

words.tr: v. 不喜欢
words.ex: He dislikes eating broccoli.
words.ex_cn: 他不喜欢吃西兰花。
words.en: If you dislike someone or something, you consider them to be unpleasant and do not like them.

words.tr: phrase. 对…有强烈的厌恶或反感
words.ex: He has a strong aversion to spicy food.
words.ex_cn: 他非常讨厌辛辣食物。
words.en: To feel a deep and intense dislike or repulsion towards someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 不情愿做某事；勉强去做
words.ex_cn: 他不愿意在全班面前说话。
words.en: If you are reluctant to do something, you are unwilling to do it and hesitate before doing it, or do it slowly and without enthusiasm.

words.tr: v. 无法忍受；不能容忍（某人或某事）
words.ex: I cannot stand loud noises.
words.ex_cn: 我无法忍受巨大的噪音。

words.tr: v. 厌恶；憎恶
words.ex: I loathe waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 我讨厌早起。
words.en: If you loathe something or someone, you dislike them very much.

words.tr: phrase. 自力更生的；依靠自己的；独立自主的
words.ex: He learned to be self-reliant after moving out of his parents' house.
words.ex_cn: 搬出父母家后，他学会了自力更生。
words.en: To be self-reliant means to rely on one's own powers and resources rather than those of others.

words.tr: adj. 自给自足的；能独立维持自己生活的
words.ex: He wants to be self-sufficient by growing his own food.
words.ex_cn: 他想通过自己种食物来实现自给自足。
words.en: Be able to provide for one's own needs without external assistance.

words.tr: 短语. 成功靠自己奋斗的人；白手起家的人
words.ex: He be a self-made man who started with nothing.
words.ex_cn: 他是个白手起家的人，最初一无所有。
words.en: A man who has achieved success through his own efforts, without inherited wealth or privilege.

words.tr: phrase. 表现出主动性；主动采取行动
words.ex: He shows initiative by helping others without being asked.
words.ex_cn: 他主动帮助别人，表现出积极性。
words.en: Display the ability to assess and initiate tasks independently without being told.

words.w: do sth. of one's own accord
words.tr: phr. 自愿做某事；主动做某事（without being forced or persuaded）
words.uk: duː sʌmθɪŋ ɒv wʌns oʊn əˈkɔːd
words.us: duː sʌmθɪŋ ʌv wʌnz oʊn əˈkɔːrd
words.ex: He left the job of his own accord.
words.ex_cn: 他自愿离开了那份工作。
words.en: Act voluntarily, without being asked or forced.

words.tr: phrase. 顽强的；坚韧不拔的；固执的
words.ex: He is tenacious and never gives up.
words.ex_cn: 他坚持不懈，从不放弃。
words.en: To be persistent and determined in the face of difficulty.

words.tr: n. 毅力；
words.ex: His perseverance helped him finish the marathon.
words.ex_cn: 他的毅力帮助他完成了马拉松。
words.en: Perseverance is the quality of continuing to try to achieve a particular aim despite difficulties.

words.tr: n. 意志力；毅力；
words.ex: He lost weight by using his willpower.
words.ex_cn: 他凭借意志力减掉了体重。
words.en: Willpower is the ability to control yourself and to make yourself do things that are difficult or unpleasant.

words.tr: phrase. 遵守诺言；守信用
words.ex: He keeps his word and always does what he promises.
words.ex_cn: 他信守诺言，总是做他承诺过的事情。
words.en: To do what one has promised to do.

words.tr: phrase. 正直的公民；品行端正的市民
words.ex: He is an upright citizen who always follows the law.
words.ex_cn: 他是个正直的公民，总是遵守法律。
words.en: A person who is honest, moral, and follows the law.

words.tr: phrase. 保持某人的正直；维护某人的品格完整
words.ex: He refused the money to preserve his integrity.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝了那笔钱，以保持自己的正直。
words.en: To maintain one's moral principles and honesty, especially under pressure.

words.tr: phrase. 务实的；实事求是的
words.ex: She's very down-to-earth and doesn't care about fancy titles.
words.ex_cn: 她非常务实，不在乎花哨的头衔。
words.en: If you say that someone is down-to-earth, you approve of the fact that they concern themselves with practical things and actions, rather than with abstract theories.

words.tr: phrase. 非常艺术的；过分追求艺术感的；矫揉造作的
words.ex: He is very arty and loves painting every day.
words.ex_cn: 他非常有艺术气质，喜欢每天画画。
words.en: To behave or appear in a way that is very artistic or pretentiously artistic.

words.tr: phrase. 为某事设立标准；树立典范
words.ex: This company set the benchmark for customer service.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司为客户服务设立了标准。
words.en: To establish the standard or level of excellence that others must meet.

words.tr: phrase. 崇拜某人；敬仰某人
words.ex: He worships his father.
words.ex_cn: 他崇拜他的父亲。
words.en: To admire or love someone deeply, often with great respect or devotion.

words.tr: phrase. 亲自与某人见面；当面会见某人
words.ex: I want to meet my friend in person next week.
words.ex_cn: 我想下周亲自见我的朋友。
words.en: To meet someone face-to-face rather than through any other means of communication.

words.tr: phrase. 文艺复兴时期的人；多才多艺的人
words.ex: Leonardo da Vinci was a renaissance man who painted, invented, and studied nature.
words.ex_cn: 列奥纳多·达·芬奇是一个文艺复兴时期的人，他会绘画、发明并研究自然。
words.en: A Renaissance man is a person who is skilled in many different areas of knowledge or activity, especially in the arts and sciences.

words.tr: phrase. 多才多艺的；用途广泛的；可适应多种功能的
words.ex: He can play guitar, paint, and code—he is versatile.
words.ex_cn: 他会弹吉他、画画和编程——他多才多艺。
words.en: Able to adapt to many different functions or activities.

words.tr: phrase. 具有艺术性的；有艺术天赋的；富有创造力的
words.ex: She loves to be artistic in her approach to teaching.
words.ex_cn: v. 她在教学方法上喜欢有艺术性。
words.en: To have or show skill in the arts, especially in creating beautiful or expressive things.

words.tr: adj. 世界知名的
words.ex: He is a world-renowned scientist.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位世界闻名的科学家。
words.en: Known and admired throughout the world; famous globally.

words.tr: phrase. 一夜成名的人或事；迅速取得的成功
words.ex: He became an overnight success after his song went viral.
words.ex_cn: 他的歌曲走红后，一夜之间成名了。
words.en: A sudden and rapid achievement of fame or success.

words.tr: 某人的遗产永存
words.ex: Even after he died, his kindness and ideas one's legacy lives on.
words.ex_cn: 即使他去世了，他的善良和思想依然延续。

words.tr: phrase. 有进取心的人；积极向上、主动进取的人
words.ex: He is a go-getter who always finishes his work early.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个总是早早完成工作的积极进取的人。
words.en: A go-getter is someone who is very energetic, determined to succeed, and able to deal with new or difficult situations easily.

words.tr: phrase. 一个技艺精湛的演员；形容表演技巧完美无缺的演员
words.ex: He is a consummate actor who moves everyone with his performance.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位技艺高超的演员，用他的表演感动了每一个人。
words.en: An actor who is extremely skilled and has achieved the highest level of expertise.

words.tr: phrase. 天才；神童；在年幼时就表现出卓越才能的人
words.ex: He is a prodigy who plays piano at age five.
words.ex_cn: 他是个天才，五岁就会弹钢琴。
words.en: A person with exceptional talent or ability, especially at a young age.

words.w: people from all walks of life
words.tr: phrase. 各行各业的人；社会各阶层人士
words.uk: ˈpiːpl frəm ɔːl wɔːks əv laɪf
words.us: ˈpiːpl frəm ɔːl wɔːks əv laɪf
words.ex: People from all walks of life came to the festival.
words.ex_cn: 来自各行各业的人都来参加了这个节日。
words.en: People from all walks of life refers to individuals from various professions, backgrounds, or social statuses.

words.w: people who live next door to you
words.tr: phrase. 住在你隔壁的人；你的隔壁邻居
words.uk: ˈpiːpl huː lɪv nekst dɔː tuː juː
words.us: ˈpiːpl huː lɪv nekst doʊr tuː juː
words.ex: The people who live next door to you are nice.
words.ex_cn: 住在你隔壁的人很友好。
words.en: Your neighbours; the people living in the house or flat next to yours.

words.tr: phrase. 从一贫如洗到富贵显赫；白手起家获得巨大成功
words.ex: He went from rags to riches by starting a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他通过创办一家小企业从贫穷变成了富翁。
words.en: To go from being very poor to being very wealthy.

words.w: is a subject very close to one's heart
words.tr: phrase. 是一个非常贴近某人内心的话题；是某人十分关切的事情
words.uk: /ɪz ə ˈsʌbdʒekt ˈveri kləʊs tu wʌnz hɑːt/
words.us: /ɪz ə ˈsʌbdʒekt ˈvɛri kloʊs tə wʌnz hɑrt/
words.ex: Math is a subject very close to one's heart.
words.ex_cn: 数学是一个让人非常热爱的科目。
words.en: Something that one feels very passionate about or has a deep personal connection to.

words.tr: phrase. 关心某事；担心某事；对某事感到忧虑
words.ex: She is concerned about her son's health.
words.ex_cn: 她担心她儿子的健康。
words.en: To worry or feel anxious about something.

words.tr: phrase. 是一种奢侈；是一件奢侈品；是难得的享受
words.ex: A private car is a luxury for many families.
words.ex_cn: 对于许多家庭来说，私家车是一种奢侈。
words.en: Something expensive and desirable but not essential.

words.tr: phrase. 是绝对必要的；是必不可少的事物
words.ex: Water is an absolute necessity for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命绝对必需的。
words.en: Something absolutely essential; a basic requirement.

words.w: is part and parcel of being famous
words.tr: phrase. 成名的固有部分；成名所不可避免的组成部分
words.uk: pɑːt ənd ˈpɑːsl əv ˈbiːɪŋ ˈfeɪməs
words.us: pɑːrt ənd ˈpɑːrsl əv ˈbiːɪŋ ˈfeɪməs
words.ex: Being watched everywhere is part and parcel of being famous.
words.ex_cn: 随时随地被人关注是成名的一部分。
words.en: Being famous involves certain inevitable aspects or responsibilities.

words.tr: n. 名人；
words.ex: The celebrity smiled at the fans outside the theater.
words.ex_cn: 这位名人向剧院外的粉丝微笑。
words.en: A celebrity is a famous person, especially in entertainment or sports.

words.tr: n. 狗仔队
words.ex: The paparazzi took photos of the celebrity at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 狗仔队在机场拍下了这位名人的照片。
words.en: Paparazzi are photographers who follow famous people around in order to take pictures of them that they can sell to newspapers or magazines.

words.tr: adj. 奢侈的；过度的；
words.ex: He bought an extravagant car that cost too much money.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一辆奢侈的车，价格太贵了。
words.en: Spending much more than is necessary or wise; excessively expensive.

words.tr: phrase. 运输基础设施；指支持交通运输系统的设施，如道路、铁路、机场、港口等
words.ex: The city built new transport infrastructure to reduce traffic.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市建造了新的交通基础设施以减少交通拥堵。
words.en: The physical networks and facilities used for moving people and goods, including roads, railways, ports, and airports.

words.tr: phrase. 道路网络；公路网
words.ex: The city improved its road network last year.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市去年改善了它的道路网络。
words.en: A road network is a system of connected roads and highways that allows for travel and transport within a region.

words.tr: phrase. 交通瓶颈；指道路上因容量不足或障碍导致车流受阻的路段
words.ex: The traffic bottleneck causes long delays at rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 交通瓶颈在高峰时段导致长时间延误。
words.en: A traffic bottleneck is a section of a road or highway where the flow of traffic is significantly reduced, often causing delays and congestion.

words.w: be out of bounds to sb
words.tr: phrase. 对某人来说是不允许的
words.ex: The truth is out of bounds to him.
words.ex_cn: 这个真相对他来说是不能谈的。
words.en: If an area is out of bounds to someone, they are not allowed to go there.

words.tr: phrase. 首尾相接的；拥挤的（通常形容交通堵塞）
words.ex: The traffic was bumper to bumper during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段交通堵塞得车辆连成一片。
words.en: Moving or parked very close together, as in heavy traffic.

words.tr: phrase. 车流量；交通量
words.ex: The volume of traffic on the roads has increased significantly during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 在高峰时段，道路上的车流量显著增加。
words.en: The amount of vehicles moving along a road or in an area.

words.tr: phrase. 交通密度；单位时间内道路上车辆的密集程度
words.ex: The traffic density is high during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段交通密度很高。
words.en: The degree of congestion of vehicles or pedestrians in a particular area, often measured as the number of vehicles or people per unit area of road space.

words.tr: phrase. 挤满的；塞得满满的
words.ex: The concert hall was jam-packed with fans.
words.ex_cn: v. 音乐厅里挤满了粉丝。
words.en: If a place is jam-packed, it is so full of people or things that there is no room for more.

words.tr: n. 通勤者；经常往返者；
words.ex: He is a commuter who takes the train to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名每天乘火车上班的通勤者。
words.en: A commuter is someone who travels a long distance to work every day.

words.tr: phrase. 混合动力车
words.ex: He drives a hybrid car to save fuel.
words.ex_cn: 他开一辆混合动力汽车以节省燃油。
words.en: A hybrid car is a vehicle that uses two or more distinct power sources to move, typically combining an internal combustion engine with an electric motor.

words.tr: phrase. 耗油量
words.ex: The car has high fuel consumption.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车油耗很高。
words.en: The amount of fuel used by a vehicle or machine over a certain period or distance.

words.tr: phrase. 耗油量大的汽车或机器；油老虎
words.ex: He drives a gas guzzler that uses too much fuel.
words.ex_cn: 他开的是一辆耗油很大的车。
words.en: A vehicle that consumes an excessive amount of fuel, typically a large or powerful model.

words.tr: phrase. 鲁莽驾驶；危险驾驶
words.ex: He was fined for reckless driving.
words.ex_cn: 他因危险驾驶被罚款。
words.en: Driving in a way that shows a disregard for the safety of others.

words.tr: phrase. 酒后驾驶；醉酒驾驶
words.ex: Drunk driving is a serious offense that endangers lives.
words.ex_cn: 酒后驾驶是一种危及生命的严重违法行为。
words.en: The act of driving a vehicle while impaired by alcohol to the extent that one's mental faculties are significantly reduced.

words.tr: v. 损害某人的驾驶能力
words.ex: Drinking alcohol can impair one's driving ability.
words.ex_cn: 喝酒会损害人的驾驶能力。

words.tr: 短语动词. 平安无事地到达某地；安全地抵达某个地方
words.ex: They walked for hours but finally got somewhere safe and sound.
words.ex_cn: 他们走了几个小时，终于安全到达了一个安全的地方。
words.en: To arrive at a place without any harm or damage.

words.tr: phrase. 曲折；迂回；波折（常指情节、道路或人生的复杂变化）
words.ex: The story has many twists and turns.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事有很多曲折。
words.en: Complex, unpredictable developments or changes in a situation or story.

words.tr: phrase. 混乱的局面；混战；无规则的争斗
words.ex: The debate turned into a free-for-all.
words.ex_cn: 辩论变成了一场混战。
words.en: A situation in which everyone can do what they want without any rules or control.

words.tr: （文章等）组织框架很好的
words.ex: She is a well-organised student who always finishes her homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有条理的学生，总是按时完成作业。
words.en: Arranged or structured in an efficient or effective way.

words.tr: phrase. 在交叉路口；在交汇处
words.ex: The two roads meet at the intersection.
words.ex_cn: 两条路在交叉口相会。
words.en: Located where two or more roads meet or cross.

words.tr: phrase. 猛踩刹车；急刹车
words.ex: He jammed on the brakes to avoid the dog.
words.ex_cn: 他猛踩刹车以避开那只狗。
words.en: To press the brakes of a vehicle suddenly and forcefully in order to stop quickly.

words.tr: phrase. 超过速度限制，超速驾驶
words.ex: He went over the speed limit and got a ticket.
words.ex_cn: 他超速了，收到了罚单。
words.en: To drive faster than the legally permitted speed.

words.tr: phrase. 多元文化社会；由多种族、多文化群体共同组成的社会
words.ex: Canada is a multicultural society with many different cultures.
words.ex_cn: 加拿大是一个拥有许多不同文化的多元文化社会。
words.en: A society composed of people from diverse cultural backgrounds living together.

words.tr: phrase. 文化马赛克；指多种文化在一个社会中共存且保持各自特色的现象，常用于描述多元文化社会
words.ex: Canada is a cultural mosaic with many traditions.
words.ex_cn: 加拿大是一个拥有多种传统的文化大熔炉。
words.en: A society where different cultures coexist and contribute to the whole, like pieces in a mosaic.

words.tr: v. 传播；散播；扩散
words.ex: The news will disseminate quickly through social media.
words.ex_cn: 这条新闻会通过社交媒体迅速传播。
words.en: To disseminate means to spread or distribute something, especially information, widely.

words.tr: n. 主流；干流；
words.ex: Pop music is part of the mainstream.
words.ex_cn: 流行音乐是主流的一部分。
words.en: The ideas, attitudes, or activities that are shared by most people and regarded as normal or conventional.

words.tr: phrase. 习惯的；惯例的；通常的
words.ex: It is customary to shake hands when you meet someone for the first time.
words.ex_cn: v. 第一次见面时握手是惯例。
words.en: To be customary means to be in accordance with custom or usual practice.

words.tr: adj. 非传统的；
words.ex: He uses an unorthodox method to teach math.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种非传统的方法教数学。
words.en: If you describe someone's behaviour, beliefs, or customs as unorthodox, you mean that they are different from what is generally accepted.

words.tr: 短语动词. 属于少数；占少数
words.ex: In the vote, those who wanted to cancel the trip were in the minority.
words.ex_cn: 在投票中，想要取消旅行的人处于少数。
words.en: To be in the minority means to be part of the smaller number or part within a larger group or population.

words.tr: phrase. 曾经的日子一去不复返了；过去的时代已经结束了
words.uk: ɡəʊn ɑː r ðə deɪz wɛn
words.ex: Gone are the days when we walked to school.
words.ex_cn: 我们步行上学的日子一去不复返了。
words.en: A phrase used to indicate that a past situation or time no longer exists.

words.tr: phrase. 核心价值观；基本信念；根本价值
words.ex: My family teaches me core values like honesty and kindness.
words.ex_cn: 我的家人教我诚实和善良等核心价值观。
words.en: The fundamental beliefs or principles that guide a person or group's behavior.

words.tr: phrase. 社会习俗；社会道德规范
words.ex: People follow social mores to fit in with their community.
words.ex_cn: 人们遵守社会风俗以融入社区。
words.en: The unwritten social rules and conventions that govern behavior in a society.

words.tr: phrase. 来自；起源于
words.ex: His love of music stems from his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他对音乐的热爱源于他的童年。
words.en: If a condition or problem stems from something, it was caused originally by that thing.

words.tr: v. 成为一种结合机制
phrase. 融入一种新文化；同化于一种新的文化中
words.ex: He tries to assimilate into a new culture after moving to Canada.
words.ex_cn: 他搬到加拿大后，努力融入新文化。
words.en: To adopt the customs, language, and behavior of a new cultural group.

words.tr: phrase. 不言而喻的规则；未明说但被普遍遵守的规范
words.ex: He followed the unspoken rules of the team.
words.ex_cn: 他遵守了团队的不成文规定。
words.en: Unwritten social norms or expectations that govern behavior without being formally stated.

words.tr: phrase. 与…不相容的；与……对立
words.ex: This software may be incompatible with older operating systems.
words.ex_cn: 这个软件可能与旧的操作系统不兼容。
words.en: If one thing or person is incompatible with another, they do not suit each other or agree with each other.

words.tr: phrase. 语言障碍
words.ex: He cannot talk to the doctor because of the language barrier.
words.ex_cn: 由于语言障碍，他无法和医生交流。
words.en: A language barrier is a figurative phrase used primarily to refer to linguistic barriers to communication, i.e., the difficulties in communication experienced by people or groups originally speaking different languages, or even dialects in some cases.

words.tr: adj. 原始的；简陋的；
words.ex: The tribe lives in a primitive hut.
words.ex_cn: 这个部落住在原始的小屋里。
words.en: Belonging to a very early period in the history of the world, or to a time before modern things existed.

words.tr: phrase. 原住民；土著人；当地土生土长的民族
words.ex: The indigenous people live near the forest.
words.ex_cn: 原住民住在森林附近。
words.en: Indigenous people are ethnic groups who are the original inhabitants of a given region, in contrast to groups that have settled, occupied or colonized the area more recently.

words.tr: phrase. 远祖；远古祖先
words.ex: Tracing back to our remote ancestors can reveal much about our family history.
words.ex_cn: 追溯我们的远祖可以揭示很多关于我们家族历史的信息。
words.en: Remote ancestors refer to the distant forebears or progenitors from whom one is descended.

words.tr: phrase. 已经消失；已经不见
words.ex: The toys have vanished from the box.
words.ex_cn: 玩具从盒子里消失了。
words.en: To have ceased to exist or be present.

words.tr: phrase. 保持完整；完好无损；未受损害
words.ex: The old vase remained intact after the fall.
words.ex_cn: 花瓶从高处掉下后仍然完好无损。
words.en: To stay undamaged, unchanged, or in its original condition.

words.tr: adj. 怀旧的；乡愁的
words.ex: He felt nostalgic when he saw his old toy.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到自己的旧玩具时，他感到怀旧。
words.en: If you feel nostalgic, you feel both happy and slightly sad when you think about things that happened in the past.

words.tr: phrase. 有远见的
words.ex: He is a forward-looking manager who plans for the future.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位具有前瞻性的经理，为未来做规划。
words.en: If you describe a person or organization as forward-looking, you approve of the fact that they think about the future or have modern ideas.

words.tr: 短语动词. 再次流行起来；重新受到欢迎
words.ex: Classic video games have a resurgence in popularity among young players.
words.ex_cn: 经典电子游戏在年轻玩家中重新流行起来。
words.en: To experience a renewed increase in popularity or interest.

words.tr: phrase. 东山再起；复出；重新流行
words.ex: After years away, the singer will make a comeback next month.
words.ex_cn: 离开多年后，这位歌手将于下个月复出。
words.en: To return to a former position of strength, importance, or high rank after a period of absence.

words.tr: phrase. 恢复其活力；重新焕发生机
words.ex: The old town will regain its vitality after the festival.
words.ex_cn: 这个古镇在节日之后会重新焕发生机。
words.en: To recover strength, energy, or enthusiasm.

words.tr: adj. 尴尬的；
words.ex: He felt awkward when he forgot his friend's name.
words.ex_cn: 当他忘记朋友的名字时，他感到很尴尬。
words.en: If you describe a situation as awkward, you mean that it is embarrassing or difficult to deal with.

words.tr: phrase. 感到不自在的；感到拘束的；感到不安的
words.ex: He feels ill at ease when he speaks in front of people.
words.ex_cn: 当他当着大家说话时，他感到不自在。
words.en: If you are ill at ease, you feel uncomfortable or anxious in a particular situation.

words.tr: phrase. 通用语；混合语
words.ex: English is a lingua franca in international business.
words.ex_cn: 英语是国际商务中的通用语言。
words.en: A lingua franca is a language or way of communicating which is used between people who do not speak one another's native language.

words.tr: phrase. 一种单一的国际语言
words.ex: The idea of a single international language has been proposed many times throughout history.
words.ex_cn: 历史上曾多次提出一种国际通用语言的想法。
words.en: A single language used worldwide for communication between people of different native languages.

words.tr: phrase. 保持文化的独特性；维护各文化的个性
words.ex: It is important to preserve the individuality of cultures in a globalized world.
words.ex_cn: 在全球化的世界中，保护文化的个性是很重要的。
words.en: To protect the unique characteristics and traditions of different cultures.

words.tr: adj. 仅懂一种语言的；
words.ex: He is monolingual and only speaks English.
words.ex_cn: 他只会说英语，不懂其他语言。
words.en: Using or knowing only one language.

words.tr: phrase. 紧密团结的社区；关系密切的群体
words.ex: Living in a close-knit community can provide a strong sense of belonging and support.
words.ex_cn: 生活在一个紧密团结的社区中可以提供强烈的归属感和支持。
words.en: A group of people who are closely connected and support each other strongly.

words.tr: phrase. 一种疏离感；一种被孤立或与周围环境脱节的感觉
words.ex: Living in a foreign country for many years, he developed a sense of alienation from his own culture.
words.ex_cn: 在国外生活多年后，他对自己的文化产生了一种疏离感。
words.en: A feeling of being isolated, disconnected, or not belonging to a group or society.

words.tr: v. 正在建设中；正在施工
phrase. 建筑业；建筑行业
words.ex: The construction industry builds houses and roads.
words.ex_cn: 建筑业建造房屋和道路。
words.en: The sector involved in building and infrastructure projects.

words.tr: adj. 残破的；
words.ex: The old house looked dilapidated after years of neglect.
words.ex_cn: 这所老房子因多年疏于维护而显得残破。
words.en: A building that is dilapidated is old and in a generally bad condition.

words.tr: 短语动词. 作为……的展示平台；用来展示……
words.ex: The new museum be a showcase for local art.
words.ex_cn: 这个新博物馆将成为本地艺术的展示平台。
words.en: To serve as an excellent example or demonstration of something.

words.tr: v. 代表；表现；体现；相当于；
words.ex: He represents his country in the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中代表他的国家。
words.en: If someone represents a person or group of people, they act on behalf of that person or group.

words.tr: phrase. 中心位置
words.ex: The shop is in a central location.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店位于中心位置。
words.en: A central location refers to a place that is easily accessible from all parts of a city or area, often considered the main or most important area.

words.tr: v. 强加；“impose”的现在分词； adj. 壮观的；
words.ex: He imposed his rules on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的规则强加给团队。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as imposing, you mean that they have an impressive appearance or manner.

words.tr: adj. 优雅的；
words.ex: She wore an elegant dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条优雅的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe a person or thing as elegant, you mean that they are pleasing and graceful in appearance or style.

words.tr: phrase. 明亮且通风的；轻盈通透的；轻松明快的
words.ex: The room is light and airy with big windows.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有大窗户，明亮又通风。
words.en: Light and airy describes something that is not heavy and allows air to move freely, creating a sense of openness and freshness.

words.tr: adj. 通风良好的
words.ex: The kitchen is well-ventilated with a big window.
words.ex_cn: 厨房有一个大窗户，通风良好。
words.en: A well-ventilated place has plenty of fresh air and is not stuffy.

words.tr: adj. 宽敞的；
words.ex: The new house has a spacious living room.
words.ex_cn: 这所新房子有一个宽敞的客厅。
words.en: A spacious room, building, or place is large in size or area, so that you can move around freely in it.

words.tr: 短语. 成为一个非常重要的地标
words.ex: The old church be a very significant landmark in the town.
words.ex_cn: 那座老教堂是这个小镇的一个非常重要的地标。
words.en: To serve as a prominent, recognizable, and important feature or symbol.

words.tr: n. 街坊；四邻；附近地区；
words.ex: We know all our neighbours in this neighbourhood.
words.ex_cn: 我们认识这个街坊里的所有邻居。
words.en: A neighbourhood is one of the parts of a town where people live.

words.w: be a blot on the landscape
words.tr: phrase. 成为景观中的污点；指某人或某物破坏了周围的美感或和谐
words.uk: biː ə blɒt ɒn ðə ˈlændskeɪp
words.us: biː ə blɑːt ɑːn ðə ˈlændskeɪp
words.ex: The old factory is a blot on the landscape.
words.ex_cn: 那座旧工厂破坏了风景。
words.en: To be an ugly feature that spoils the appearance of a natural or urban area.

words.tr: phrase. 商业建筑；用于商业活动（如办公、零售、服务等）的建筑物
words.ex: The new commercial building has five floors.
words.ex_cn: 这座新的商业大楼有五层。
words.en: A commercial building is a structure that is used for business purposes, such as offices, retail stores, or other commercial activities.

words.tr: phrase. 住宅建筑；居民楼
words.ex: The new residential building offers modern amenities for its residents.
words.ex_cn: 这座新的住宅楼为居民提供了现代化的设施。
words.en: A building designed for people to live in, such as an apartment block or a house.

words.tr: n. 大厅；游说团队；
words.ex: We waited in the hotel lobby for our friend.
words.ex_cn: 我们在酒店的大厅里等我们的朋友。
words.en: A lobby is a large room or hall in a building, often used for meetings or as a waiting area. As a verb, to lobby means to try to influence politicians or officials on a particular issue.

words.tr: phrase. 主题公园
words.ex: We went to a theme park last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末去了一家主题公园。
words.en: A theme park is a type of amusement park that bases its structures and attractions around a central theme, often featuring multiple areas with different themes.

words.tr: phrase. v. 与……大不相同；远非
words.ex: This small room is a far cry from the big house he used to live in.
words.ex_cn: 这个小房间和他以前住的大房子相差甚远。
words.en: To be very different from and far inferior to something else; to fall short of expectations significantly.

words.tr: phrase. 完全不同于……的
words.ex: This book is entirely different from the one I read last year.
words.ex_cn: 这本书和我去年读的那本完全不同。
words.en: To be completely unlike something else.

words.tr: phrase. 将某物转变成；把……转换为
words.ex: He converts water into ice in the freezer.
words.ex_cn: 他把水放进冰箱变成冰。
words.en: To change the form, purpose, or function of something.

words.tr: phrase. 宁静的与安详的；形容环境或心境平和、无扰、祥和
words.ex: The lake is tranquil and serene at sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 日出时，湖面宁静而平和。
words.en: Free from disturbance; calm and peaceful.

words.tr: phrase. 熙熙攘攘；忙碌喧嚣
words.ex: The hustle and bustle of the city wakes me up every morning.
words.ex_cn: 城市的喧嚣每天早上都把我吵醒。
words.en: The term 'hustle and bustle' refers to the busy and noisy activity of a lot of people in a particular place.

words.tr: phrase. 缓解压力；减轻紧张
words.ex: Listening to music can relieve stress.
words.ex_cn: 听音乐可以缓解压力。
words.en: To reduce or alleviate the feeling of stress or tension.

words.tr: phrase. 感到压力很大；紧张过度；精疲力尽
words.ex_cn: 他因为太多作业而感到压力很大。
words.en: To be in a state of mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances.

words.tr: phrase. 遍布；点缀着
words.ex: The sky is dotted with stars.
words.ex_cn: 天空布满了星星。
words.en: To be scattered or sprinkled with something, typically in a way that creates a pattern or design.

words.tr: n. 积雪覆盖的山脉
words.ex: The snow-capped mountains look beautiful in the morning light.
words.ex_cn: 积雪的山峰在晨光中看起来很美丽。
words.en: Mountains covered with snow.

words.tr: phrase. 蜿蜒的小路
words.ex: We followed the winding path through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 我们沿着蜿蜒的小路穿过森林。
words.en: A path that follows a twisting or turning course.

words.tr: phrase. 平缓起伏的丘陵
words.ex: The farm is surrounded by gentle rolling hills.
words.ex_cn: 农场被柔和起伏的山丘环绕。
words.en: Gently sloping, rounded hills with a smooth appearance.

words.tr:
adj. 波动的；起伏的
v. 使波动；使起伏；“undulate”的现在分词
words.ex: The road is undulating through the hills.
words.ex_cn: 这条路在山丘间起伏蜿蜒。
words.en: Moving with a smooth wavelike motion.

words.tr: adj. 彩虹色的；色彩斑斓的
words.ex: The soap bubble is iridescent in the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 肥皂泡在阳光下呈现出彩虹色。
words.en: Showing luminous colors that seem to change when seen from different angles.

words.tr:
adj.  发微光的；闪闪发光的
v. 闪烁；发微光；“shimmer”的现在分词
words.ex: The lake is shimmering under the sun.
words.ex_cn: 湖面在阳光下闪烁。
words.en: Shimmering is used to describe something that shines with a flickering or wavering light.

words.tr: adj. 令人敬畏的；令人惊叹的
words.ex: The mountain view is awe-inspiring.
words.ex_cn: 山景令人敬畏。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as awe-inspiring, you are emphasizing that you think that they are remarkable and amazing, although sometimes rather frightening.

words.tr: adj. 令人兴奋的； v. “exhilarate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The roller coaster ride was exhilarating.
words.ex_cn: 过山车之旅令人兴奋。
words.en: If you describe something as exhilarating, you mean that it makes you feel very happy and excited.

words.tr: phrase. 落叶树（指在干旱或寒冷季节落叶的树木）
words.ex: The deciduous trees lose their leaves in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 落叶树在秋天会掉叶子。
words.en: Deciduous trees are trees that shed their leaves annually, typically in the autumn.

words.tr: phrase. 常绿树；四季保持绿叶的树木
words.ex: Evergreen trees stay green all year.
words.ex_cn: 常绿树一年四季都是绿色的。
words.en: Evergreen trees are trees that do not lose their leaves seasonally but remain green year-round.

words.tr: n. 植被；（统称）植物；
words.ex: The desert has little vegetation.
words.ex_cn: 这个沙漠植被很少。
words.en: Vegetation refers to plants in general, or the plants that are found in a particular area. It can also refer to a life that is dull or inactive, often due to illness or lack of exercise.

words.tr: n. 花束；（酒等的）芳香
words.ex: She bought a bouquet of flowers for her mom.
words.ex_cn: 她为妈妈买了一束花。
words.en: A bouquet is a bunch of flowers that is attractively arranged, especially one that is given to someone as a present.

words.tr: n. 花床；花圃；花坛
words.ex: She carefully tended to her flowerbed, ensuring each plant received adequate sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 她仔细地照料她的花床，确保每株植物都能得到充足的阳光。
words.en: A flowerbed is an area of ground in a garden or park where flowers are planted.

words.tr: n. 叶子（总称）；
words.ex: The trees showed bright foliage in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 秋天时，树木呈现出鲜艳的叶子。
words.en: The leaves of a plant or tree, or the leaves on trees and plants collectively.

words.tr: n. 灌木丛；矮树；
words.ex: The cat hid behind the bush.
words.ex_cn: 猫躲到了灌木丛后面。
words.en: A bush is a plant which is much smaller than a tree and has a lot of branches.

words.tr: n. 野营地；露营场所
words.ex: We set up our tent at the campground.
words.ex_cn: 我们在露营地搭起了帐篷。
words.en: A campground is a place where people can camp, typically in tents or recreational vehicles.

words.tr: adj. 如画的；
words.ex: The village by the lake is picturesque.
words.ex_cn: 湖边的村庄如画般美丽。
words.en: A picturesque place is attractive and interesting, especially in a way that is old-fashioned or unusual.

words.tr: phrase. 擅长园艺；有养植物的天赋（英式英语，相当于美式英语中的 'green thumb'）
words.ex: My grandma has green fingers and grows beautiful flowers.
words.ex_cn: 我奶奶有园艺天赋，种出了美丽的花。
words.en: To be good at gardening and growing plants.

words.tr: phrase. 作物产量
words.ex: The farmer hopes for a high crop yield this year.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民希望今年有高的作物产量。
words.en: The amount of a crop that is harvested per unit of land area.

words.tr: phrase. 自然资源（如矿产、森林、水等自然界中可供人类利用的物质或能量）
words.ex: The country has many natural resources like oil and water.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家有很多自然资源，比如石油和水。
words.en: A valuable asset or material that occurs naturally in the environment.

words.tr: n. 适者生存
words.ex: In nature, survival for the fittest means only the strongest animals live long.
words.ex_cn: 在自然界中，适者生存意味着只有最强壮的动物才能活得长久。

words.tr: adj. 完全透明的；极其清楚的
words.ex: The instructions were crystal-clear.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明非常清晰。
words.en: Very clear; easy to understand.

words.tr: adj. 污浊的；
words.ex: The river water looked murky after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后，河水看起来污浊。
words.en: If you describe something as murky, you mean that the details of it are not clear or that it is difficult to understand.

words.tr: 短语动词. 进入开花期；开始绽放（通常指植物）
words.ex: The flowers come into bloom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 花朵在春天开放。
words.en: When a plant or tree comes into bloom, it produces flowers.

words.tr: phrase. 结出果实；产生结果；奏效
words.ex: If you work hard, your efforts will bear fruit.
words.ex_cn: 如果你努力工作，你的努力会结出果实。
words.en: To produce a desired result or to become successful.

words.tr: phrase. 预期寿命；平均寿命
words.ex: Life expectancy has increased in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 许多国家的预期寿命已经增加。
words.en: The average period that a person may expect to live.

words.tr: phrase. 寿命；使用期限
words.ex: The life span of a dog is about 10 to 15 years.
words.ex_cn: 狗的寿命大约是10到15年。
words.en: The length of time for which a person or animal lives or a thing functions.

words.tr: phrase. 延长生命；延长寿命
words.ex: He eats healthy food to extend life.
words.ex_cn: 他吃健康食品来延长生命。
words.en: To prolong the duration of existence or vitality of a person, animal, or object, often through medical, technological, or lifestyle interventions.

words.tr: phrase. 关注健康的；重视健康的
words.ex: She tries to be health-conscious by eating more vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 她通过多吃蔬菜来注重健康。
words.en: To be health-conscious means to be aware of and concerned about your health, often taking steps to maintain or improve it.

words.tr: n. 锻炼计划；运动方案
words.ex: He follows an exercise regime every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上遵循一套锻炼计划以保持健康。

words.tr: 短语. 欢迎回家
words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.tr: phrase. 抑制；制止；阻止自己做某事
words.ex: He tried to restrain from eating sweets.
words.ex_cn: 他努力克制自己不吃糖果。
words.en: To prevent oneself from doing something; to hold back or control oneself.

words.tr: n. 自律；自我约束
words.ex: He shows self-discipline by waking up early every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天早起展现自律。
words.en: The ability to control yourself and to make yourself work hard or behave in a particular way without needing anyone else to tell you what to do.

words.tr: 名词短语，健康与健身；指身体和心理的健康状态以及通过锻炼和饮食维持或改善体能的活动
words.ex: He walks every day for health and fitness.
words.ex_cn: 他每天走路以保持健康和健身。
words.en: The overall condition of being physically and mentally well, often involving exercise and nutrition.

words.tr: v. 给某人接种疫苗以预防（某种疾病）
phrase. 免疫系统
words.ex: The immune system fights germs in the body.
words.ex_cn: 免疫系统在体内对抗细菌。
words.en: The immune system is the body's defense against infectious organisms and other invaders. Through a series of steps called the immune response, the immune system attacks organisms and substances that invade body systems and cause disease.

words.tr: phrase. 医疗；治疗；医学处理
words.ex: He needs medical treatment for his broken leg.
words.ex_cn: 他需要为断掉的腿接受治疗。
words.en: Medical treatment refers to the management and care of a patient to combat disease or disorder.

words.tr: phrase. 一种久坐的工作；需要长时间坐着的工作
words.ex: He has a sedentary job at an office.
words.ex_cn: 他在办公室有一份久坐的工作。
words.en: A job that involves sitting for long periods with little physical activity, often associated with health risks like obesity or back pain.

words.tr: phrase. 眼睛疲劳；视疲劳（长时间用眼导致的眼睛不适）
words.ex: He gets eye strain from looking at his phone too long.
words.ex_cn: 他因为长时间看手机而眼睛疲劳。
words.en: Eye strain refers to discomfort or pain in the eyes, often caused by prolonged use of digital devices, reading without sufficient light, or other activities requiring intense use of the eyes.

words.tr: phrase. 血液循环
words.ex: Exercise improves blood circulation.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼改善血液循环。
words.en: The movement of blood through the body, driven by the heart, which delivers oxygen and nutrients to the tissues and removes carbon dioxide and other wastes.

words.tr: phrase. 肌肉力量
words.ex: Regular exercise can significantly improve your muscle strength.
words.ex_cn: 定期锻炼可以显著提高你的肌肉力量。
words.en: The physical power and force that is produced by the muscles in the body.

words.tr: 感到焕然一新；感到精神焕发
words.ex: She feels refreshed after a short nap.
words.ex_cn: 她小睡一会儿后感觉精神焕发。
words.en: Feel refreshed: To experience a renewed sense of energy, vitality, and mental clarity.

words.tr: 感到精力充沛的；感到充满活力的
words.ex: She feels invigorated after a morning walk.
words.ex_cn: 她早晨散步后感到精力充沛。
words.en: To feel renewed, energized, or full of new vitality.

words.w: has taken its toll on one's health
words.tr: 短语动词. 对某人的健康造成了严重影响；长期损害了某人的健康
words.uk: hæz ˈteɪkən ɪts təʊl ɒn wʌnz helθ
words.us: hæz ˈteɪkən ɪts toʊl ɑːn wʌnz helθ
words.ex: Stress has taken its toll on one's health.
words.ex_cn: 压力已经对健康造成了损害。
words.en: To have caused damage or harm to someone's health.

words.tr: phrase. 慢性疾病；长期持续的疾病
words.ex: He has chronic diseases and needs medicine every day.
words.ex_cn: 他患有慢性病，每天都需要吃药。
words.en: Chronic diseases are conditions that last 1 year or more and require ongoing medical attention or limit activities of daily living or both.

words.tr: phrase. 买保险
words.ex: He decided to take out insurance to protect his new car.
words.ex_cn: 他决定购买保险以保护他的新车。
words.en: To purchase an insurance policy to protect against loss or damage.

words.tr: phrase. 患上一种疾病；感染某种疾病
words.ex: He contracted a disease from dirty water.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了脏水后染上了一种疾病。
words.en: To become infected with or develop a specific illness.

words.tr: phrase. 一次流行病；广泛传播的现象
words.ex: An epidemic spread quickly in the town.
words.ex_cn: 一场传染病在小镇迅速蔓延。
words.en: A widespread occurrence of an infectious disease in a community at a particular time.

words.tr: n. 疗法；纠正办法；
words.ex: The doctor suggested a natural remedy for the cold.
words.ex_cn: 医生建议了一种治疗感冒的天然疗法。
words.en: A remedy is a cure or a way of making something better.

words.w: get a clean bill of health
words.tr: 短语动词. 获得健康证明；被确认健康；通过检查或评估而被认为没有问题
words.uk: ɡet ə klen bɪl əv helθ
words.us: ɡet ə klen bɪl əv helθ
words.ex: The doctor said he got a clean bill of health after the check-up.
words.ex_cn: 医生说他体检后得到了健康证明。
words.en: To be declared healthy or in good condition after a check-up or inspection.

words.tr: phrase. 感觉不舒服；身体欠佳；略有不适
words.ex: He feels under the weather today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天感觉不舒服。
words.en: To feel slightly ill.

words.tr: phrase. 高胆固醇的；指血液中胆固醇水平过高的状态
words.ex: He has high cholesterol and must eat less fat.
words.ex_cn: 他胆固醇高，必须少吃脂肪。
words.en: High cholesterol refers to an excessive level of cholesterol in the blood, which can increase the risk of cardiovascular diseases.

words.tr: phrase. 高血压；动脉血压持续升高的病症
words.ex: He has high blood pressure and must eat less salt.
words.ex_cn: 他有高血压，必须少吃盐。
words.en: High blood pressure is a condition in which the force of the blood against the artery walls is too high.

words.tr: phrase. 身体健壮的；精力充沛的；健康的（多用于形容年长者身体硬朗）
words.ex: My grandfather is hale and hearty at 85.
words.ex_cn: 我祖父85岁了，身体依然健壮。
words.en: In good health and full of energy.

words.tr: phrase. 非常健康；身体极佳
words.ex: He is as fit as a fiddle after his morning run.
words.ex_cn: 他晨跑后身体非常健康。
words.en: In very good health.

words.tr: phrase. 缺乏；不足
words.ex: He is deficient in vitamin D.
words.ex_cn: 他缺乏维生素D。
words.en: to lack something that is needed or essential

words.tr: phrase. 含有丰富的…；富于
words.ex: This soil is rich in nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 这种土壤富含养分。
words.en: To contain a large amount of something beneficial or valuable.
